customer-locker-booking.summary: Tap an empty box on the layout to rent it or send a parcel from it.

customer-locker-map.title: Locker map
customer-locker-map.summary: See all lockers on a map, locate yourself and open locker info quickly.

customer-locker-detail-map.title: Locker info on the map
customer-locker-detail-map.summary: Open a locker preview, see free boxes, book a service and get directions.

customer-stores.title: Drop-off points
customer-stores.summary: Find stores with Lock.R lockers near you, save favorites and open details.

customer-store-detail.title: Drop-off point details
customer-store-detail.summary: Store info, directions, its lockers and customer reviews.

customer-directions.title: Directions to a locker
customer-directions.summary: In-app navigation from your position to a store or locker.

customer-favorites.title: Favorite drop-off points
customer-favorites.summary: The stores you saved on this device.

customer-send-form.title: Send via locker
customer-send-form.summary: Create a send order: locker, box size, recipient, storage time and discounts.

customer-payment-vietqr.title: VietQR payment
customer-payment-vietqr.summary: Pay for sending, renting, extensions or drone deliveries by VietQR bank transfer.

customer-send-drop.title: Drop off the parcel
customer-send-drop.summary: After paying: open the box, put the parcel in and confirm.

customer-send-done.title: Pass the code on
customer-send-done.summary: Parcel dropped: share the pickup code and watch the deadline.

customer-rent-form.title: Rent a storage locker
customer-rent-form.summary: Rent a box by the hour or day: locker, box type, duration and discounts.

customer-rent-result.title: Your rental
customer-rent-result.summary: After renting: get the PIN, open the box, pay extensions and view the order.

customer-drone-book.title: Send by drone
customer-drone-book.summary: Book a technician to collect at home and a drone to deliver to the receiving locker.

customer-drone-pickup-map.title: Choose the pickup point
customer-drone-pickup-map.summary: Search an address, pin it on the map or use your position for the technician.

customer-drone-tracking.title: Drone delivery tracking
customer-drone-tracking.summary: A drone order’s journey: current stage, payment, home pickup and incidents.

customer-drone-tracking-route.title: Drone route & pickup
customer-drone-tracking-route.summary: Drop-off, pickup, maps, deadline and delivery progress.

customer-drone-tracking-info.title: Drone order info
customer-drone-tracking-info.summary: Order details, people, flight mission, journey log and actions.

customer-drone-live-map.title: Live drone map
customer-drone-live-map.summary: Watch the drone fly on the map with expected arrival and speed.

customer-orders-incoming.title: Incoming parcels
customer-orders-incoming.summary: Parcels sent to you: pickup code, opening the box and details.

customer-receiver-detail.title: Incoming order details
customer-receiver-detail.summary: Pickup code, opening, directions, drone tracking and sender info.

customer-order-detail.title: Order details
customer-order-detail.summary: Status, PIN/QR, locker and fee info, timeline and rating of an order.

customer-order-actions.title: Order actions
customer-order-actions.summary: Buttons in order details follow the state: pay, open, confirm, extend.

customer-order-more.title: Delegation, PIN & help
customer-order-more.summary: Delegate pickup, change PIN, recipient email, report a box, cancel, directions and refunds.

customer-delegations.title: Delegated orders
customer-delegations.summary: Orders other people asked you to collect.

customer-authorized-opening.title: Delegated locker opening
customer-authorized-opening.summary: Collect with a code sent to you, right at the locker.

customer-qr-scan.title: Kiosk login by QR
customer-qr-scan.summary: Scan the kiosk screen code to use your account at the locker.

customer-qr-manual.title: Enter the kiosk code
customer-qr-manual.summary: Log in on the kiosk with codes when the QR won’t scan.

drone-tech-pickup.title: Home pickup
drone-tech-pickup.summary: Answer invitations, collect the parcel at the sender's address and bring it to the sending locker to assign a drone. Tap a card for order details.

drone-tech-orders.title: Drone delivery orders
drone-tech-orders.summary: Order cards in the Dispatch tab: return parcels to senders, assign, load and launch drones, confirm stages and handle problems.

drone-tech-order-detail.title: Drone mission details
drone-tech-order-detail.summary: Tap an order in the Dispatch tab to see its whole journey, updated in real time.

drone-tech-mission-planner.title: Flight planning
drone-tech-mission-planner.summary: Draw a flight path on the map, edit each point and export a mission file for the ground station.

drone-tech-fleet.title: Fleet
drone-tech-fleet.summary: Drones you're in charge of and drones without a technician: status, battery, home locker. Tap a drone to act on it.

drone-tech-drone-actions.title: Drone actions
drone-tech-drone-actions.summary: Tap a drone in the Fleet tab to take charge or release it, change its status, update battery or view its maintenance log.

drone-tech-flight-data.title: Telemetry & control
drone-tech-flight-data.summary: Connect a flight controller over MAVLink to see position and a live HUD and send flight commands — only with SITL or a dedicated control link.

drone-tech-incidents.title: Drone incidents
drone-tech-incidents.summary: Drone technical tickets and parcel-drop incidents: search, filter, claim and follow up.

drone-tech-my-work.title: My work
drone-tech-my-work.summary: Incident tickets and drone maintenance schedules assigned to you, filtered by type, status and due date.

drone-tech-routine.title: Routine maintenance
drone-tech-routine.summary: Drone maintenance schedules created by admins: search, filter by due date and priority, inspect with the checklist.

drone-tech-flight-tools.title: Flight tools
drone-tech-flight-tools.summary: Open the flight planner and the drone telemetry/control screen.

drone-tech-profile-sheet.title: Profile at a glance
drone-tech-profile-sheet.summary: Tap your photo at the top to see performance, rating and SLA policy and open your profile.

drone-tech-profile.title: Technician profile
drone-tech-profile.summary: See your shift metrics, edit personal info, change language and log out.

kiosk-home.title: Kiosk home screen
kiosk-home.summary: Three things you can do right at the locker: open a box with a code, store items / rent a box, and report a problem.

kiosk-open-code.title: Open a box with a code
kiosk-open-code.summary: Enter a 6-digit PIN or QR code to open a box: pick up, drop off or reopen a box you rent.

kiosk-open-invalid.title: Code rejected
kiosk-open-invalid.summary: When the code is wrong, expired, or the order has something unpaid.

kiosk-open-retry.title: System busy
kiosk-open-retry.summary: The code couldn't be checked because of the network or a busy system — try again; it doesn't count as a wrong try.

kiosk-rental-access.title: Reopening a rented box
kiosk-rental-access.summary: After entering the code of a box you rent: end the rental or just take / store items.

kiosk-end-rental-dialog.title: Confirm ending the rental
kiosk-end-rental-dialog.summary: A last check before the box is returned — so you don't end it with items still inside.

kiosk-login.title: Sign in to rent a box
kiosk-login.summary: Get a one-time code by phone or email — no password; a quick account is created if you don't have one.

kiosk-login-email.title: Sign in with email
kiosk-login-email.summary: Get the code by email; your box code and rental details are sent there too.

kiosk-otp.title: Enter the one-time code
kiosk-otp.summary: Verify with the 6-digit code you just got by SMS or email.

kiosk-boxes.title: Choose a box
kiosk-boxes.summary: A map that mirrors the real locker: pick a free box to rent, or manage the box you already rent.

kiosk-boxes-manage.title: Manage a rented box
kiosk-boxes-manage.summary: Opens when you tap "Ô của bạn": box code, open, end rental, report a fault.

kiosk-order-time.title: Choose the rental time
kiosk-order-time.summary: Pick hours or days; each option shows its price.

kiosk-order-day.title: Renting by day
kiosk-order-day.summary: "Theo ngày" mode: choose days instead of hours.

kiosk-order-summary.title: Promo code and booking
kiosk-order-summary.summary: Note, promo code, price summary and the book button.

kiosk-order-promo.title: Promo code applied
kiosk-order-promo.summary: A valid code is taken off the total; remove it to use another.

kiosk-payment.title: VietQR bank transfer
kiosk-payment.summary: Scan with your banking app; the kiosk opens the box as soon as the money arrives.

kiosk-payment-expired.title: Payment wait timed out
kiosk-payment-expired.summary: No money after 10 minutes: check again or cancel.

kiosk-payment-retry.title: VietQR code not created
kiosk-payment-retry.summary: Fallback screen when the transfer code fails: try again or cancel.

kiosk-payment-paid.title: Paid — opening the box
kiosk-payment-paid.summary: Payment received but the box didn't open yet: keep your code and retry.

kiosk-drop-confirm.title: Put your items in
kiosk-drop-confirm.summary: The box is open: put your items in, close the door, then confirm.

kiosk-success.title: Done
kiosk-success.summary: The result screen after each task: drop-off, unlock, end of rental, report sent.

kiosk-report-login.title: Sign in to report
kiosk-report-login.summary: Reporting needs a verified phone or email so a technician can reach you.

kiosk-report.title: Report a faulty box
kiosk-report.summary: Pick the box (or the whole locker), pick the problem and send it to a technician.

kiosk-keyboard-text.title: On-screen letter keyboard
kiosk-keyboard-text.summary: The virtual keyboard appears when you tap a text or email field.

kiosk-keyboard-numeric.title: Number pad
kiosk-keyboard-numeric.summary: A large number pad for box codes, one-time codes and phone numbers.

kiosk-tech-setup.title: Kiosk: pair the controller
kiosk-tech-setup.summary: The kiosk screen when the Pi isn't assigned to a locker: scan the code with the technician app.

locker-tech-header.title: Header buttons
locker-tech-header.summary: Locker installation, Q&A assistant, notifications, profile and log out.

locker-tech-profile-sheet.title: Quick profile card
locker-tech-profile-sheet.summary: Tap your profile photo for a quick look at your workload, rating and SLA level.

locker-tech-shift.title: Shift card
locker-tech-shift.summary: Start or end your shift, refresh GPS and open location details.

locker-tech-shift-location.title: Location details
locker-tech-shift-location.summary: Device GPS panel: shift state, coordinates, accuracy and the privacy promise.

locker-tech-inspect-cabinet.title: Locker layout
locker-tech-inspect-cabinet.summary: Cell counts, colour legend, physical layout, door sensors and the drone landing pad of the selected locker.

locker-tech-cell-sheet.title: Cell actions
locker-tech-cell-sheet.summary: Tap a cell on the layout to report a fault, take it out of service, clean, restore or emergency-open it.

locker-tech-incidents.title: Incidents tab
locker-tech-incidents.summary: Browse all Kiosk incident tickets, filter by scope and status, and take new work.

locker-tech-mine.title: My work tab
locker-tech-mine.summary: Shift figures, SLA level and the tickets you are handling.

locker-tech-report-detail.title: Incident ticket
locker-tech-report-detail.summary: Everything about a ticket: SLA, location, reporter, photos and work log.

locker-tech-report-actions.title: Ticket actions
locker-tech-report-actions.summary: Take, check & lock the cell, accept & complete, reject, release, directions and SLA extension.

locker-tech-resolve.title: Repair acceptance
locker-tech-resolve.summary: Confirm the repair: before / during / after photos, notes and a test open.

locker-tech-scene-photos.title: On-site confirmation
locker-tech-scene-photos.summary: Photograph the cell as soon as you arrive, as evidence before the repair.

locker-tech-extend-sla.title: SLA extension
locker-tech-extend-sla.summary: Ask for more time on a ticket: pick the hours and enter a reason.

locker-tech-box-incident.title: Check cell & lock incident
locker-tech-box-incident.summary: At the Kiosk: pick the cell, handle the items inside, decide whether to lock it, add notes and photos.

locker-tech-routine.title: Routine tab
locker-tech-routine.summary: Kiosk routine inspections: filter by assignee and due date, open details, start an inspection.

locker-tech-schedule-detail.title: Routine schedule details
locker-tech-schedule-detail.summary: The full inspection plan: deadline, location, criteria, procedure and the previous result.

locker-tech-routine-inspection.title: Routine inspection
locker-tech-routine-inspection.summary: Rate each item pass / fail, pick a faulty cell if any, add notes and photos, then confirm.

locker-tech-iot.title: IoT devices tab
locker-tech-iot.summary: Controllers on your lockers: status, last signal and details.

locker-tech-iot-device.title: IoT device details
locker-tech-iot-device.summary: Info, restart the controller, mark offline / faulty and the activity log.

locker-tech-recovery.title: Parcel recovery tab
locker-tech-recovery.summary: Tasks to find and recover parcels when a drone goes down.

locker-tech-recovery-detail.title: Recovery task details
locker-tech-recovery-detail.summary: Situation, location accuracy, evidence, receiving station and the accept, search, record, hand-over steps.

locker-tech-recovery-result.title: Record recovery result
locker-tech-recovery-result.summary: Confirm GPS on site, search outcome, parcel condition, notes and photos, then send to the admin.

locker-tech-installations.title: Installation jobs
locker-tech-installations.summary: Installation jobs from the admin: schedule, checklist progress and return reasons.

locker-tech-install-detail.title: Installation job
locker-tech-install-detail.summary: Site details, site photos and the start / submit button.

locker-tech-install-checklist.title: Commissioning steps
locker-tech-install-checklist.summary: Photos and confirmation for manual steps, controller binding, box tests and the lid.

locker-tech-profile.title: Technician profile
locker-tech-profile.summary: Change your photo, see shift figures, edit your details, switch language and log out.

admin-locker-maintenance-mode.title: Put a locker into maintenance
admin-locker-maintenance-mode.summary: Stop the whole locker from taking new orders and optionally create a fault ticket for the assigned technician.

admin-locker-maintenance-history.title: Locker repair & maintenance history
admin-locker-maintenance-history.summary: Every fault ticket and scheduled inspection of one locker on a single timeline.

admin-settings-simulation.title: Simulation & demo cluster
admin-settings-simulation.summary: Turn all simulation off for live operation and back on for demos — one button for every service.

admin-basics-intro.title: Welcome to the Lock.R admin console
admin-basics-intro.body: Here you track orders, lockers, drones, technicians and revenue. This guide walks through the parts you use most and takes about a minute.

admin-basics-sidebar.title: Main menu
admin-basics-sidebar.body: Every admin page lives here, grouped by area: Lockers & operations, Drones, Finance, Users… Use the arrow at the top of the menu to collapse it.

admin-basics-search.title: Quick search
admin-basics-search.body: Type a page name to open it right away without browsing the menu. Shortcut: Ctrl + K (⌘K on Mac).

admin-basics-notifications.title: Notifications
admin-basics-notifications.body: Refund requests, new tickets, drone incidents and more appear under this bell. The red number counts unread items.

admin-basics-language.title: Language
admin-basics-language.body: Switch between Vietnamese and English. Your choice is remembered.

admin-basics-guide.title: Reopen the guide
admin-basics-guide.body: Use this button at any time to replay the guide, pick the sections you want, or turn automatic guides on or off.

admin-dashboard-kpis.title: Key figures
admin-dashboard-kpis.body: Total orders, orders today, revenue (money actually collected) this month and today, with the change versus the previous period. Click a card to open the orders or payments behind the number.

admin-dashboard-trend.title: Monthly trend
admin-dashboard-trend.body: Blue bars are new orders and the green line is money collected for each month of the selected year. Hover a month for exact figures.

admin-dashboard-capacity.title: System overview
admin-dashboard-capacity.body: Box occupancy (available / in use / total), accounts, locations, kiosks, active kiosks and pending orders. Click any figure to open the matching list.

admin-dashboard-locations.title: Top locations
admin-dashboard-locations.body: Locations ranked by money collected and orders in the selected year. Click a row for the paid orders there, the name for the location page; "Detailed report" opens the Revenue page.

admin-orders-filters.title: Status, type and payment filters
admin-orders-filters.body: The "Status", "Order type" and "Payment" menus accept several values at once; a menu gets a bold border while it filters.

customer-home-intro.title: Welcome to Lock.R
customer-home-intro.body: Lock.R lets you send parcels through lockers, rent a box for your things and deliver by drone. Here are the main buttons.

customer-home-quick.title: Shortcuts
customer-home-quick.body: “Drop-off points” lists stores with lockers, “Rent a locker” opens the Lockers tab, “Locker orders” opens your orders, “Utilities” shows more services.

customer-home-scan.title: Scan at the kiosk
customer-home-scan.body: In front of a locker, tap here to scan the QR code on the kiosk screen: your account signs in on the kiosk so you can open your boxes.

customer-home-notifications.title: Notifications
customer-home-notifications.body: Pickup codes, pickup reminders and drone progress all arrive here. A red dot means unread messages.

customer-home-tabs.title: Navigation bar
customer-home-tabs.body: Switch between “Home”, “Lockers”, “Orders” and “Profile”. The bar hides while you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up.

customer-home-guide.title: Reopen the guide
customer-home-guide.body: Tap this button at any time to replay the guide or turn automatic guides on or off.

locker-tech-home-intro.title: Welcome, locker technician
locker-tech-home-intro.body: Here you take incident tickets, inspect lockers, run routine checks, manage IoT devices and recover dropped drone parcels for your lockers.

locker-tech-home-shift.title: Shift card
locker-tech-home-shift.body: Tap "Start shift" when you begin work to get nearby jobs (location access needed) and "End shift" when you stop. Tap the card for location details.

locker-tech-home-hud.title: Pending work
locker-tech-home-hud.body: "Pending" (unclaimed tickets), "In progress", "Routine" and "Stations". Tap a tile to jump to its tab.

locker-tech-home-tabs.title: Work tabs
locker-tech-home-tabs.body: "Inspect", "Incidents", "My work", "Routine", "IoT devices" and "Parcel recovery"; the number in brackets is the current workload. Swipe sideways to see them all.

locker-tech-home-guide.title: Reopen the guide
locker-tech-home-guide.body: Tap this button at any time to replay the guide or turn automatic guides on or off.

drone-tech-home-intro.title: Welcome, drone technician
drone-tech-home-intro.body: Here you collect parcels from senders, assign and load drones, launch and follow flights, handle incidents and maintain the fleet.

drone-tech-home-shift.title: Start and end shift
drone-tech-home-shift.body: Tap "Start shift" to begin your shift (location must be on); "End shift" ends it and also turns off pickup jobs. The locate button refreshes GPS; tap the card for GPS details and Google Maps.

drone-tech-home-hud.title: Quick work tiles
drone-tech-home-hud.body: "Pending" is unclaimed incidents, "Working" your tickets in progress, "Routine" maintenance schedules and "Fleet" the drones you are in charge of. Tap a tile to open its tab; a "… drones in flight" line shows while flights are airborne.

drone-tech-home-tabs.title: Work tabs
drone-tech-home-tabs.body: Dispatch, Fleet, Incidents, My work, Routine and Flight tools; the number in brackets is what is left to do. Swipe sideways to see them all and pull a list down to reload.

drone-tech-home-guide.title: Reopen the guide
drone-tech-home-guide.body: Tap this button at any time to replay the guide or turn automatic guides on or off.

admin-users-stats.title: User figures
admin-users-stats.body: Total users, active, disabled, new this month, email verified and terms accepted. Click a card (or the "customers" / "staff" links) to filter to that group.

admin-users-filters.title: Filter and search
admin-users-filters.body: The "Status" menu filters Active / Disabled with counts; the search box matches name, email, phone or role.

admin-lockers-filters.title: Search and filter
admin-lockers-filters.body: Search by cabinet name or code, filter by "Status", "Location" and "Technician" — "Unassigned" finds cabinets nobody looks after.

admin-lockers-list.title: Cabinet list
admin-lockers-list.body: Each row is a cabinet with its location and status; change page and rows per page at the bottom.

admin-drones-summary.title: Fleet status
admin-drones-summary.body: "Total", "Ready", "Charging", "Fault" cards — click one to show only that group.

admin-drones-add.title: Add drone
admin-drones-add.body: Register a new drone: code and home locker with a landing pad.

admin-drones-list.title: Each drone
admin-drones-list.body: Each card shows battery, locker, assigned technician (click to open their profile) and any fault.

admin-storage-stats.title: Storage overview
admin-storage-stats.body: Items in storage, still owing overtime fees and fully paid. Click a card to filter the list.

admin-storage-list.title: Items in storage
admin-storage-list.body: Each row: order, sender → receiver, when stored, who moved it, overtime fee and amount due.

admin-refunds-stats.title: Refund requests
admin-refunds-stats.body: Counts of pending, refunded, rejected and total requests. Click a card to filter by status (cards other than Pending open the History tab).

admin-refunds-tabs.title: Three work areas
admin-refunds-tabs.body: "Pending requests" to review, "Refund history" to look up, "Rules & verification guide" to check before sending a refund transfer.

customer-orders-scope.title: Two order tabs
customer-orders-scope.body: “My orders” are the ones you created, “Incoming” are parcels sent to you. The red number counts parcels waiting for you.

customer-orders-filters.title: Filter orders
customer-orders-filters.body: “All”, “Recent”, “In use”, “Completed”, “Rent a locker”, “Send parcel” and “Cancelled” when present; the number is the count.

customer-orders-list.title: Order list
customer-orders-list.body: Orders grouped by day; cards warn about overdue pickups, fees paused by a box fault or items moved to storage. Tap one for its PIN/QR, payment and delegation.

customer-profile-header.title: Your profile
customer-profile-header.body: Avatar, name and email. Tap the photo (camera icon) to take or pick a new one, then "Save profile photo"; tap your name to open your details.

customer-profile-refund.title: Refund bank account
customer-profile-refund.body: Add your bank and account number to receive money when an order is refunded.

customer-profile-guide.title: User guide
customer-profile-guide.body: Replay the on-screen guide any time, open the manual, and turn automatic guides on or off.

locker-tech-inspect-picker.title: Pick a locker
locker-tech-inspect-picker.body: Tap to open the locker list and choose the one to check; temporarily unavailable lockers show the reason.

locker-tech-inspect-locker.title: Locker status
locker-tech-inspect-locker.body: Name, code, address and status; whether the controller is online; reserved and occupied counts, STANDARD / XL cells and the "Your locker" badge.

locker-tech-inspect-report.title: Report a locker fault
locker-tech-inspect-report.body: Only after confirming a physical fault on site: enter a title, description, optional photos and optionally turn on "Block whole locker" to stop orders until the ticket is completed.

drone-tech-dispatch-weather.title: Weather at drone lockers
drone-tech-dispatch-weather.body: Shows which lockers can fly in the upcoming forecast window; lockers with rain, strong wind, no forecast or paused by an admin come first. Tap to expand, use reload to refresh.

drone-tech-dispatch-duty.title: Pickup jobs
drone-tech-dispatch-duty.body: Once on shift, turn the switch on to receive home-pickup invitations near you (location required; the app re-sends it every minute). While you have an invitation or unfinished job you get no more.

admin-maintenance-intro.title: Maintenance page
admin-maintenance-intro.body: Dispatch technicians to locker and drone incidents, watch SLA deadlines and plan preventive inspections. Ticket lists refresh every 15 seconds.

admin-maintenance-sync.title: Sync devices
admin-maintenance-sync.body: Click "Sync Devices" to reload tickets, faulty cells, locker heartbeats, the drone fleet and the technician list right away.

admin-maintenance-tabs.title: Three work areas
admin-maintenance-tabs.body: "Kiosk Incidents" and "Drone Incidents" (the number counts open + in-progress tickets), and "Schedules & Logs" for preventive checks.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-kpis.title: Kiosk ticket figures
admin-maintenance-kiosk-kpis.body: "Open Incidents", "New Reports" (waiting for a technician), "In Progress" and "Completed" — locker tickets only, drones excluded.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-overdue.title: SLA overdue alert
admin-maintenance-kiosk-overdue.body: Shown when tickets are past their SLA. Click "View SLA-Overdue Reports" to filter them and dispatch first.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-filters.title: Search and filter
admin-maintenance-kiosk-filters.body: Search by ticket code, title, locker, cell, reporter or phone; filter by technician (incl. "Unassigned (New)"), kiosk station and time, and pick a sort order (newest, priority, SLA due soonest, oldest).

admin-maintenance-kiosk-status.title: Filter by status
admin-maintenance-kiosk-status.body: Chips "All / New / In progress / SLA overdue / Done" with counts. While filtering, "Filtering:" lists each condition — click X to drop it; "Reset Filters" clears all.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-bulk.title: Select and delete
admin-maintenance-kiosk-bulk.body: Tick row boxes or "Select all … filtered report(s)", then "Delete … selected report(s)". "Delete all" removes every Kiosk ticket. Always confirmed and cannot be undone.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-list.title: Ticket list
admin-maintenance-kiosk-list.body: Newest tickets first; tickets waiting for a technician are highlighted. The yellow bar counts new tickets; "Show New Only" filters them.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-heartbeat.title: Kiosk device health
admin-maintenance-kiosk-heartbeat.body: Each locker controller shows "Online" or "Disconnected" from its latest heartbeat, with its locker and last report time.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-info.title: Ticket details
admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-info.body: Code, title, status, "Whole locker down", "From periodic inspection", "SLA Overdue" tags and the SLA countdown; locker, cell, reporter, address and photos. Click the technician to open their profile.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-log.title: Log
admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-log.body: Opens the handling record: ticket details, SLA times and every step the technician logged in the app (read-only).

admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-assign.title: Assign / Change technician
admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-assign.body: "Assign Technician" on new tickets, "Change Technician" while in progress — pick a locker technician and the ticket goes to their app.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-complete.title: Resolve
admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-complete.body: Close the ticket on the technician's behalf, optionally with a note and acceptance photos. The related cell / locker returns to service.

admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-delete.title: Delete ticket
admin-maintenance-kiosk-report-delete.body: The bin button permanently deletes this ticket after confirmation — only for duplicates or mistakes.

admin-maintenance-repair-log-open.title: Open the log
admin-maintenance-repair-log-open.body: Click "Log" on a ticket to see its full handling record.

admin-maintenance-repair-log-sections.title: Two sections
admin-maintenance-repair-log-sections.body: "Report Details": report, reporter photos, technician, assignment time, SLA deadline, handling time. "Technician Log": each repair step with photos.

admin-maintenance-repair-log-body.title: Read-only
admin-maintenance-repair-log-body.body: Admins read only; technicians add log entries and photos in the mobile app. Affected drone orders (if any) are listed at the top.

admin-maintenance-assign-open.title: Open assignment
admin-maintenance-assign-open.body: Click "Assign Technician" (or "Change Technician") on the ticket.

admin-maintenance-assign-summary.title: Ticket to assign
admin-maintenance-assign-summary.body: Code, title, description, locker and cell, to double-check before assigning.

admin-maintenance-assign-tech.title: Pick a technician
admin-maintenance-assign-tech.body: Only technicians of the right specialty (locker or drone) are listed; "[Suspended]" ones cannot be picked.

admin-maintenance-assign-confirm.title: Confirm
admin-maintenance-assign-confirm.body: "Confirm Assignment" hands over the ticket and notifies the technician's app.

admin-maintenance-resolve-open.title: Open resolve
admin-maintenance-resolve-open.body: Click "Complete" on an open or in-progress ticket.

admin-maintenance-resolve-note.title: Acceptance note
admin-maintenance-resolve-note.body: Optionally note what was done, e.g. lock latch replaced, open/close tested.

admin-maintenance-resolve-photos.title: Acceptance photos
admin-maintenance-resolve-photos.body: Optionally attach after-repair photos; they are saved to the ticket record.

admin-maintenance-resolve-confirm.title: Confirm
admin-maintenance-resolve-confirm.body: The ticket becomes "Completed"; the related cell, landing pad or locker returns to service.

admin-maintenance-drone-kpis.title: Drone ticket figures
admin-maintenance-drone-kpis.body: Open incidents, new tickets waiting for a drone technician, in progress and resolved.

admin-maintenance-drone-overdue.title: SLA overdue alert
admin-maintenance-drone-overdue.body: Shown when drone tickets are overdue; "View SLA-Overdue Reports" filters them.

admin-maintenance-drone-create.title: Create Drone Incident Report
admin-maintenance-drone-create.body: Opens a new ticket for a drone; the drone is put in fault status for drone technicians to take.

admin-maintenance-drone-filters.title: Search and filter
admin-maintenance-drone-filters.body: Search by ticket code, drone, fault, technician or phone; filter by drone technician, drone, time and choose the sort order.

admin-maintenance-drone-status.title: Filter by status
admin-maintenance-drone-status.body: All / New / In progress / SLA overdue / Done; active conditions show with an X to remove.

admin-maintenance-drone-bulk.title: Select and delete
admin-maintenance-drone-bulk.body: Select tickets then "Delete … selected report(s)", or "Delete all" drone tickets — confirmed, cannot be undone.

admin-maintenance-drone-list.title: Drone ticket list
admin-maintenance-drone-list.body: Emergency parcel-drop tickets are red, new tickets yellow. The yellow bar counts new tickets with an "Show New Only" button.

admin-maintenance-drone-report-info.title: Ticket details
admin-maintenance-drone-report-info.body: Code, status, SLA, drone and technician. Drop tickets carry an emergency tag, drop coordinates and "Order code" / "Drop incident code" links.

admin-maintenance-drone-report-dispatch.title: Dispatch technicians within radius R
admin-maintenance-drone-report-dispatch.body: Drop tickets only: opens the parcel-drop incident page to send the nearest technician to search.

admin-maintenance-drone-report-log.title: Log
admin-maintenance-drone-report-log.body: View the handling record and the steps drone technicians logged (read-only).

admin-maintenance-drone-report-assign.title: Assign drone technician
admin-maintenance-drone-report-assign.body: "Assign Drone Technician" on new tickets, "Change Technician" while in progress.

admin-maintenance-drone-report-complete.title: Resolve
admin-maintenance-drone-report-complete.body: Close the ticket with an optional note and acceptance photos.

admin-maintenance-drone-report-delete.title: Delete ticket
admin-maintenance-drone-report-delete.body: Permanently delete the ticket after confirmation.

admin-maintenance-create-drone-open.title: Open the form
admin-maintenance-create-drone-open.body: On the "Drone Incidents" tab, click "Create Drone Incident Report".

admin-maintenance-create-drone-drone.title: Affected drone
admin-maintenance-create-drone-drone.body: Pick the drone; the new ticket opens as pending and the drone goes into fault status.

admin-maintenance-create-drone-title.title: Incident title
admin-maintenance-create-drone-title.body: Summarise the fault, e.g. "Drone lost GPS".

admin-maintenance-create-drone-desc.title: Description and cause
admin-maintenance-create-drone-desc.body: Actual condition, when it was found and what the technician should check.

admin-maintenance-create-drone-photos.title: Site photos
admin-maintenance-create-drone-photos.body: Optional, up to 10 photos of the drone, battery, propellers or location.

admin-maintenance-create-drone-submit.title: Create Incident Report
admin-maintenance-create-drone-submit.body: Saves the ticket into the drone technicians' queue; the list switches to "New" so you see it.

admin-maintenance-fleet-filters.title: Search and battery filter
admin-maintenance-fleet-filters.body: Search by drone code, station, technician or fault; filter battery: low, 20–49%, ready from 50%.

admin-maintenance-fleet-status.title: Filter by status
admin-maintenance-fleet-status.body: "Needs attention" groups faulty, maintenance and low-battery drones; other chips filter Ready, Reserved, In flight, Charging, Maintenance, Fault.

admin-maintenance-fleet-card.title: Drone card
admin-maintenance-fleet-card.body: Code, station, status, battery bar and fault reason (if any). Drones needing attention are listed first.

admin-maintenance-fleet-detail.title: View details
admin-maintenance-fleet-detail.body: Opens the drone's operating info, maintenance history and resolved incidents.

admin-maintenance-drone-health-open.title: Open details
admin-maintenance-drone-health-open.body: Click "View Detail" on a drone card.

admin-maintenance-drone-health-ops.title: Operating info
admin-maintenance-drone-health-ops.body: Status, battery, station, assigned technician (click for profile), last charge, date added and recorded fault.

admin-maintenance-drone-health-history.title: Completed maintenance
admin-maintenance-drone-health-history.body: Recorded preventive checks: result, technician, note and photo count.

admin-maintenance-drone-health-resolved.title: Resolved incidents
admin-maintenance-drone-health-resolved.body: The drone's closed incident tickets with their resolution time.

admin-maintenance-schedules-subtabs.title: Kiosk / Drone section
admin-maintenance-schedules-subtabs.body: Switch between locker inspection plans and drone maintenance plans; the number counts plans.

admin-maintenance-schedules-kpis.title: Inspection figures
admin-maintenance-schedules-kpis.body: Lockers with a plan, due today, overdue and on-time rate.

admin-maintenance-schedules-form.title: New plan
admin-maintenance-schedules-form.body: Choose the locker (*), name (*), technician, interval in days (*), priority, position in the building, first date & time and time slot.

admin-maintenance-schedules-checklist.title: Inspection checklist
admin-maintenance-schedules-checklist.body: One item per line, graded Pass / Fail / N/A by the technician; click sample items to add or remove quickly.

admin-maintenance-schedules-create.title: Create the plan
admin-maintenance-schedules-create.body: Add SOP notes if needed, then click "Create Kiosk Plan"; it appears in the list and the technician's app.

admin-maintenance-schedules-filters.title: Search and filter plans
admin-maintenance-schedules-filters.body: Search by locker name, code or technician; filter by technician and status: overdue, due today, upcoming.

admin-maintenance-schedules-row.title: A plan
admin-maintenance-schedules-row.body: Name (click for details), priority, time left, last result, "Awaiting report RPT-…" after a failed check; location, slot, interval and technician — click the technician or "Unassigned (Assign now)" to assign.

admin-maintenance-schedules-actions.title: Plan actions
admin-maintenance-schedules-actions.body: "Assign Technician / Change Technician", "Details & History", "Record Inspection" (locked while a ticket is pending), the pen to edit and the bin to delete the plan.

admin-maintenance-schedules-drone-kpis.title: Drone maintenance figures
admin-maintenance-schedules-drone-kpis.body: Drones with a plan, due today, overdue and on-time rate.

admin-maintenance-schedules-drone-form.title: New drone plan
admin-maintenance-schedules-drone-form.body: Pick the drone, name, interval, technician, priority, start date & time, landing spot, slot, checklist and SOP. Note: creating a plan puts the drone "Under maintenance" until the first check PASSES.

admin-maintenance-schedules-drone-list.title: Drone plans
admin-maintenance-schedules-drone-list.body: Each row shows the landing pad from the linked locker, due date, technician and the same buttons as the Kiosk section.

admin-maintenance-history-asset.title: Kiosk or Drone
admin-maintenance-history-asset.body: Choose locker or drone fleet history.

admin-maintenance-history-list.title: Records
admin-maintenance-history-list.body: Newest first: device, completion time, owner, Pass / Fail result and notes. Incident records have a "Log" button.

admin-maintenance-inspect-place.title: Place and time
admin-maintenance-inspect-place.body: Device, location, position in the building, slot and record time.

admin-maintenance-inspect-tech.title: Technician
admin-maintenance-inspect-tech.body: Choose who did the check (admin records on their behalf); empty means the signed-in account.

admin-maintenance-inspect-result.title: Grade the result
admin-maintenance-inspect-result.body: Grade each checklist item Pass / Fail / N/A (one Fail ⇒ the check fails); plans without a checklist take a single Pass or Fail.

admin-maintenance-inspect-note.title: Notes
admin-maintenance-inspect-note.body: Describe the work done and the on-site condition.

admin-maintenance-inspect-photos.title: Evidence photos
admin-maintenance-inspect-photos.body: Paste photo links, one per line.

admin-maintenance-inspect-fail.title: When it fails
admin-maintenance-inspect-fail.body: An incident ticket opens automatically (drone plans: the drone goes to Fault). You can pick the faulty cell on the locker map and add a reason; the next due date moves only after the ticket closes.

admin-maintenance-inspect-save.title: Save the record
admin-maintenance-inspect-save.body: "Save Inspection Record" once every item is graded; it goes to history and the plan moves to its next due date.

admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-open.title: Open details
admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-open.body: Click "Details & History" or the plan name.

admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-params.title: Key data
admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-params.body: Device, repeat interval, next due date and technician.

admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-locati.title: Location
admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-locati.body: Locker or landing pad address, building, position, recommended slot and a "Directions in Google Maps" button.

admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-checkl.title: SOP and checklist
admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-checkl.body: Procedure notes and the standard items to check.

admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-histor.title: Inspection history
admin-maintenance-schedule-detail-histor.body: Each check: item results, technician, notes, photos and the ticket opened on failure. Drone plans also list resolved drone incidents.

admin-maintenance-schedule-assign-open.title: Open assignment
admin-maintenance-schedule-assign-open.body: Click "Assign Technician" or "Change Technician" on the plan.

admin-maintenance-schedule-assign-summar.title: Plan
admin-maintenance-schedule-assign-summar.body: Plan name, device, work address, position, due date & slot, interval.

admin-maintenance-schedule-assign-tech.title: Pick a technician
admin-maintenance-schedule-assign-tech.body: Choose a technician of the right specialty, or "Unassigned" to clear. The plan syncs to their app.

admin-maintenance-schedule-edit-open.title: Open edit
admin-maintenance-schedule-edit-open.body: Click the pen button on the plan.

admin-maintenance-schedule-edit-fields.title: Plan fields
admin-maintenance-schedule-edit-fields.body: Name, interval (days), priority, next due date and time (Vietnam time), slot and position. Use "Change Technician" to switch technician.

admin-maintenance-schedule-edit-checklis.title: Checklist and SOP
admin-maintenance-schedule-edit-checklis.body: One checklist item per line; edit the technician guidance just below.

admin-maintenance-schedule-edit-save.title: Save changes
admin-maintenance-schedule-edit-save.body: Click "Save changes"; plans waiting on a ticket move their due date when it closes.

admin-drones-filters.title: Status chips
admin-drones-filters.body: Filter All, Ready, Charging, Reserved, In flight, Maintenance, Fault; kept in the URL so coming back from details keeps it.

admin-drones-refresh.title: Refresh
admin-drones-refresh.body: Reload the latest battery and status of the fleet.

admin-drones-batch.title: Delete several drones
admin-drones-batch.body: Tick cards then "Delete selected", or "Delete all (n)" in the filter; a reason is required. Reserved or flying drones cannot be deleted.

admin-drones-actions.title: Card buttons
admin-drones-actions.body: "Detail" opens the drone record; "Maintenance" / "Activate" switches status (reason required, locked while flying or faulty); "Delete" retires the drone with a reason.

admin-drones-form-code.title: Drone code
admin-drones-form-code.body: Enter a unique code (auto upper-case), e.g. DRONE-01.

admin-drones-form-locker.title: Home locker (landing pad)
admin-drones-form-locker.body: Only lockers with a landing pad are listed; configure a landing pad first if none.

admin-drones-form-submit.title: Create
admin-drones-form-submit.body: Click "Create" to add the drone; assign a technician on its detail page.

admin-drone-detail-header.title: Header
admin-drone-detail-header.body: Drone code, status, current station and whether it is operating; the arrow goes back, "Refresh" reloads everything.

admin-drone-detail-fault.title: Issue to fix
admin-drone-detail-fault.body: Shown when the drone has a recorded fault.

admin-drone-detail-tech.title: Assigned technician
admin-drone-detail-tech.body: Pick a drone technician and "Save": new incident tickets go to them only. "Unassigned" notifies all drone technicians.

admin-drone-detail-station.title: Drone station
admin-drone-detail-station.body: Pick a landing-pad locker and "Save" to move the drone; locked during a mission.

admin-drone-detail-info.title: System info
admin-drone-detail-info.body: Last charge, system ID, created and updated time, mission status.

admin-drone-detail-rename.title: Rename
admin-drone-detail-rename.body: Edit the code and click "Rename" (confirmed); technician apps and the drone must use the new code.

admin-drone-detail-battery.title: Record battery
admin-drone-detail-battery.body: Enter 0–100% and "Update Battery"; 100% also records the last charge time.

admin-drone-detail-decommission.title: Delete drone
admin-drone-detail-decommission.body: Retire the drone with a reason: removes the technician and controller, keeps logs. Locked in flight. Every action is logged.

admin-drone-detail-hardware-header.title: Hardware block
admin-drone-detail-hardware-header.body: "Refresh" re-reads the device status; "Remove controller" detaches the Pi from the drone.

admin-drone-detail-hardware-devices.title: Three units
admin-drone-detail-hardware-devices.body: Raspberry Pi (MAC, IP, last update), Pixhawk (flight mode, motors, GPS, satellites) and power (battery, voltage, current).

admin-drone-detail-hardware-camera.title: Live camera
admin-drone-detail-hardware-camera.body: Watch the drone camera; with a stream: reload, open in a new tab, enlarge. Without one the reason is shown (camera service off or Pi offline).

admin-drone-detail-hardware-assign.title: Assign Pi controller
admin-drone-detail-hardware-assign.body: When no controller is attached: choose a discovered Pi or type its IP; port 8080 is checked and duplicates are blocked.

admin-drone-detail-logs-tabs.title: Four log tabs
admin-drone-detail-logs-tabs.body: "IoT Logs", "Flight log", "Incidents & Repairs" and "Actions" (assignment, station, battery, retirement).

admin-drone-detail-logs-banner.title: Connection status
admin-drone-detail-logs-banner.body: Whether the drone is online, controller IP, MAVLink and last seen time.

admin-drone-detail-logs-filters.title: Filter IoT log
admin-drone-detail-logs-filters.body: Search message, order, technician, error, IP, MAC; filter component, event, result; "Reset filters" when filtering.

admin-drone-detail-logs-table.title: Event table
admin-drone-detail-logs-table.body: Time, component, event, result, actor and the full message.

admin-drone-detail-flights-tab.title: Flight log
admin-drone-detail-flights-tab.body: On the drone record, click this tab in the operation log block.

admin-drone-detail-flights-list.title: Flight list
admin-drone-detail-flights-list.body: Mission code, order, route, status and dispatcher; flights with an incident link to "View incident".

admin-drone-detail-reports-tab.title: Incidents & repairs
admin-drone-detail-reports-tab.body: On the drone record, click this tab in the operation log block.

admin-drone-detail-reports-list.title: Ticket list
admin-drone-detail-reports-list.body: Code, category, status, technician, description and time.

admin-drone-detail-operations-tab.title: Admin operations
admin-drone-detail-operations-tab.body: On the drone record, click this tab in the operation log block.

admin-drone-detail-operations-list.title: Operation log
admin-drone-detail-operations-list.body: Time, actor and content: assignment, station, rename, battery, status change, controller assignment.

admin-drone-orders-weather.title: Weather at drone lockers
admin-drone-orders-weather.body: Which lockers can fly in the next 30 minutes; click to expand each. "Flight control" opens the suspension page, the round button refreshes.

admin-drone-orders-stats.title: Count cards
admin-drone-orders-stats.body: "In Progress", "Awaiting Dispatch", "In Flight", "Finished" — click a card to see exactly those orders.

admin-drone-orders-refresh.title: Refresh
admin-drone-orders-refresh.body: Reload the list now (it also refreshes on its own).

admin-drone-orders-scopes.title: Order groups
admin-drone-orders-scopes.body: "In Progress" (incl. closed orders awaiting parcel return), "Finished", "All". The selected card chip can be cleared.

admin-drone-orders-list.title: Journey list
admin-drone-orders-list.body: Order code, route, stage, drone, dispatcher, payment, created and updated time. Click a row for details; dropped parcels show "Handle parcel drop incident →".

admin-drone-order-detail-back.title: Back to list
admin-drone-order-detail-back.body: "Drone journeys" returns to the group you were viewing.

admin-drone-order-detail-title.title: Order and current stage
admin-drone-order-detail-title.body: Order code and current stage; the page refreshes every 3 seconds.

admin-drone-order-detail-pickup.title: Home pickup
admin-drone-order-detail-pickup.body: Pickup status, address (open map), technician and distance, accept / pickup times, parcel photo. While searching you can pick a technician and "Assign technician".

admin-drone-order-detail-weather.title: Route weather
admin-drone-order-detail-weather.body: Next-30-minute forecast on the route: wind, gusts, rain and whether flying is safe.

admin-drone-order-detail-map.title: Tracking map
admin-drone-order-detail-map.body: Sending and receiving lockers, live drone position and the path flown.

admin-drone-order-detail-track.title: Flight position log
admin-drone-order-detail-track.body: Saved GPS points (newest first): coordinates, altitude, speed, battery; downloadable as CSV.

admin-drone-order-detail-camera.title: Live camera
admin-drone-order-detail-camera.body: The drone's real camera stream in flight; with reconnect and "Report Parcel Drop" with a snapshot.

admin-drone-order-detail-close.title: Confirm failed delivery
admin-drone-order-detail-close.body: When a paid order cannot be delivered: pick a reason, add a note and confirm to close it and start the refund.

admin-drone-order-records-drop.title: Parcel drop
admin-drone-order-records-drop.body: Shown when a drop is reported: recovery status, search technician, coordinates and "View incident details".

admin-drone-order-records-return.title: Parcel to return
admin-drone-order-records-return.body: Undeliverable order: the parcel is in the sending cell or with the flight team; add a note then "Confirm parcel returned".

admin-drone-order-records-route.title: Route
admin-drone-order-records-route.body: Sending and receiving lockers, reserved cell, send / arrival / code / pickup times and "View on map".

admin-drone-order-records-progress.title: Delivery progress
admin-drone-order-records-progress.body: Stages from order to pickup, the current one highlighted.

admin-drone-order-records-order.title: Order
admin-drone-order-records-order.body: Status, payment, fee, method, reference and transaction, weight, category, size, declared value, distance, flight mode.

admin-drone-order-records-people.title: People
admin-drone-order-records-people.body: Sender, receiver (name, phone, email), dispatcher and loader.

admin-drone-order-records-mission.title: Mission & loading
admin-drone-order-records-mission.body: Mission ID, drone, current position, actual weight, seal, loading checklist, launch battery, landing and deposit times.

admin-drone-order-records-log.title: Journey log
admin-drone-order-records-log.body: Each milestone (newest first) with note, time, actor and location.

admin-flight-control-global.title: Suspend all flights
admin-flight-control-global.body: Turn on for a flight ban or widespread bad weather: no new drone orders, no launches. Confirmed first.

admin-flight-control-weather.title: Weather check
admin-flight-control-weather.body: On: bookings, launches and auto station stops follow the weather limits. Turn off only for testing and remember to turn it back on.

admin-flight-control-summary.title: Blocks in 24 hours
admin-flight-control-summary.body: Counted by cause: unsafe weather, no forecast, system suspension, station suspended.

admin-flight-control-stations.title: Flight stations
admin-flight-control-stations.body: Each landing-pad locker: current weather, suspension (who, since, until) and blocks in 24 hours.

admin-flight-control-station.title: Suspend / resume station
admin-flight-control-station.body: "Pause station": choose a reason, note and optional auto-resume time. "Resume station" when suspended, with a note.

admin-flight-control-blocks-filters.title: Filter history
admin-flight-control-blocks-filters.body: Filter by cause, blocked step, order code and date range; the round button refreshes.

admin-flight-control-blocks-table.title: Block table
admin-flight-control-blocks-table.body: Time, cause, step, order (click for the journey), route, suspended station and wind / rain details. Paginated.

admin-flight-control-logs-table.title: Log table
admin-flight-control-logs-table.body: Time, station, Suspend / Resume, reason with note, auto-resume time and actor.

admin-flight-control-rules-panel.title: Flight rules
admin-flight-control-rules-panel.body: Edit each rule and save — applies at once to bookings, launches and the weather board. You can restore defaults and view change history.

admin-drone-incidents-stats.title: Count cards
admin-drone-incidents-stats.body: "Open", "Recovering", "Awaiting Verification", "Completed" — click to filter that group.

admin-drone-incidents-filters.title: Filter and refresh
admin-drone-incidents-filters.body: Filter by incident status (with counts); when opened from an order a chip "Order …" appears — click X to clear. "Refresh" reloads.

admin-drone-incidents-list.title: Incident list
admin-drone-incidents-list.body: Code, order (click to open) and drone, search technician, incident / recovery / inspection status, last update and "Details".

admin-drone-incident-detail-header.title: Header
admin-drone-incident-detail-header.body: Incident code, drop time, three statuses (incident, recovery, parcel) and refresh; back to the list.

admin-drone-incident-detail-kpis.title: Four key cards
admin-drone-incident-detail-kpis.body: Drop location & drone (open OpenStreetMap), search technician, parcel & hub (confirm the drone returned), compensation.

admin-drone-incident-detail-order.title: Order information
admin-drone-incident-detail-order.body: Sender, receiver, lockers, parcel, weight, fee and payment of the affected order.

admin-drone-incident-detail-tech.title: Technician on the job
admin-drone-incident-detail-tech.body: Once accepted: name, phone, specialty, recovery status. When results come in use "Approve the technician's search result", then "Confirm parcel is at …".

admin-drone-incident-detail-dispatch.title: Search dispatch
admin-drone-incident-detail-dispatch.body: Before anyone accepts: a map of technicians near the drop point — click one to assign; reassign while they have not accepted.

admin-drone-incident-resolution-field.title: Field report
admin-drone-incident-resolution-field.body: Search result, parcel condition, technician note, GPS comparison and evidence photos.

admin-drone-incident-resolution-timeline.title: Timeline
admin-drone-incident-resolution-timeline.body: Every event from the drop report to closing.

admin-drone-incident-resolution-policy.title: Compensation policy
admin-drone-incident-resolution-policy.body: Rate, cap, parcel value, suggested amount, free redelivery, shipping refund, SLA and whether approval is needed.

admin-drone-incident-resolution-proposal.title: Propose a resolution
admin-drone-incident-resolution-proposal.body: Pick the type, amount, shipping refund and reason, then "Send resolution plan to customer". Then follow the redelivery or approve the payout.

admin-drone-incident-resolution-history.title: Proposal history
admin-drone-incident-resolution-history.body: Versions sent, amounts and customer responses.

admin-drone-logs-header.title: Communication log
admin-drone-logs-header.body: The table refreshes every 5 seconds; "Refresh" reloads now.

admin-drone-logs-lid.title: ArUco lid test
admin-drone-logs-lid.body: Turn on to test: when the camera sees a listed ArUco marker the cell lid really opens for a few seconds, no order needed. Real motor — always stay by the locker.

admin-drone-logs-filters.title: Filter messages
admin-drone-logs-filters.body: Filter by order ID, drone code, event type and processing status.

admin-drone-logs-table.title: Message list
admin-drone-logs-table.body: Time, sender (click to open locker / drone) and receiver, event, message, status. Paginated with page size.

admin-drone-logs-expand.title: Expand / collapse all
admin-drone-logs-expand.body: Messages are grouped by order; open or close every group.

admin-drone-logs-group.title: Grouped by order
admin-drone-logs-group.body: Group row: order (click to open), drone, locker, message and error counts, latest event. Click to expand.

admin-orders-search.title: Search orders
admin-orders-search.body: Type an order code, phone number or recipient name; the list filters once you stop typing.

admin-orders-sort.title: Sort
admin-orders-sort.body: Pick an order: newest first, recently updated, amount high → low, recently paid, recently completed…

admin-orders-dates.title: Date range
admin-orders-dates.body: Pick a from–to range or a quick preset such as Today, 7 days or This month; "All time" removes the limit. Filters by order creation time.

admin-orders-toolbar.title: Clear and reload
admin-orders-toolbar.body: "Clear filters" resets every filter; "Reload" fetches the latest data.

admin-orders-first-row.title: Open an order
admin-orders-first-row.body: Click a row to open the full order. Each row shows the code, type, creation time, sender → recipient, status · payment, locker / box and total (with any amount still due).

admin-orders-row-menu.title: Row menu
admin-orders-row-menu.body: The "…" button offers "View Detail" and "Update Status" — the latter only while the order can still be changed by hand (initialized, storing, awaiting dispatch).

admin-orders-table.title: Table and paging
admin-orders-table.body: The number of matching orders is shown just above the table. At the bottom, choose rows per page and move between pages.

admin-order-detail-header.title: Order header
admin-order-detail-header.body: The order code customers and staff read to each other, plus the internal id and creation time. The arrow goes back to the list.

admin-order-detail-update.title: Update status
admin-order-detail-update.body: Only shown while the order can still be changed by hand. Opens a dialog with the valid next steps; every change is logged in the history.

admin-order-detail-band.title: Status strip
admin-order-detail-band.body: Status, order type, payment and drone stage; plus a parcel-drop incident alert or "Overtime fee charged" when relevant, and the last update time.

admin-order-detail-info.title: Order information
admin-order-detail-info.body: The same rows the customer sees in the app, by order type: rentals show rental hours, rental end and when items were placed; deliveries show hold time, the receiver pickup deadline and when the sender dropped off; drone orders show the pickup deadline at the receiving locker, the sending locker and flight distance. Extra rows (completed, last reminder…) appear only when set, plus delegate, overdue fee, incidents and customer milestones.

admin-order-detail-fees.title: Fee breakdown
admin-order-detail-fees.body: Charges actually applied (original price, storage, shipping, overdue fee), discount, loyalty points used and the total; zero amounts are hidden. Plus the promotion codes applied.

admin-order-detail-parcel.title: Parcel & notes
admin-order-detail-parcel.body: The customer's parcel declaration, extra items, customer / staff notes, next action (while the order is open) and cancel reason. Hidden when there is nothing to show.

admin-order-detail-history.title: Status history
admin-order-detail-history.body: Every status change: from → to, time, who did it, note and location (drone orders). Only what actually happened is listed.

admin-order-detail-side-customer.title: Customer
admin-order-detail-side-customer.body: The sender (renter for rentals) — name, phone, email, account status — and the recipient (not for rentals); if the recipient has a Lock.R account, that account is shown too.

admin-order-detail-side-locker.title: Locker & box
admin-order-detail-side-locker.body: The locker, address and box of the order: deliveries use one box (the sender drops off and the receiver picks up from the same box), rentals show the rented box; plus store and contact phone. Expired orders show when the item went to storage plus "Open stored items list"; handed-over orders show the "Handover record".

admin-order-detail-side-code.title: Pickup code
admin-order-detail-side-code.body: The PIN and QR code the customer uses at the locker, who holds the code (recipient, renter or delegate) and whether it still opens the box.

admin-order-detail-side-payment.title: Payment
admin-order-detail-side-payment.body: Payment status, order total, paid, still due, refunded, payment time, number of payments and the latest method.

admin-order-detail-side-transactions.title: Payments
admin-order-detail-side-transactions.body: Each payment attempt (Attempt 1, 2…): status, method, amount, payment reference, bank transaction id and transfer content.

admin-order-detail-side-refunds.title: Order refunds
admin-order-detail-side-refunds.body: Each refund ticket: amount, status, reason, transaction id, request and processing time. Tickets are approved on the Refunds page.

admin-order-detail-drone-fees.title: Drone order fees
admin-order-detail-drone-fees.body: Drone fee, weight surcharge, promotion, points used, amount paid and amount still due — matching the customer's screen.

admin-order-detail-drone-parcel.title: Drone parcel
admin-order-detail-drone-parcel.body: Declared and measured weight, category, size, declared value, flight distance, flight mode, seal code, loading note and cancel reason.

admin-order-detail-drone-pickup.title: Sender & home pickup
admin-order-detail-drone-pickup.body: The sender on the order; for home pickup: status, address, coordinates, assigned technician, accept / pickup times, parcel photo and failure reason.

admin-order-detail-drone-locker.title: Receiving locker
admin-order-detail-drone-locker.body: Drone orders are delivered into a locker only: the receiving locker, its address and box; there is no send box.

admin-order-detail-drone-home-code.title: Home pickup code
admin-order-detail-drone-home-code.body: The code the sender reads to the technician at home pickup; once the technician has the parcel it shows as used.

admin-order-detail-drone-pay-codes.title: Payment codes
admin-order-detail-drone-pay-codes.body: Method, paid time, Lock.R reference and bank transaction id of the latest successful payment — for reconciling with the customer.

admin-order-detail-drone-flight.title: Drone flight
admin-order-detail-drone-flight.body: Delivery stage, mission status, drone code, auto or manual dispatch, source – destination locker, ready / launch times and current position. "View drone journey" opens the tracking map.

admin-order-status-open.title: Open the dialog
admin-order-status-open.body: On the order page, click "Update Status". The button is hidden for completed, canceled or stored orders (stored items are handed over on the Storage page).

admin-order-status-current.title: Current status
admin-order-status-current.body: The dialog shows the order code and its current status; the change is logged in the history with your name.

admin-order-status-new.title: Pick the new status
admin-order-status-new.body: Only valid steps are offered: storing → completed or expired (move to storage); initialized / awaiting dispatch → canceled. The amber hint explains the effect (box released, PIN revoked, discount returned…).

admin-order-status-actions.title: Save
admin-order-status-actions.body: "Update" saves at once, "Close" discards. Canceling does not refund automatically — handle that on the Refunds page.

admin-users-toolbar.title: Add a user
admin-users-toolbar.body: "Add User" opens the account form; "Clear filters" removes every filter; "Reload" refreshes the list.

admin-users-segment.title: Current group
admin-users-segment.body: After clicking a figure card, this line shows the group being filtered and its size; "Show all" clears it.

admin-users-batch.title: Bulk delete
admin-users-batch.body: Tick the boxes at the start of rows, click "Delete selected" and enter a reason. Your own account cannot be selected; deleted accounts can no longer sign in.

admin-users-first-row.title: Open a profile
admin-users-first-row.body: Click a row to open the user's details. The table shows phone, roles, sign-in method, email verification and creation date; paging is at the bottom.

admin-users-switch.title: Lock / unlock
admin-users-switch.body: Flip the switch between Active and Disabled; a disabled account cannot sign in but keeps its data.

admin-users-row-menu.title: Row menu
admin-users-row-menu.body: The "…" button: "View Detail" and "Delete" (reason required). To only block sign-in, flip the switch instead of deleting.

admin-users-create-name.title: First and last name
admin-users-create-name.body: The first name is required, the last name is optional.

admin-users-create-email.title: Email
admin-users-create-email.body: Required and unique; used to sign in.

admin-users-create-password.title: Password
admin-users-create-password.body: At least 6 characters. Click the eye icon to show or hide what you type.

admin-users-create-roles.title: Roles
admin-users-create-roles.body: Click to toggle each role: Customer, Administrator, Drone technician, Locker technician; several can be chosen.

admin-users-create-enabled.title: Activate account
admin-users-create-enabled.body: On means the account can sign in right away; turn it off to create now and enable later.

admin-users-create-actions.title: Create user
admin-users-create-actions.body: Click "Create User" to save. Missing or invalid fields turn red below the field; a duplicate email / phone is named explicitly.

admin-user-detail-header.title: Header
admin-user-detail-header.body: Title and user id; the arrow goes back to the list.

admin-user-detail-actions.title: Actions
admin-user-detail-actions.body: "Technician profile" (technicians only) opens their page; the badge shows Active / Locked. While you edit, this area turns into "Cancel" and "Save changes".

admin-user-detail-avatar.title: Avatar
admin-user-detail-avatar.body: "Change photo" uploads and saves a new picture at once; "Remove photo" removes the current one (after confirming).

admin-user-detail-profile.title: Personal information
admin-user-detail-profile.body: Edit the name, email and phone, then click "Save changes" and confirm. Sign-in method, birthday and email verification are read-only.

admin-user-detail-roles.title: Roles
admin-user-detail-roles.body: The roles this account holds: customer, administrator, locker technician, drone technician.

admin-user-detail-account.title: Account information
admin-user-detail-account.body: Status, user id, whether a password is set (Google / OTP accounts may not have one), last sign-in, created and updated dates.

admin-user-detail-terms.title: Terms of service
admin-user-detail-terms.body: Customers only: whether they accepted, when, and which terms version.

admin-user-detail-stats.title: Quick figures
admin-user-detail-stats.body: Orders and total spending over the last 12 months (money actually collected) and current loyalty points.

admin-user-tab-orders-tabs.title: Activity tabs
admin-user-tab-orders-tabs.body: Orders placed, orders received, payments, refunds, loyalty points, reviews, incident reports, notifications and AI assistant. The open tab is kept in the page address, so coming back lands in the same place.

admin-user-tab-orders-panel.title: Orders placed
admin-user-tab-orders-panel.body: Orders this user created, newest first: code (click to open), type, status, payment, amount and date. The "Orders received" tab lists orders where they are the recipient.

admin-user-tab-payments-tab.title: Payments tab
admin-user-tab-payments-tab.body: Click to see the user's transactions.

admin-user-tab-payments-panel.title: Transactions
admin-user-tab-payments-panel.body: Click a payment code to open its details, click an order code to open the order; method, amount and status are shown. The "Refunds" tab next to it lists this user's refund tickets.

admin-user-tab-loyalty-tab.title: Loyalty tab
admin-user-tab-loyalty-tab.body: Click to view and adjust the user's points.

admin-user-tab-loyalty-summary.title: Loyalty summary
admin-user-tab-loyalty-summary.body: Membership tier, current points, lifetime points (the basis for tiers) and stamps.

admin-user-tab-loyalty-adjust.title: Adjust points
admin-user-tab-loyalty-adjust.body: Enter the points, choose add or deduct, then confirm. You cannot deduct more than the current balance; the entry is recorded as an adjustment.

admin-user-tab-loyalty-history.title: Points history
admin-user-tab-loyalty-history.body: Type (earned from order, used on order, voucher exchange, adjustment…), points +/−, related order and time; 10 rows per page.

admin-user-tab-assistant-tab.title: AI assistant tab
admin-user-tab-assistant-tab.body: Click to see the user's assistant conversations.

admin-user-tab-assistant-panel.title: Assistant conversations
admin-user-tab-assistant-panel.body: One row per conversation: title, message count and last update. Click the conversation code to read it in full in the side panel.

admin-payments-links.title: Shortcuts
admin-payments-links.body: "Refunds" opens the refund review page; "View Revenue Analytics" opens the Revenue page.

admin-payments-range.title: Statistics range
admin-payments-range.body: Pick a range or quick preset for the cards below; the note on the right names the comparison period.

admin-payments-cards.title: Figure cards
admin-payments-cards.body: Total, successful, pending and failed transactions, success rate, refunds and net collected — with % change. Click a card to filter the table; Refunds / Net collected open the list of entries.

admin-payments-breakdown.title: By status / method
admin-payments-breakdown.body: Count and amount per status and per method (SePay transfer, cash, legacy methods). Click a row to filter the table.

admin-payments-list-filters.title: Search and filter
admin-payments-list-filters.body: Search by reference, description, transaction id or order code; filter by status and method and choose the sort order.

admin-payments-list-dates.title: Date range
admin-payments-list-dates.body: Filters by transaction creation time; use a preset or "All time".

admin-payments-list-toolbar.title: Clear and reload
admin-payments-list-toolbar.body: "Clear filters" resets the filters; "Reload" fetches the latest transactions.

admin-payments-list-first-row.title: Open a transaction
admin-payments-list-first-row.body: Click a row to open its details. Each row has the reference (matches the payment gateway), customer, order (click to open), amount and refunded part, method, status, created and paid time.

admin-payments-list-table.title: Table, row menu and paging
admin-payments-list-table.body: The "…" button at the end of each row (scroll the table sideways on narrow screens) offers "View Detail" and "Open Order". The number of matching transactions is shown above the table; at the bottom choose rows per page and move between pages.

admin-payment-detail-summary.title: Summary
admin-payment-detail-summary.body: Amount, status, method and kind; customer, created / paid / updated time, refunded amount, reference, gateway transaction id and content.

admin-payment-detail-order.title: Related order
admin-payment-detail-order.body: Code, order and payment status, type, total and creation time; "Open order" goes to the order page.

admin-payment-detail-refunds.title: Refunds
admin-payment-detail-refunds.body: Refunds of this transaction: status, amount, reason, refund transaction id and who processed it. Creating a refund does not change the transaction status.

admin-payment-detail-others.title: Other payments of the order
admin-payment-detail-others.body: Other payment attempts of the same order, e.g. an earlier failed one.

admin-payment-detail-status.title: Update status
admin-payment-detail-status.body: Pick a status and click "Save status". Locked once a transaction has succeeded, failed or been refunded — to give money back, use Refunds.

admin-refunds-header.title: Shortcuts
admin-refunds-header.body: "Refund rules" opens the rules in a dialog; "Payment Management" goes to the Payments page.

admin-refunds-check-rules.title: Check the rules
admin-refunds-check-rules.body: Opens the rules next to the list so you can check the refund conditions before approving.

admin-refunds-status.title: Status filter
admin-refunds-status.body: All, Pending (with count), Refunded, Rejected; the list refreshes itself every 5 seconds.

admin-refunds-dates.title: Date range
admin-refunds-dates.body: Filters by refund request time; leave empty for all time.

admin-refunds-first-row.title: Refund ticket
admin-refunds-first-row.body: Each row: ticket code (click for details) and payment, customer, order (click to open), refund vs. paid amount, receiving account, status and time. The red "Incident compensation" tag marks compensation for a dropped drone parcel.

admin-refunds-actions.title: Approve or reject
admin-refunds-actions.body: "Detail" opens the ticket; for pending ones, "Approve & Transfer" opens the transfer screen with a VietQR code and receipt upload, "Reject" needs a reason.

admin-refunds-history-tab.title: History tab
admin-refunds-history-tab.body: Click to see processed tickets; the number in brackets is refunded plus rejected.

admin-refunds-history-alert.title: Pending reminder
admin-refunds-history-alert.body: While requests are waiting, an amber banner shows at the top; "Process now" returns to the pending tab.

admin-refunds-history-list.title: History list
admin-refunds-history-list.body: Same status and date filters; refunded tickets show the bank transfer reference, rejected ones the reason. Click the ticket code or "Detail" to see the receipt.

admin-refunds-rules-tab.title: Rules tab
admin-refunds-rules-tab.body: Click to open the checklist; the "Refund rules" button at the top opens it too.

admin-refunds-rules-steps.title: Four-step procedure
admin-refunds-rules-steps.body: Check the account → scan VietQR and transfer → upload the proof image → confirm the refund.

admin-refunds-rules-scenarios.title: Refund scenarios
admin-refunds-rules-scenarios.body: Each scenario shows its refund rate; click it to see the conditions, required evidence and what the admin must check.

admin-refund-detail-info.title: Ticket information
admin-refund-detail-info.body: Status, order code, refund transaction id, customer, amount, receiving bank, account number and holder, transfer reference, rejection reason, request and processing time.

admin-refund-detail-reason.title: Original reason
admin-refund-detail-reason.body: What the customer wrote when requesting; compensation for a dropped parcel has its own tag.

admin-refund-detail-customer-proof.title: Customer's photo
admin-refund-detail-customer-proof.body: The proof photo the customer attached (if any); click "Enlarge" or the photo to view it large.

admin-refund-detail-transfer-proof.title: Transfer receipt
admin-refund-detail-transfer-proof.body: The image the admin uploaded when approving; "Open original" opens it in a new tab.

admin-refund-approve-account.title: Receiving account
admin-refund-approve-account.body: Bank, account number and holder; each has a copy button.

admin-refund-approve-order.title: Order & reason
admin-refund-approve-order.body: The order to refund (click to open), amount paid, requested amount (copyable), reason and the customer's photo.

admin-refund-approve-ref.title: Transfer reference
admin-refund-approve-ref.body: Enter the bank transfer reference; required if the system setting says so.

admin-refund-approve-proof.title: Proof image
admin-refund-approve-proof.body: Required: upload the receipt; preview it, change or remove it before confirming.

admin-refund-approve-qr.title: VietQR code
admin-refund-approve-qr.body: Scan it with a banking app to prefill the account, amount and content (HOANTIEN + order code, or BOITHUONG + incident code); content and amount can be copied.

admin-refund-approve-warning.title: Note
admin-refund-approve-warning.body: Confirming marks the order as refunded and notifies the customer with the image.

admin-refund-approve-actions.title: Confirm transfer
admin-refund-approve-actions.body: The button only enables once a proof image (and reference, if required) is provided; "Cancel" closes.

admin-refund-reject-info.title: Ticket being rejected
admin-refund-reject-info.body: Ticket code and requested amount; below are the customer's reason and photo (if any).

admin-refund-reject-reason.title: Rejection reason
admin-refund-reject-reason.body: Required — the customer receives it in a notification.

admin-refund-reject-actions.title: Confirm rejection
admin-refund-reject-actions.body: "Confirm rejection" closes the ticket; "Cancel" goes back.

admin-revenue-reconcile.title: Reconcile transactions
admin-revenue-reconcile.body: Go to the Payments page to check individual transactions.

admin-revenue-range.title: Date range
admin-revenue-range.body: Every card and tab uses this range (366 days max); the comparison period is shown on the right.

admin-revenue-kpis.title: Overview cards
admin-revenue-kpis.body: Period revenue, net after refunds, refunds, average order value, new orders and paid orders — with % vs. the previous period. Click a card to see the entries or orders behind it.

admin-revenue-quick.title: Quick periods
admin-revenue-quick.body: Today, This week and This month revenue regardless of the selected range; click to see the entries.

admin-revenue-chart.title: Daily revenue
admin-revenue-chart.body: Lines for money collected and net after refunds per day; "Show table" switches to numbers, "Show chart" switches back.

admin-revenue-tabs.title: Breakdowns
admin-revenue-tabs.body: By service, by method, by locker, by store and by customer.

admin-revenue-service.title: By service
admin-revenue-service.body: Per order type: revenue, share, refunds, net and orders; "View orders" lists that type's orders. Overtime fees have their own line so nothing is counted twice.

admin-revenue-orders-header.title: What you are viewing
admin-revenue-orders-header.body: The title names the service / locker / store / customer / method and the date range.

admin-revenue-orders-table.title: Orders
admin-revenue-orders-table.body: Order count and table with a button to open each order; for a payment method it lists transactions. With paging.

admin-revenue-orders-footer.title: Open the full page
admin-revenue-orders-footer.body: "Open in Orders" (or "Open in Payments") with the matching filters; "Close" goes back.

admin-revenue-entries-header.title: Summary
admin-revenue-entries-header.body: The card you clicked, total, number of entries, orders and date range.

admin-revenue-entries-table.title: Payments and refunds
admin-revenue-entries-table.body: Order code (click to open), customer, order type, method, amount (red for refunds) and time; with paging.

admin-revenue-method-tab.title: "By method" tab
admin-revenue-method-tab.body: Click to see this breakdown table.

admin-revenue-method-panel.title: By method table
admin-revenue-method-panel.body: Revenue, refunds, net, share, payment count and paid orders per method; "View orders" lists that method's transactions.

admin-revenue-locker-tab.title: "By locker" tab
admin-revenue-locker-tab.body: Click to see this breakdown table.

admin-revenue-locker-panel.title: By locker table
