admin-revenue-locker-panel.body: Locker, store, revenue, net, share, boxes, revenue per box, new and paid orders — lockers without revenue included; "View orders" lists the locker's orders.

admin-revenue-store-tab.title: "By store" tab
admin-revenue-store-tab.body: Click to see this breakdown table.

admin-revenue-store-panel.title: By store table
admin-revenue-store-panel.body: Store, contact, revenue, net, share, lockers, boxes and orders; "View orders" lists the store's orders.

admin-revenue-customers-tab.title: "By customer" tab
admin-revenue-customers-tab.body: Click to see revenue per customer.

admin-revenue-customers-filters.title: Search and sort
admin-revenue-customers-filters.body: Search by name, email, phone or customer id; sort by top spending, net spending, most orders, recent order / payment…

admin-revenue-customers-first.title: Customer
admin-revenue-customers-first.body: Click a name to open their revenue page. The table shows spent, refunds, net spent, average order, orders, last order / payment.

admin-revenue-customers-actions.title: Actions
admin-revenue-customers-actions.body: "View orders" lists the customer's orders in the period; the arrow button opens the customer page.

admin-revenue-customer-detail-open.title: Open from the customer tab
admin-revenue-customer-detail-open.body: In the "By customer" tab, click a customer name to open this page.

admin-revenue-customer-detail-header.title: Header
admin-revenue-customer-detail-header.body: Customer name and date range; the arrow goes back to the report.

admin-revenue-customer-detail-range.title: Date range
admin-revenue-customer-detail-range.body: Change it to see the customer's spending in another period.

admin-revenue-customer-detail-customer.title: Customer information
admin-revenue-customer-detail-customer.body: Name, phone, email and account status.

admin-revenue-customer-detail-stats.title: Customer figures
admin-revenue-customer-detail-stats.body: Spent, net after refunds, average order, orders created, paid orders, first and latest order.

admin-revenue-customer-detail-orders.title: Orders in the period
admin-revenue-customer-detail-orders.body: Each order: total, paid in period, paid all time, methods; click the code to open it. Orders created earlier but paid in the period are included.

admin-loyalty-range.title: Date range
admin-loyalty-range.body: Applies to the four period cards right below.

admin-loyalty-period.title: Points in the period
admin-loyalty-period.body: Points issued, redeemed, the difference and transaction count, with % vs. the previous period. Click a card to see the transactions in "Points origin".

admin-loyalty-overview.title: Members
admin-loyalty-overview.body: Members, new this month, active in 30 days and points outstanding. Click a card to filter the member list; the +/− numbers open transactions.

admin-loyalty-tiers.title: Tier distribution
admin-loyalty-tiers.body: Members per tier: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum. Tiers follow lifetime points — spending points never lowers a tier. Click a tier to filter.

admin-loyalty-metrics.title: Point metrics
admin-loyalty-metrics.body: Points issued, redeemed, average and median per member and total transactions; click any row for details.

admin-loyalty-month.title: This month
admin-loyalty-month.body: Points issued, redeemed and new members this month; click to see them.

admin-loyalty-members-search.title: Find a member
admin-loyalty-members-search.body: Search by name, email or phone number.

admin-loyalty-members-segments.title: Member groups
admin-loyalty-members-segments.body: Chips for all, new this month, active in 30 days, with points and each tier — with counts; the line below shows the group's total points.

admin-loyalty-members-table.title: Members table
admin-loyalty-members-table.body: Tier, points, lifetime, points added (+), points removed (−), transactions, joined and last transaction. Click a +/− number or the transaction count to open that member's history.

admin-loyalty-transactions-card.title: Points origin
admin-loyalty-transactions-card.body: Clicking a card above opens this table with that figure's filters.

admin-loyalty-transactions-range.title: Date range
admin-loyalty-transactions-range.body: Filter transactions by date; leave empty for all time.

admin-loyalty-transactions-filters.title: Transaction kind
admin-loyalty-transactions-filters.body: Chips for all, points added (+) and points removed (−), plus an order-type menu.

admin-loyalty-transactions-breakdown.title: By source / member
admin-loyalty-transactions-breakdown.body: Transactions and points per source (earned from order, used on order, voucher exchange…) and up to 20 members with the most points.

admin-loyalty-transactions-table.title: Each transaction
admin-loyalty-transactions-table.body: Time, member, source, order (click to open) or voucher exchange code, order type and points +/−; with paging.

admin-loyalty-member-header.title: Member
admin-loyalty-member-header.body: Name, current points, lifetime points, total added and removed.

admin-loyalty-member-panel.title: Member transactions
admin-loyalty-member-panel.body: The same date, kind filters and table as "Points origin", for this member only; opens on the kind you clicked (+ or −).

admin-promotions-create.title: Create promotion
admin-promotions-create.body: Opens the form for a new code.

admin-promotions-status.title: Status
admin-promotions-status.body: All, Active, Upcoming, Expired, Depleted, Inactive — with counts. Upcoming / expired / depleted are worked out from the dates and usage.

admin-promotions-search.title: Find a code
admin-promotions-search.body: Search by code or campaign name.

admin-promotions-scope.title: Scope
admin-promotions-scope.body: Filter system-wide codes or codes tied to a specific locker.

admin-promotions-toolbar.title: Clear and reload
admin-promotions-toolbar.body: "Clear filters" removes all filters, "Reload" refreshes the list.

admin-promotions-batch.title: Bulk delete
admin-promotions-batch.body: Tick rows and use "Delete selected", or "Delete all (n)" for the current filter; both need a reason. Codes that were already used are refused.

admin-promotions-first-row.title: Promotion row
admin-promotions-first-row.body: Code (with points if it is a points voucher), name and image, scope, discount, minimum order, validity, usage / limit and status.

admin-promotions-row-menu.title: Row menu
admin-promotions-row-menu.body: "Edit" opens the form (with an image field), "Deactivate" / "Reactivate", "Delete" (with a reason). Codes with history cannot be deleted — you are offered to deactivate instead.

admin-promotions-form-code.title: Code and name
admin-promotions-form-code.body: The promotion code (3–20 characters A-Z, 0-9, _, upper-cased automatically) and the campaign name — both required.

admin-promotions-form-description.title: Description
admin-promotions-form-description.body: A short description of the campaign for customers.

admin-promotions-form-scope.title: Applies at
admin-promotions-form-scope.body: System-wide or one locker (search by code / name). A locker code only works for orders at that locker; drone orders use the source locker.

admin-promotions-form-discount.title: Discount
admin-promotions-form-discount.body: Discount type (percentage or fixed amount), value and maximum discount (percentage only).

admin-promotions-form-limits.title: Conditions and limits
admin-promotions-form-limits.body: Minimum order, total uses and uses per user; leave empty for no limit.

admin-promotions-form-points.title: Redeem with points
admin-promotions-form-points.body: Enter points to make it a points voucher (1 point = 1 VND): hidden from the offers page and usable only by those who redeemed it.

admin-promotions-form-dates.title: Validity
admin-promotions-form-dates.body: Start and end date-time — required, the end must be after the start.

admin-promotions-form-toggles.title: Activate and combine
admin-promotions-form-toggles.body: "Activate now" and "Allow combining with other promotions" (only matters when settings allow several codes per order). Click create / save to store it.

admin-lockers-toolbar.title: Refresh, clear filters
admin-lockers-toolbar.body: Refresh reloads the list; clear filters resets every filter to its default.

admin-lockers-batch.title: Bulk delete
admin-lockers-batch.body: Tick the box on the left of each cabinet, then "Delete selected"; "Delete all cabinets" removes every cabinet and its boxes (asks to confirm).

admin-lockers-tech.title: Assigned technician
admin-lockers-tech.body: The technician in charge — click to open their page. "Unassigned" means fault tickets go to every cabinet technician.

admin-lockers-boxes.title: Boxes and free boxes
admin-lockers-boxes.body: Total boxes and free boxes; shows "Under maintenance" or "Not accepting orders" when the cabinet is paused.

admin-lockers-menu.title: Actions menu
admin-lockers-menu.body: Press "⋯" at the end of a row to view details, switch maintenance / activate, or delete the cabinet.

admin-lockers-row-menu-view.title: View detail
admin-lockers-row-menu-view.body: Opens the cabinet page: box layout, devices, logs and installation record.

admin-lockers-row-menu-status.title: Maintenance / Activate
admin-lockers-row-menu-status.body: "Maintenance" stops new orders at the cabinet; "Activate" lets it take orders again.

admin-lockers-row-menu-delete.title: Delete cabinet
admin-lockers-row-menu-delete.body: Deletes the cabinet and its boxes after you confirm. Only for cabinets that were removed for good.

admin-locker-detail-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-detail-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-detail-title.title: Name and status
admin-locker-detail-title.body: The cabinet code, name, location and current status.

admin-locker-detail-refresh.title: Refresh
admin-locker-detail-refresh.body: Reloads the box layout and the latest cabinet state.

admin-locker-detail-add.title: Add box
admin-locker-detail-add.body: Opens the dialog to add one or more physical boxes to the cabinet.

admin-locker-detail-more.title: More actions
admin-locker-detail-more.body: Menu for pinning the location, printing QR labels, test-open QR codes, auto-arranging the layout and deleting all boxes.

admin-locker-detail-warnings.title: Cabinet paused
admin-locker-detail-warnings.body: Shown when the cabinet takes no new orders, with the blocking fault tickets; it resumes once the last one is done.

admin-locker-detail-installing.title: Being installed
admin-locker-detail-installing.body: Customers cannot see the cabinet until an admin approves the acceptance record in the "Installation" tab.

admin-locker-detail-kpis.title: Boxes by status
admin-locker-detail-kpis.body: "Total physical boxes", "Free", "In use", "Faulty" and "Waiting for technician check".

admin-locker-detail-door.title: Open door warning
admin-locker-detail-door.body: Lists boxes whose door stayed open — check on site or close them to avoid losing goods.

admin-locker-more-menu-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-more-menu-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-more-menu-more.title: Open the menu
admin-locker-more-menu-more.body: Press "More actions" at the top of the cabinet page.

admin-locker-more-menu-location.title: Pin location
admin-locker-more-menu-location.body: Opens the map to set the exact position and address — the customer app uses it for directions.

admin-locker-more-menu-qr.title: QR & labels
admin-locker-more-menu-qr.body: View, download and print the QR label stuck on each box door.

admin-locker-more-menu-open-qr.title: Test-open QR
admin-locker-more-menu-open-qr.body: Prints a sheet of QR codes by layout: scanning a box code pops that box — for installation or lock checks.

admin-locker-more-menu-arrange.title: Auto-arrange
admin-locker-more-menu-arrange.body: Re-orders boxes by number, row by row from the top-left; preview how many move, then "Arrange". Only when the layout differs from the real cabinet.

admin-locker-more-menu-delete-all.title: Delete all boxes
admin-locker-more-menu-delete-all.body: Removes every box from the layout (asks to confirm). Boxes holding goods cannot be deleted.

admin-locker-grid-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-grid-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-grid-tab.title: "Box layout" tab
admin-locker-grid-tab.body: The default tab of the cabinet page.

admin-locker-grid-grid.title: Physical layout
admin-locker-grid-grid.body: Boxes laid out by row and column like the real cabinet; row 1 holds the drone boxes.

admin-locker-grid-screen.title: Kiosk screen
admin-locker-grid-screen.body: The 7-inch touchscreen always sits at row 1, column 1; red border when offline. Click for screen details.

admin-locker-grid-legend.title: Colour legend
admin-locker-grid-legend.body: Colours for "Available", "In use", "Faulty", "Waiting for check", "Suspended" and "Door open".

admin-locker-grid-cell.title: A box
admin-locker-grid-cell.body: Box number, type (drone, XL suitcase), size and status; shows the reason when reported faulty.

admin-locker-grid-cell-qr.title: Box QR
admin-locker-grid-cell-qr.body: Click the QR icon to view and print the box label.

admin-locker-grid-cell-menu.title: Box actions
admin-locker-grid-cell-menu.body: The box "More actions" menu: QR label, ArUco, edit, suspend, cleaning, emergency open, report fault, delete.

admin-locker-grid-cell-actions.title: Quick buttons
admin-locker-grid-cell-actions.body: Suspended / cleaning / faulty boxes get "Restore box"; boxes with orders get a button to see them.

admin-locker-grid-overlap.title: Overlapping boxes
admin-locker-grid-overlap.body: Warns when two boxes share a row and column — fix the position or use "Auto-arrange".

admin-locker-cell-menu-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-cell-menu-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-cell-menu-open.title: Open the box menu
admin-locker-cell-menu-open.body: Press "⋯" in the corner of the box.

admin-locker-cell-menu-qr.title: QR & label
admin-locker-cell-menu-qr.body: Opens the box QR label to download or print.

admin-locker-cell-menu-aruco.title: Drone ArUco code
admin-locker-cell-menu-aruco.body: Drone boxes only: view or assign the ArUco marker on the sliding lid so the drone finds the box.

admin-locker-cell-menu-edit.title: Edit function
admin-locker-cell-menu-edit.body: Change box type, number, size, row/column and status.

admin-locker-cell-menu-suspend.title: Suspend
admin-locker-cell-menu-suspend.body: Available box: stop customers from booking it.

admin-locker-cell-menu-cleaning.title: Send to cleaning
admin-locker-cell-menu-cleaning.body: Available box: mark it as being cleaned so nobody books it.

admin-locker-cell-menu-force.title: Emergency open
admin-locker-cell-menu-force.body: Faulty / suspended / cleaning box: sends a real open command right away — only when someone is at the cabinet.

admin-locker-cell-menu-fault.title: Report fault
admin-locker-cell-menu-fault.body: Marks the box faulty and opens a fault ticket for technicians.

admin-locker-cell-menu-delete.title: Delete this box
admin-locker-cell-menu-delete.body: Removes the box from the layout (with a reason). Boxes holding goods or reserved cannot be deleted.

admin-locker-edit-box-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-edit-box-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-edit-box-menu.title: Open the box menu
admin-locker-edit-box-menu.body: Press "⋯" in the corner of the box.

admin-locker-edit-box-type.title: Box function
admin-locker-edit-box-type.body: Standard box (send, store, hand-over), drone box or XL suitcase bay — decides which services use it.

admin-locker-edit-box-number.title: Number, size, position
admin-locker-edit-box-number.body: Box number, bay size and row/column on the layout (row 1 column 1 is the screen).

admin-locker-edit-box-status.title: Box status
admin-locker-edit-box-status.body: "Available", "Out of service" or "Cleaning". Use the box menu to report a fault.

admin-locker-edit-box-footer.title: Save or delete
admin-locker-edit-box-footer.body: Save (synced at once to the kiosk and technician app) or delete the box with a reason.

admin-locker-qr-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-qr-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-qr-open.title: Open the QR label
admin-locker-qr-open.body: Click the QR icon on a box.

admin-locker-qr-modes.title: Label type
admin-locker-qr-modes.body: "Box label" (QR), "Box ArUco" (drone boxes) or "Print all" labels.

admin-locker-qr-sticker.title: Label preview
admin-locker-qr-sticker.body: A true-to-print preview: function, size, position, ID and QR.

admin-locker-qr-picker.title: Pick another box
admin-locker-qr-picker.body: Switch to another box without closing the dialog.

admin-locker-qr-specs.title: Box specs
admin-locker-qr-specs.body: Technical details of the box shown.

admin-locker-qr-payload.title: QR payload
admin-locker-qr-payload.body: The JSON inside the QR — for checking when a scan fails.

admin-locker-qr-print.title: Print
admin-locker-qr-print.body: Print this label, the ArUco label or all labels (80×100 mm, thermal decal or A4 printer).

admin-locker-cell-orders-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-cell-orders-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-cell-orders-open.title: Orders button
admin-locker-cell-orders-open.body: A box with orders shows "Order held" — click to see them.

admin-locker-cell-orders-dialog.title: Order list
admin-locker-cell-orders-dialog.body: Orders reserved or holding goods in the box, with sender and receiver.

admin-locker-cell-orders-first.title: View order
admin-locker-cell-orders-first.body: Press "View order" to open the order detail page.

admin-locker-add-box-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-add-box-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-add-box-open.title: Open the dialog
admin-locker-add-box-open.body: Press "Add box" at the top of the cabinet page.

admin-locker-add-box-fields.title: Number and position
admin-locker-add-box-fields.body: One box: number, row, column. Many: a list (3, 6, 9 or 1-6) or a running range, with optional auto row & column.

admin-locker-add-box-type.title: Type and size
admin-locker-add-box-type.body: Pick "Box type" (standard, drone, XL suitcase) and "Size".

admin-locker-add-box-preview.title: Preview
admin-locker-add-box-preview.body: A preview of where the new boxes will go.

admin-locker-open-qr-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-open-qr-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-open-qr-more.title: Open "More actions"
admin-locker-open-qr-more.body: Press "More actions" at the top of the cabinet page.

admin-locker-open-qr-base.title: Admin web address
admin-locker-open-qr-base.body: The address a phone opens when scanning with its camera. Not needed when scanning with the Lock.R app (test mode).

admin-locker-open-qr-sheet.title: QR sheet by layout
admin-locker-open-qr-sheet.body: One QR per box at its real position; scanning a code pops that box.

admin-locker-open-qr-print.title: Print
admin-locker-open-qr-print.body: Print the sheet to stick on or bring to the cabinet.

admin-locker-open-qr-result.title: Page after scanning
admin-locker-open-qr-result.body: Scan with a camera and sign in as ADMIN / the assigned technician: the "Open box by QR" page sends the command, shows the result, with "Open again" and "Back to cabinet".

admin-locker-screen-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-screen-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-screen-open.title: Open screen details
admin-locker-screen-open.body: Click the screen tile at row 1, column 1.

admin-locker-screen-status.title: Screen state
admin-locker-screen-status.body: Whether the screen is online; when offline, wait for kiosk power or reconnect the Raspberry Pi.

admin-locker-screen-specs.title: Hardware specs
admin-locker-screen-specs.body: Model, resolution, touch standard and port, video port and the no-blanking power setting.

admin-locker-screen-app.title: App & controller
admin-locker-screen-app.body: The UI app, its address on the Pi, the Pi MAC address and last seen time.

admin-locker-operations-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-operations-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-operations-tech.title: Technician in charge
admin-locker-operations-tech.body: Gets the cabinet fault tickets. "Unassigned" sends new tickets to every cabinet technician.

admin-locker-operations-select.title: Change technician
admin-locker-operations-select.body: Pick a technician (locked ones are disabled) and press "Save".

admin-locker-operations-gps.title: Location & GPS
admin-locker-operations-gps.body: Saved coordinates and address, "Located" / "No GPS"; "Open Google Maps" to check it.

admin-locker-operations-location.title: Edit map
admin-locker-operations-location.body: Opens the map to re-pin the cabinet.

admin-locker-location-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-location-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-location-search.title: Search a place
admin-locker-location-search.body: Type an address, building or school and press "Search"; click a result to pin it.

admin-locker-location-tools.title: GPS and pin mode
admin-locker-location-tools.body: "My GPS location" uses the device position; switch between centre pin and drag pin.

admin-locker-location-map.title: Map
admin-locker-location-map.body: Drag the map or the pin, zoom in / out, re-centre the pin.

admin-locker-location-fields.title: Address and coordinates
admin-locker-location-fields.body: The detailed address looked up from the pin, editable; latitude and longitude.

admin-locker-location-save.title: Save
admin-locker-location-save.body: Save the new position or cancel.

admin-locker-devices-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-devices-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-devices-gateway.title: Cabinet controller
admin-locker-devices-gateway.body: The Pi linked to the cabinet: connection, hardware slots, last seen and warnings (wrong cabinet, more boxes than slots, failed test slots).

admin-locker-devices-gateway-actions.title: Controller actions
admin-locker-devices-gateway-actions.body: "Resend layout", "Ask to report", "Detach"; pick a reported Pi and "Assign to cabinet" (optionally test every door), "Forget" an old Pi.

admin-locker-devices-ble-test.title: Bluetooth test opening
admin-locker-devices-ble-test.body: Customer accounts on this list see a Bluetooth button in the app Profile and can open this cabinet’s boxes standing nearby.

admin-locker-devices-ble-add.title: Allow an account
admin-locker-devices-ble-add.body: Search a customer by name, email or phone to grant test access.

admin-locker-devices-ble-list.title: Allowed accounts
admin-locker-devices-ble-list.body: Accounts granted and when; "Revoke" removes access.

admin-locker-devices-ble-scan.title: Bluetooth scan & test
admin-locker-devices-ble-scan.body: In Chrome/Edge with Bluetooth: "Scan cabinet Bluetooth"; once the right cabinet is close, "Open box n" to test.

admin-locker-logs-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-logs-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-logs-tabs.title: Two log types
admin-locker-logs-tabs.body: "Unlock & IoT log" (connections, opens, drone ↔ cabinet) and "Faults & repairs".

admin-locker-logs-kpis.title: Log numbers
admin-locker-logs-kpis.body: Total entries, online (powered), offline (unplugged) and hardware errors / warnings.

admin-locker-logs-gateway.title: Power state
admin-locker-logs-gateway.body: Whether the cabinet is online, its hardware, firmware and last signal.

admin-locker-logs-filters.title: Search and filter
admin-locker-logs-filters.body: Search by text, order code or account; filter by "Event type", "Box" and "Result".

admin-locker-logs-table.title: Log table
admin-locker-logs-table.body: Each event with time, box, who or what did it and the result.

admin-locker-installation-detail.title: Open the cabinet
admin-locker-installation-detail.body: In the kiosk list, press "⋯" at the end of a row and choose "View detail" to open that cabinet.

admin-locker-installation-create.title: Create a record
admin-locker-installation-create.body: No record (or the last one closed): create one ⇒ the cabinet is "Awaiting installation", hidden from customers.

admin-locker-installation-info.title: Record details
admin-locker-installation-info.body: Installer, schedule, site contact, power, network, cabinet model/serial and timeline.

admin-locker-installation-actions.title: Approve or return
admin-locker-installation-actions.body: "Approve" (cabinet goes live), "Return to technician" with a reason, or "Cancel record". Missing steps or photos block approval.

admin-locker-installation-checklist.title: Acceptance checklist
admin-locker-installation-checklist.body: Steps the technician did: link the controller, test each box…; automatic steps come from IoT.

admin-locker-installation-photos.title: Installation photos
admin-locker-installation-photos.body: Site photos sent with the record — click to enlarge.

admin-cabinet-control-safety.title: Real hardware
admin-cabinet-control-safety.body: Every button drives real hardware. Only act when nobody is using the cabinet; press "Stop" at once if a lid jams.

admin-cabinet-control-locker.title: Pick a cabinet
admin-cabinet-control-locker.body: Choose the cabinet; "Refresh" reads its state again.

admin-cabinet-control-tabs.title: Two tabs
admin-cabinet-control-tabs.body: "Control" and "Hardware config" (the Pi GPIO pin map).

admin-cabinet-control-open-box.title: Open a box
admin-cabinet-control-open-box.body: Click a box to send its unlock command.

admin-cabinet-control-lids.title: Sliding lids
admin-cabinet-control-lids.body: Per lid axis: state, "Open fully", "Close fully", "Home", "Stop", jog by revolutions and tune speed / pulses.

admin-cabinet-control-log.title: Control log
admin-cabinet-control-log.body: Each command: time, source, action, box / axis, revolutions and result.

admin-cabinet-hardware-status.title: Config state
admin-cabinet-hardware-status.body: When it was saved and applied, and whether it matches what runs on the cabinet. Only admins can edit.

admin-cabinet-hardware-boxes.title: Boxes: relay and sensor
admin-cabinet-hardware-boxes.body: Each box has a relay terminal, relay pin and door sensor pin; "Add box", "Remove last box".

admin-cabinet-hardware-options.title: Relay, sensor, drone
admin-cabinet-hardware-options.body: Relay trigger level, pulse time, door-closed level, require door sensor and lid bypass.

admin-cabinet-hardware-lids.title: Sliding lids
admin-cabinet-hardware-lids.body: Per axis: wired or not, PUL/DIR pins, open direction, limit switch, boxes under the lid.

admin-cabinet-hardware-wiring.title: Wiring diagram
admin-cabinet-hardware-wiring.body: Table of wires between Pi, relays and devices; add or delete rows.

admin-cabinet-hardware-actions.title: Save and apply
admin-cabinet-hardware-actions.body: "Save", then "Apply to cabinet" (controller restarts ~10 s); "Load running config" or "Discard".

admin-storage-filters.title: Search, filter, sort
admin-storage-filters.body: Search by order code, receiver name/phone or sender phone; filter "Order type", "Sort"; refresh, clear filters.

admin-storage-handover.title: Hand over
admin-storage-handover.body: Press "Hand over" when the customer comes to the counter.

admin-storage-handover-open.title: Open hand-over
admin-storage-handover-open.body: Press "Hand over" on the item row.

admin-storage-handover-summary.title: Order details
admin-storage-handover-summary.body: Sender, receiver, when stored and the overtime fee.

admin-storage-handover-recipient.title: Who collects
admin-storage-handover-recipient.body: Choose "Receiver", "Sender" or "Someone else" (name, phone); ask for the last 4 phone digits to check.

admin-storage-handover-payment.title: Overtime fee
admin-storage-handover-payment.body: Owing: collect and tick "I collected it"; if the customer just paid in the app, re-check. Paid: nothing to collect.

admin-storage-handover-note.title: Note
admin-storage-handover-note.body: Optional note; a reason is required when handing to someone else.

admin-storage-handover-photo.title: Verification photo
admin-storage-handover-photo.body: Photo of the receiver holding the item, face and item visible. Required.

admin-storage-handover-footer.title: Confirm hand-over
admin-storage-handover-footer.body: "Missing" lists what is left; when complete press "Handed over" — the order is completed, no undo.

admin-stores-filters.title: Filter stores
admin-stores-filters.body: Filter by "Status" (Active / Inactive) and by "Area" taken from the address; the search box matches name, address or phone.

admin-stores-toolbar.title: Add and reload
admin-stores-toolbar.body: "Add Store" opens a form for name, address, phone and coordinates. "Reload" fetches fresh data, "Clear filters" resets every filter.

admin-stores-batch.title: Delete several stores
admin-stores-batch.body: Tick rows and press "Delete selected", or "Delete all" for everything matching the filters; a reason is required. Stores that still have lockers cannot be deleted.

admin-stores-list.title: Store list
admin-stores-list.body: Each row shows contact, address and the number of lockers, boxes and orders in the last 12 months. Use the table footer for rows per page and paging.

admin-stores-status.title: Switch on / off
admin-stores-status.body: Flip the switch to move a store between "Active" and "Inactive"; it changes as soon as you flip it.

admin-stores-menu.title: Row menu
admin-stores-menu.body: The "…" button at the end of a row: "View Detail", "Edit" or "Delete" the store.

admin-stores-row-menu-view.title: View Detail
admin-stores-row-menu-view.body: Opens the detail page: edit details, change the photo, see statistics and manage the store's kiosks.

admin-stores-row-menu-edit.title: Edit
admin-stores-row-menu-edit.body: Opens "Edit Store" to change the name, address, phone, coordinates and description.

admin-stores-row-menu-delete.title: Delete store
admin-stores-row-menu-delete.body: Asks for a reason, then deletes. Move or delete all of the store's kiosks first, otherwise the server refuses.

admin-stores-form-name.title: Store name
admin-stores-form-name.body: Required; it identifies the store in every list and filter.

admin-stores-form-address.title: Address
admin-stores-form-address.body: Required. Write it from smallest to largest, separated by commas (number, ward, district) so the "Area" filter can find the district.

admin-stores-form-coords.title: Latitude, longitude
admin-stores-form-coords.body: Map coordinates as decimals (e.g. 10.8412 and 106.8098); leave empty if unknown.

admin-stores-form-description.title: Description
admin-stores-form-description.body: A short note about where the kiosks are placed, optional.

admin-stores-form-actions.title: Save or cancel
admin-stores-form-actions.body: "Create Store" (when adding) or "Save Changes" (when editing) saves; "Cancel" closes without saving.

admin-stores-detail-title.title: Name and store ID
admin-stores-detail-title.body: The name and "Store ID" (#…). The arrow button goes back.

admin-stores-detail-status.title: Status
admin-stores-detail-status.body: The badge shows whether the store is active; "Deactivate" / "Activate" changes it after you confirm. While editing, "Cancel" and "Save changes" appear here.

admin-stores-detail-image.title: Store photo
admin-stores-detail-image.body: "Change photo" uploads a new picture; "Remove photo" removes the current one after you confirm.

admin-stores-detail-form.title: Edit details
admin-stores-detail-form.body: Edit the name, address, phone, description, latitude and longitude in place, then press "Save changes" at the top and confirm.

admin-stores-detail-stats.title: Statistics
admin-stores-detail-stats.body: Total kiosks, total and free boxes, orders in the last 12 months and box usage rate.

admin-stores-detail-history.title: History
admin-stores-detail-history.body: Created date, last update and store ID.

admin-stores-detail-kiosks.title: Kiosks
admin-stores-detail-kiosks.body: The lockers placed at this store. "Refresh" reloads, "Add Kiosk" creates a new locker for this store.

admin-stores-detail-card.title: Kiosk card
admin-stores-detail-card.body: Each card is one locker: status, free boxes, usage and quick action buttons.

admin-stores-add-kiosk-open.title: Open the form
admin-stores-add-kiosk-open.body: Press "Add Kiosk" above the kiosk list (or "Add First Kiosk" when the store has none).

admin-stores-add-kiosk-head.title: Add New Kiosk
admin-stores-add-kiosk-head.body: The kiosk is assigned to this store as soon as it is created.

admin-stores-add-kiosk-code.title: Device code
admin-stores-add-kiosk-code.body: Required; a unique code that identifies the locker, e.g. LOCKER-001.

admin-stores-add-kiosk-name.title: Kiosk name
admin-stores-add-kiosk-name.body: Required; a name that tells where it stands, e.g. "Main Lobby Kiosk A".

admin-stores-add-kiosk-location.title: Location
admin-stores-add-kiosk-location.body: Optional: where the locker sits inside the store, e.g. floor or zone.

admin-stores-add-kiosk-coords.title: Locker coordinates
admin-stores-add-kiosk-coords.body: Latitude and longitude of the locker, optional.

admin-stores-add-kiosk-actions.title: Create Kiosk
admin-stores-add-kiosk-actions.body: "Create Kiosk" is enabled once code and name are filled; "Cancel" closes the form.

admin-stores-locker-card-head.title: Name and status
admin-stores-locker-card-head.body: Kiosk name, status badge (Active, Off, Maintenance, Disconnected), device code and location.

admin-stores-locker-card-usage.title: Free boxes
admin-stores-locker-card-usage.body: Free boxes out of the total and the share in use.

admin-stores-locker-card-actions.title: Action buttons
admin-stores-locker-card-actions.body: Power turns the locker on/off, the wrench sets or ends maintenance — both apply at once. The gear opens "Kiosk Settings", "View boxes" shows the box grid, "+" adds a box.

admin-stores-locker-card-boxes.title: Box grid
admin-stores-locker-card-boxes.body: Box colours follow their status (legend above). Click a box to see and change its status; the "+" tile adds a new box.

admin-stores-locker-settings-open.title: Open settings
admin-stores-locker-settings-open.body: Click the gear icon at the bottom of the kiosk card.

admin-stores-locker-settings-head.title: Kiosk Settings
admin-stores-locker-settings-head.body: The dialog for one kiosk's details and status.

admin-stores-locker-settings-form.title: Locker details
admin-stores-locker-settings-form.body: Edit the kiosk name, device code, location and coordinates; name and code are required.

admin-stores-locker-settings-maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
admin-stores-locker-settings-maintenance.body: Flip the switch to turn maintenance on/off — it applies immediately, no need to press "Save". While on, all boxes are locked.

admin-stores-locker-settings-actions.title: Save
admin-stores-locker-settings-actions.body: "Save" stores your edits (or just closes if nothing changed); "Cancel" closes the dialog.

admin-stores-add-box-open.title: Open the form
admin-stores-add-box-open.body: Click "+" at the bottom of the kiosk card, or the "+" tile at the end of the box grid.

admin-stores-add-box-head.title: Add Box
admin-stores-add-box-head.body: The new box is added to the locker right after it is created.

admin-stores-add-box-number.title: Box number
admin-stores-add-box-number.body: Pre-filled with the highest existing number plus 1; change it if needed.

admin-stores-add-box-size.title: Size
admin-stores-add-box-size.body: Pick Small (S), Medium (M), Large (L) or Extra large (XL).

admin-stores-add-box-actions.title: Add the box
admin-stores-add-box-actions.body: "Add Box" creates it right away; "Cancel" closes the form.

admin-stores-box-settings-expand.title: View boxes
admin-stores-box-settings-expand.body: Click "View boxes" on the kiosk card to open the box grid, then click a box.

admin-stores-box-settings-grid.title: Pick a box
admin-stores-box-settings-grid.body: Each tile is a box coloured by status; a tile with the unlock icon holds a parcel.

admin-stores-box-settings-locked.title: Box in use
admin-stores-box-settings-locked.body: A box holding a parcel or a reservation is managed by the order flow and cannot be changed by hand.

admin-stores-box-settings-change.title: Change status
admin-stores-box-settings-change.body: For a box without an order: pick "Available" or "Maintenance", then press "Save".

admin-stores-box-settings-emergency.title: Emergency Open
admin-stores-box-settings-emergency.body: Only for a box holding a parcel: sends the open command after you confirm and is logged. Use it only with staff on site.

admin-stores-box-settings-actions.title: Save
admin-stores-box-settings-actions.body: "Save" stores the new status; "Cancel" closes the dialog.

admin-services-range.title: Report period
admin-services-range.body: Pick a from–to date or a shortcut ("Today", "7 days", "This month"…) to see performance; the total revenue for the period is on the right.

admin-services-card.title: Service card
admin-services-card.body: Each card is one service: name, order type code and its main price in large type on the right (e.g. fee per order).

admin-services-performance.title: Performance in period
admin-services-performance.body: Revenue, share, new orders and paid orders; "View orders for this service" opens the Orders page already filtered.

admin-services-rules.title: Applicable rules
admin-services-rules.body: Edit prices, time limits, overtime fees… right in the fields; each shows its valid range and invalid values turn red.

admin-services-shared.title: Shared rules
admin-services-shared.body: Rules for all three services, plus "Overtime Fees Collected in Period" (counted separately from the services' revenue).

admin-services-save.title: Save changes
admin-services-save.body: With unsaved edits, a bar at the bottom shows how many, with "Discard Changes" and "Save changes". New prices apply to orders created after saving.

admin-technicians-kpis.title: Overview cards
admin-technicians-kpis.body: Four cards: "Total Technicians", "Handling Incidents", "SLA Violation Warnings", "CSAT Quality Score". Click a card to see only its technicians; click "kiosk tech(s)", "drone tech(s)" or "… on shift" to filter quickly.

admin-technicians-policy.title: Three SLA penalty levels
admin-technicians-policy.body: The server places technicians in Level 1 Reminder, Level 2 Job Hold or Level 3 Suspension by overdue reports; thresholds are set in Settings.

admin-technicians-search.title: Find a technician
admin-technicians-search.body: Type a name, phone number or email to find a technician quickly.

admin-technicians-shift.title: Filter by shift
admin-technicians-shift.body: Pick "On shift" to see who can take a job right now, or "Off shift".

admin-technicians-specialty.title: Filter by specialty
admin-technicians-specialty.body: Show only kiosk techs (locker repair) or drone techs (fleet).

admin-technicians-penalty.title: Filter by penalty
admin-technicians-penalty.body: Show only technicians who are active, under SLA warning, restricted from new jobs or suspended / locked.

admin-technicians-count.title: Technicians shown
admin-technicians-count.body: The title shows how many technicians match. When filtering by a card, a "Showing: …" chip appears — click "Clear" to see everyone again.

admin-technicians-card-identity.title: Profile summary
admin-technicians-card-identity.body: Name, ID, phone, specialty and number of periodic schedules. Click the name to open the detail page.

admin-technicians-card-status.title: Penalty status
admin-technicians-card-status.body: "In good standing", "SLA Warning", "Restricted", "Suspension recommended" or "Suspended" — calculated by the server from overdue reports.

admin-technicians-card-load.title: Workload
admin-technicians-card-load.body: Shows whether the technician is free, working or under high load (3+ jobs) so you can pick who gets the job.

admin-technicians-card-shift.title: Shift and location
admin-technicians-card-shift.body: A green dot means "On shift". Click the GPS coordinates to open the latest position in Google Maps; without coordinates it shows "No location yet".

admin-technicians-card-metrics.title: Report counts
admin-technicians-card-metrics.body: The technician's "In progress", "Done" and "SLA late" reports.

admin-technicians-card-detail.title: View Detail
admin-technicians-card-detail.body: Open the technician detail page: profile, incident reports, periodic schedules and ratings.

admin-technicians-card-assign.title: Assign
admin-technicians-card-assign.body: Opens the Maintenance page with incidents filtered to this technician to assign or follow up reports. Hidden for suspended technicians.

admin-technicians-card-suspend.title: Suspend / unlock
admin-technicians-card-suspend.body: The red button suspends the technician (asks to confirm; their sessions end and they cannot sign in). Suspended technicians get a green "Unlock technician" button that works at once.

admin-technicians-detail-header.title: Name and status
admin-technicians-detail-header.body: The technician's name with account status, technician ID and specialty. The arrow goes back to the list.

admin-technicians-detail-refresh.title: Refresh
admin-technicians-detail-refresh.body: Reload the technician's performance, incident reports, profile and latest location.

admin-technicians-detail-assign.title: Assign Incident
admin-technicians-detail-assign.body: Opens a dialog to pick a pending incident report for this technician. Hidden when the technician is suspended.

admin-technicians-detail-warning.title: Send SLA Warning
admin-technicians-detail-warning.body: Immediately sends an in-app reminder to clear overdue reports. Shown only when the technician is at a penalty level.

admin-technicians-detail-suspend.title: Suspend / reactivate
admin-technicians-detail-suspend.body: "Suspend Technician" asks to confirm, then locks the account and ends sign-in sessions; "Reactivate" unlocks at once.

admin-technicians-detail-kpis.title: Four figures
admin-technicians-detail-kpis.body: The technician's "Total Assigned", "In Progress", "Completed" (with completion rate) and "SLA Overdue".

admin-technicians-profile-profile.title: Technician Profile
admin-technicians-profile-profile.body: Email, phone, join date and current workload; the copy buttons copy the email or phone number.

admin-technicians-profile-phone.title: Edit phone number
admin-technicians-profile-phone.body: The pencil opens "Update Technician Phone": type the new number and click "Save changes" (account status stays the same).

admin-technicians-profile-presence.title: Shift & field location
admin-technicians-profile-presence.body: Shift start, GPS coordinates, accuracy and update time; "Open in Google Maps" shows the spot. Location exists only while the technician is on shift in the app.

admin-technicians-profile-devices.title: Assigned devices
admin-technicians-profile-devices.body: Lockers (or drones) assigned to the technician with free boxes; click "View kiosk details" to open a locker. Assign technicians on the locker / drone detail page.

admin-technicians-profile-sla.title: SLA policy & violations
admin-technicians-profile-sla.body: Current penalty level, reason and applied penalty, plus the 3-level automatic framework. Thresholds are set by the admin in Settings.

admin-technicians-tickets-tab.title: Incident Reports tab
admin-technicians-tickets-tab.body: The number in brackets is how many reports are assigned to this technician.

admin-technicians-tickets-filters.title: Filter reports
admin-technicians-tickets-filters.body: Pick "All", "In progress", "Done" or "SLA late"; the numbers show how many reports each has.

admin-technicians-tickets-search.title: Search reports
admin-technicians-tickets-search.body: Search by RPT code, title, locker name, drone code or content; click × to clear.

admin-technicians-tickets-summary.title: Report content
admin-technicians-tickets-summary.body: Code, title, status ("Newly received", "In Progress", "Completed"), SLA countdown, overdue / extended tags, the customer's report and reporter.

admin-technicians-tickets-actions.title: Report actions
admin-technicians-tickets-actions.body: "Log" shows details and repair photos; "Extend SLA" adds handling hours with a reason; "Reclaim" moves the report back to Unassigned (asks to confirm).

admin-technicians-tickets-info.title: Device and SLA due
admin-technicians-tickets-info.body: Click the locker / drone name to open the device; see the created time and SLA due. Below are photos in 4 stages: on-site (reporter), technician verification, repair progress, acceptance.

admin-technicians-timeline-tab.title: Activity History tab
admin-technicians-timeline-tab.body: Opens the technician's dispatch and repair log.

admin-technicians-timeline-list.title: Dispatch log
admin-technicians-timeline-list.body: The 10 latest reports: a green dot is completed, blue is in progress, with time, device and description.

admin-technicians-schedules-tab.title: Periodic schedules tab
admin-technicians-schedules-tab.body: The tab reads "Periodic Kiosk Schedules" or "Periodic Drone Schedules" by specialty, with the number assigned.

admin-technicians-schedules-plans.title: Devices for periodic inspection
admin-technicians-schedules-plans.body: Each plan shows its due time, interval, checklist and an "Overdue", "Due today" or "N day(s) left" tag; click the locker / drone name to open it.

admin-technicians-schedules-history.title: Inspection history
admin-technicians-schedules-history.body: Each inspection record: result, note, per-item checklist, on-site photos and the incident report created when it failed.

admin-technicians-reviews-tab.title: Reviews & CSAT tab
admin-technicians-reviews-tab.body: The number in brackets is how many customers rated the technician.

admin-technicians-reviews-csat.title: Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
admin-technicians-reviews-csat.body: Average score out of 5 and the number of ratings after completed repairs.

admin-technicians-reviews-ratings.title: Recent ratings
admin-technicians-reviews-ratings.body: Stars, time and comment of each rating.

admin-technicians-assign-open.title: Open the dialog
admin-technicians-assign-open.body: Click "Assign Incident" at the top of the technician detail page (not shown for suspended technicians).

admin-technicians-assign-pick.title: Pick a report
admin-technicians-assign-pick.body: Open, unassigned reports matching the technician's specialty (locker or drone). Click one to select it.

admin-technicians-assign-confirm.title: Confirm
admin-technicians-assign-confirm.body: Click "Confirm Assignment" to assign the selected report, or "Cancel" to close.

admin-login-intro.title: Admins only
admin-login-intro.body: This page only accepts admin accounts. Customers, technicians and drone crews use the Lock.R mobile app.

admin-login-email.title: Email
admin-login-email.body: Enter the email of your admin account.

admin-login-password.title: Password
admin-login-password.body: Enter your password; click the eye icon to show or hide what you typed.

admin-login-submit.title: "Continue"
admin-login-submit.body: Checks your email and password. Wrong details or an account without admin rights show an error right below the fields.

admin-login-note.title: Two-step verification
admin-login-note.body: After this step a 6-digit code is emailed to you to finish signing in.

admin-login-language.title: Language
admin-login-language.body: Switch the sign-in page between Vietnamese (VI) and English (EN).

admin-login-2fa-sent.title: Where the code went
admin-login-2fa-sent.body: The 6-digit code is sent to the (partly hidden) email of the account you entered. Open that inbox to get it.

admin-login-2fa-code.title: "Verification code"
admin-login-2fa-code.body: Type all 6 digits; the box accepts digits only. A wrong code shows how many tries are left; too many wrong tries or an expired code means signing in again for a new code.

admin-login-2fa-actions.title: "Verify" / "Back"
admin-login-2fa-actions.body: "Verify" is enabled once 6 digits are entered and takes you into the console (or the page you were opening before signing in). "Back" returns to the email and password step.

admin-basics-breadcrumb.title: Page path
admin-basics-breadcrumb.body: Shows where you are; click an earlier item to go back up (e.g. from an order detail to the Orders list).

admin-basics-theme.title: Light / dark theme
admin-basics-theme.body: Choose "Light", "Dark" or "System" (follows your device). The choice is saved in this browser.

admin-dashboard-year.title: "Select year"
admin-dashboard-year.body: Changes the year for this chart and for the payment mix, revenue by service and top locations cards. This year and the two before are available.

admin-dashboard-month.title: Drill into a month
admin-dashboard-month.body: Click a month on the chart and this bar shows two buttons: "… new orders →" opens that month's orders, "… collected →" opens the payments received.

admin-dashboard-charts-payment.title: "Payment mix"
admin-dashboard-charts-payment.body: Share of collected money by payment method in the selected year. Click a slice or legend row to see the orders paid that way.

admin-dashboard-charts-status.title: "Order status"
admin-dashboard-charts-status.body: Every order in the system by its current status (stored, overdue, completed, cancelled…) with counts and shares. Click a status to open those orders.

admin-dashboard-charts-service.title: "Revenue by kiosk service"
admin-dashboard-charts-service.body: Money collected for parcels, box rental, drone delivery and overdue fees this year. Click a service bar for its paid orders (overdue fees have no list as they are not one order type).

admin-dashboard-charts-peak.title: "Peak hours"
admin-dashboard-charts-peak.body: New orders per hour of the day over the last 30 days (Vietnam time). Click a bar to see the orders created in that hour.

admin-dashboard-charts-growth.title: "New customer growth"
admin-dashboard-charts-growth.body: New sign-ups per month over the last 12 months, with the 12-month total in the corner. Click a month to list the accounts created then.

admin-dashboard-charts-shortcuts.title: "Recommended for you"
admin-dashboard-charts-shortcuts.body: Shortcuts to Maintenance, the revenue report, Loyalty and Promotions. Click a card to open that page.

admin-dashboard-orders-period.title: Which orders you see
admin-dashboard-orders-period.body: The title names the group of orders; the label shows the date range (or "All time", or the hour when opened from peak hours) and the total.

admin-dashboard-orders-table.title: Order list
admin-dashboard-orders-table.body: Order code, customer, type, status, amount and creation time. Click a row to open the order; change page and rows per page at the bottom.

admin-dashboard-orders-open.title: "Open in Orders page"
admin-dashboard-orders-open.body: Opens the Orders page with the same status and date filters so you can keep filtering and searching.

admin-dashboard-lockers-totals.title: Box totals
admin-dashboard-lockers-totals.body: How many kiosks are listed and their available, in-use and total boxes.

admin-dashboard-lockers-table.title: Each kiosk
admin-dashboard-lockers-table.body: One row per locker: location, status, free, in-use and total boxes. Click a row to open that locker's box layout.

admin-layout-sidebar-collapse.title: "Collapse" / "Expand"
admin-layout-sidebar-collapse.body: Shrinks the menu to icons (hover to see page names) for more working space; click again to expand. On narrow screens open the menu with the ☰ button.

admin-layout-sidebar-top.title: Everyday pages
admin-layout-sidebar-top.body: Dashboard, Orders, Stored items and Notifications always sit at the top. The current page is highlighted.

admin-layout-sidebar-groups.title: Menu groups
admin-layout-sidebar-groups.body: Other pages are grouped into Lockers & operations, Drone, Finance, Users, Rewards & feedback and System. Click a group name to fold or unfold it; the choice is remembered. Only pages your account may see are shown.

admin-layout-sidebar-account.title: Your account
admin-layout-sidebar-account.body: Name and role of the signed-in account. Click it for the "Settings" and "Logout" menu.

admin-layout-search-input.title: Type a page name
admin-layout-search-input.body: Type a page name in Vietnamese (with or without accents) or English and the list filters instantly. Ctrl + K (⌘K) opens or closes this panel anywhere.

admin-layout-search-list.title: "Admin pages"
admin-layout-search-list.body: Only pages your account may open, with the short path on the right. Use the arrow keys and Enter, or click, to open one.

admin-layout-notifications-head.title: Unread items
admin-layout-notifications-head.body: How many of your notifications are unread; "View All" opens the Notifications page. The bell refreshes every 30 seconds.

admin-layout-notifications-list.title: Latest 5
admin-layout-notifications-list.body: Unread items have a dot in front and a tinted background. Click one to mark it read and open the related page (order, refund, drone incident, maintenance…).

admin-layout-notifications-footer.title: "Open notification center"
admin-layout-notifications-footer.body: Opens the Notifications page to browse, filter and send notifications to users.

admin-layout-account-info.title: Signed-in account
admin-layout-account-info.body: Name and email of the admin account in use.

admin-layout-account-preferences.title: "Settings"
admin-layout-account-preferences.body: Opens your personal options: language, theme, on-screen guide and a shortcut to Business rules.

admin-layout-account-logout.title: "Logout"
admin-layout-account-logout.body: Ends the session in this browser and returns to sign-in; next time you need your password and the two-step code again.

admin-preferences-open.title: Open "Settings"
admin-preferences-open.body: Click your account name at the bottom of the left menu, then choose "Settings".

admin-preferences-language.title: "Language"
admin-preferences-language.body: Choose the display language; the page switches at once without reloading.

admin-preferences-theme.title: "Theme"
admin-preferences-theme.body: Three buttons Light / System / Dark, same as the theme menu at the top.

admin-preferences-guide.title: "On-screen guide"
admin-preferences-guide.body: Opens the guide list to replay any section, even after choosing "Skip forever"; turn automatic guides on or off there.

admin-preferences-business.title: "Business rules"
admin-preferences-business.body: Goes to the page for prices, fees, deadlines, SLAs and limits — these apply to everyone, unlike personal options.

admin-preferences-close.title: "Close"
admin-preferences-close.body: Closes the box. Language and theme were saved as soon as you picked them, in this browser.

admin-notifications-actions.title: "Broadcast" / "Create Notification"
admin-notifications-actions.body: "Broadcast" sends the same message to all users or a list of IDs; "Create Notification" sends to one person.

admin-notifications-stats.title: Stats
admin-notifications-stats.body: Total, unread, read and the average time from sending to the recipient opening it.

admin-notifications-filters.title: Search and filter
admin-notifications-filters.body: Search by title, content, recipient or ID; filter by read status and by notification type (with a count per type).

admin-notifications-toolbar.title: "Clear filters" / "Reload"
admin-notifications-toolbar.body: Remove all filters, or reload the latest list.

admin-notifications-batch.title: Delete several
admin-notifications-batch.body: Tick rows and use "Delete selected", or "Delete all" for everything matching the filters. You are asked for a reason first.

admin-notifications-table.title: Notification list
admin-notifications-table.body: Recipient, title, type, read status and time sent. Change page and rows per page at the bottom.

admin-notifications-menu.title: Row "…" menu
admin-notifications-menu.body: "Mark as Read" (when unread), "Resend" to the recipient, or "Delete" (a reason is required).

admin-notifications-broadcast-type.title: "Notification Type"
admin-notifications-broadcast-type.body: "System": tapping opens the notification details in the app; "Promotion": tapping opens the Promotions tab in the app.

admin-notifications-broadcast-subject.title: "Title"
admin-notifications-broadcast-subject.body: Required; the headline recipients see first.

admin-notifications-broadcast-target.title: "Target Audience"
admin-notifications-broadcast-target.body: "All Users", or "Specific" and enter user IDs separated by commas.

admin-notifications-broadcast-submit.title: "Send Broadcast"
admin-notifications-broadcast-submit.body: Sends at once and reports how many people received it; "Cancel" closes without sending.

admin-notifications-create-type.title: "Notification Type"
admin-notifications-create-type.body: "System": tapping opens the notification details in the app; "Promotion": tapping opens the Promotions tab in the app.

admin-notifications-create-recipient.title: Recipient and order
admin-notifications-create-recipient.body: Enter the "Recipient ID" (required) — the name appears so you can check it; add the "Related Order ID" if the message is about an order.

admin-notifications-create-subject.title: "Title"
admin-notifications-create-subject.body: Required; the headline the recipient sees first.

admin-notifications-create-submit.title: "Send Notification"
admin-notifications-create-submit.body: Sends to the recipient at once; "Cancel" closes without sending.

admin-notifications-row-menu-items.title: "…" menu
admin-notifications-row-menu-items.body: "Mark as Read" (only while unread), "Resend" to the recipient, "Delete" — opens a box asking for a reason before deleting. While working, the "…" button shows a spinner.

admin-feedback-reports-tabs.title: Three tabs
admin-feedback-reports-tabs.body: "Incident Reports" (customers reporting locker problems), "Service Ratings" (stars and comments after an order) and "Metrics & Statistics".

admin-feedback-reports-filter.title: Status filter
admin-feedback-reports-filter.body: Show "Pending", "In Progress" or "Resolved" reports; the count on the right matches the filter.

admin-feedback-reports-table.title: Report list
admin-feedback-reports-table.body: Reporter, locker and box, description, status, created and resolved times.

admin-feedback-reports-resolve.title: "Resolve"
admin-feedback-reports-resolve.body: Opens a box to note the fix and attach acceptance photos, then marks it resolved. Only on unresolved reports.

admin-feedback-reports-pages.title: Pages
admin-feedback-reports-pages.body: With more than 20 reports use "Previous" / "Next" to page through.

admin-feedback-ratings-filters.title: Filter ratings
admin-feedback-ratings-filters.body: Filter by exact star rating (1–5) and "Unresolved" / "Resolved"; the total is on the right.

admin-feedback-ratings-table.title: Rating list
admin-feedback-ratings-table.body: Customer, stars, comment, order code, status and time. Click a row or the eye icon to open it.

admin-feedback-analytics-period.title: "Daily / Weekly / Monthly"
admin-feedback-analytics-period.body: Change the range of the rating chart: last 14 days, 12 weeks or 12 months.

admin-feedback-analytics-trend.title: Rating volume
admin-feedback-analytics-trend.body: Each bar is the number of ratings in one period; hover to see the average stars too.

admin-feedback-analytics-overview.title: "Ratings Overview"
admin-feedback-analytics-overview.body: Average score, ratings today / this week / this month, the 1–5 star split and how many await handling.

admin-feedback-analytics-satisfaction.title: "Satisfaction Metrics"
admin-feedback-analytics-satisfaction.body: Satisfaction score 0–100, NPS on the 5-star scale, positive / negative shares, the top complaint of the last 90 days and scores per service.

admin-feedback-detail-open.title: Open a rating
admin-feedback-detail-open.body: In the "Service Ratings" tab, click a row to see its details.

admin-feedback-detail-status.title: Handling status
admin-feedback-detail-status.body: The "Pending" / "Resolved" label; click "Mark as Resolved" when done or "Mark as Pending" to reopen. Who resolved it and when appears below.

admin-feedback-detail-rating.title: "Rating Details"
admin-feedback-detail-rating.body: Stars, satisfaction level, the customer's comment and the related order (click the code to open it).

admin-feedback-detail-replied.title: Reply sent
admin-feedback-detail-replied.body: The previous admin reply and when it was sent.

admin-feedback-detail-reply.title: Reply to the customer
admin-feedback-detail-reply.body: Write an answer and click "Send Reply"; the customer gets an app notification. Once replied, this box becomes "Update Reply".

admin-feedback-detail-customer.title: "Customer Information"
admin-feedback-detail-customer.body: Name, customer ID, email and phone in case you need to follow up.

admin-feedback-detail-history.title: "History"
admin-feedback-detail-history.body: Milestones: rating created, admin replied, resolved, last updated.

admin-scheduler-status.title: "System status"
admin-scheduler-status.body: Whether the scheduler is running or off and which service runs the jobs. If it cannot connect, a retry button appears.

admin-scheduler-auto.title: "Automated jobs"
admin-scheduler-auto.body: The 5 recurring jobs and how often each runs; dimmed when the scheduler is not running.

admin-scheduler-jobs.title: Job cards
admin-scheduler-jobs.body: Each card explains what the job does (auto-cancel unpaid orders, pickup reminders, move overdue orders to storage, reconcile boxes, release boxes) and its server-time schedule.

admin-scheduler-run.title: "Run now"
admin-scheduler-run.body: Runs a job by hand to test or handle something urgently, same result as a scheduled run. Jobs that change many records (cancelling, moving to storage, reconciling boxes) ask for confirmation first.

admin-scheduler-results.title: "Job history"
admin-scheduler-results.body: Results of manual runs: success or error and how many orders or boxes were affected. Keeps the last 10 runs in this browser session.

admin-scheduler-info.title: "Information"
admin-scheduler-info.body: Notes on the default schedule, server time (UTC) and what a manual run means.

admin-settings-tabs.title: Rule groups
admin-settings-tabs.body: 8 groups by service; a tab with unsaved changes shows an orange count. Switching tabs keeps drafts; leaving the page with drafts asks first.

admin-settings-search.title: Find a rule
admin-settings-search.body: Search by name, key or description in the current group; click × to clear.

admin-settings-head.title: Group summary
admin-settings-head.body: What the group covers, how many rules and how many differ from the default.

admin-settings-actions.title: "Change History" / "Refresh"
admin-settings-actions.body: See who changed what and when in this group, or reload the latest values from the server.

admin-settings-group.title: Rules by section
admin-settings-group.body: Rules are grouped into sections; each box header shows the section name and rule count.

admin-settings-row.title: One rule
admin-settings-row.body: Name, description, key, default value and last update. "Customized" means it differs from the default (with "Restore Default"); "Public" means apps can read it without signing in.

admin-settings-input.title: Edit a value
admin-settings-input.body: Type a number, toggle or pick a value within the limits (errors show in red). Edited rows turn yellow "Unsaved"; the bottom bar has "Cancel" and "Save changes", which lists old → new to confirm.

admin-settings-history.title: "View history"
admin-settings-history.body: Opens the change history of just this rule.

admin-settings-scopes-order.title: "Orders & Pricing"
admin-settings-scopes-order.body: Shipping and locker rental prices, storage fees, pickup deadlines and automatic order cancellation.

admin-settings-scopes-locker.title: "Lockers & Maintenance"
admin-settings-scopes-locker.body: Incident handling SLAs, penalty thresholds, acceptance photos, box holds and drones.

admin-settings-scopes-payment.title: "Payments"
admin-settings-scopes-payment.body: Payment methods, refunds and payment simulation.

admin-settings-scopes-iot.title: "IoT Devices"
admin-settings-scopes-iot.body: Temporary lockout after repeated wrong entries, door open and close timeouts.

admin-settings-scopes-auth.title: "Authentication"
admin-settings-scopes-auth.body: OTP validity and length, temporary token lifetime, splash screen duration.

admin-settings-scopes-loyalty.title: "Loyalty"
admin-settings-scopes-loyalty.body: Membership tier thresholds, stamps and loyalty points.

admin-settings-scopes-store.title: "Stores"
admin-settings-scopes-store.body: Default radius when searching for nearby stores.

admin-settings-scopes-assistant.title: "Q&A Assistant"
admin-settings-scopes-assistant.body: Assistant on/off, minimum relevance threshold, number of document chunks attached, hourly question limit and number of conversation turns remembered.

admin-settings-history-filter.title: Filter by rule
admin-settings-history-filter.body: Choose "All rules" or one rule; the button on the right reloads the history.

admin-settings-history-list.title: Changes
admin-settings-history-list.body: Each entry: the rule, old → new value (or "Restore Default"), who changed it and when. Click a rule name to see only its history.

admin-knowledge-documents-header.title: "Knowledge Base"
admin-knowledge-documents-header.body: The assistant answers only from documents here. "Assistant Settings" opens the Q&A Assistant tab in Business rules (on/off, threshold, limits).

admin-knowledge-documents-alert.title: Assistant warning
admin-knowledge-documents-alert.body: Shown when the server lacks model API keys or the assistant is off, with what to do.

admin-knowledge-documents-tabs.title: Three tabs
admin-knowledge-documents-tabs.body: "Documents", users' "Conversations" with the assistant, and retrieval quality "Evaluation".

admin-knowledge-documents-stats.title: Document counts
admin-knowledge-documents-stats.body: Total documents and how many are "Ready", "Processing" (waiting or indexing) and "Failed".

admin-knowledge-documents-toolbar.title: Search, refresh, upload
admin-knowledge-documents-toolbar.body: Search by title or file name, "Refresh" the list, "Upload Document" to add one.

admin-knowledge-documents-table.title: Document list
admin-knowledge-documents-table.body: Status, roles allowed, chunk count, size and indexing time. Click a title to view its content; while something is processing the list refreshes itself.

admin-knowledge-documents-actions.title: Per-document actions
admin-knowledge-documents-actions.body: View content, edit title / roles, re-index (costs embedding fees; use after an error) and delete. Re-index and delete ask for confirmation.

admin-knowledge-upload-file.title: "Document file"
admin-knowledge-upload-file.body: Drag and drop or click to choose a Markdown, TXT, HTML, PDF or DOCX file, up to 20 MB.

admin-knowledge-upload-name.title: "Title"
admin-knowledge-upload-name.body: Leave empty to use the file name. The assistant cites and the evaluation matches by this title.

admin-knowledge-upload-roles.title: Who may use it
admin-knowledge-upload-roles.body: "All users" means every signed-in account; internal documents (technical procedures…) should be limited to the right roles.

admin-knowledge-upload-submit.title: "Upload"
admin-knowledge-upload-submit.body: The document is queued for indexing; the list updates itself when done.

admin-knowledge-doc-detail-meta.title: Document details
admin-knowledge-doc-detail-meta.body: File name, size, status, indexing time and roles allowed.

admin-knowledge-doc-detail-actions.title: "Download Original" / "Refresh"
admin-knowledge-doc-detail-actions.body: Download the exact uploaded file, or refresh the chunk list.

admin-knowledge-doc-detail-search.title: Search chunks
admin-knowledge-doc-detail-search.body: Filter chunks by keyword to check the assistant can read what it needs.

admin-knowledge-doc-detail-chunks.title: Chunks the assistant reads
admin-knowledge-doc-detail-chunks.body: The document split by section; each chunk shows its heading path, position and length. This is exactly what the assistant answers from.

admin-knowledge-edit-name.title: "Title"
admin-knowledge-edit-name.body: Required. Renaming means evaluation cases pointing to the old title must be updated.

admin-knowledge-edit-roles.title: Allowed roles
admin-knowledge-edit-roles.body: Change who can get answers from this document; applies at once without re-indexing.

admin-knowledge-edit-submit.title: "Save"
admin-knowledge-edit-submit.body: Saves the changes; "Cancel" closes without changing anything.

admin-knowledge-conversations-filter.title: Filter by user
admin-knowledge-conversations-filter.body: Enter a user ID and click "Filter" to see only that person's conversations; "Clear filter" shows all again.

admin-knowledge-conversations-table.title: Conversation list
admin-knowledge-conversations-table.body: User (click for their profile), title, message count, start and last update. Click a row or "View" to read it.

admin-knowledge-conversations-pages.title: Pages
admin-knowledge-conversations-pages.body: 20 conversations per page, most recent first; use "Previous" / "Next".

admin-knowledge-conversation-open.title: Open a conversation
admin-knowledge-conversation-open.body: In the "Conversations" tab, click a row to read it.

admin-knowledge-conversation-meta.title: Summary
admin-knowledge-conversation-meta.body: User, messages, answers and refusals, last update; "Refresh" reloads it.

admin-knowledge-conversation-messages.title: Messages and sources
admin-knowledge-conversation-messages.body: Questions and answers in order; each answer shows its top relevance score and cited sources, or a refusal label when the documents do not cover it.

admin-knowledge-eval-summary.title: Evaluation set
admin-knowledge-eval-summary.body: How many cases, how many must hit a document and how many must be refused. Rerun after changing documents or the threshold.

admin-knowledge-eval-add.title: "Add Case"
admin-knowledge-eval-add.body: Add one question with its expected document, or mark it as must-refuse.

admin-knowledge-eval-import.title: "Import JSON"
admin-knowledge-eval-import.body: Paste a whole set as JSON; it is validated before import.

admin-knowledge-eval-run.title: "Run Retrieval Evaluation"
admin-knowledge-eval-run.body: Runs every case, retrieval only (only question embedding costs). Results appear on the page: passed, document hits, correct refusals; turn on "Show failed only" to dig in.

admin-knowledge-eval-generate.title: "Run with Answer Generation"
admin-knowledge-eval-generate.body: Same as above but asks Claude to answer each case so you see real answers — costs model fees, asks for confirmation first.

admin-knowledge-eval-cases.title: Case list
admin-knowledge-eval-cases.body: Question, asker role, expected document or "Must refuse" (with a warning when no document has that title), and creation date.

admin-knowledge-eval-delete.title: Delete a case
admin-knowledge-eval-delete.body: Remove a case from the set (asks for confirmation).

admin-knowledge-add-case-question.title: "Question"
admin-knowledge-add-case-question.body: Something a user might ask, written naturally as in the app.

admin-knowledge-add-case-roles.title: "Asker's roles"
admin-knowledge-add-case-roles.body: Only documents open to these roles (or "All users") are searched. None ticked = Customer.

admin-knowledge-add-case-refuse.title: "Must refuse"
admin-knowledge-add-case-refuse.body: Turn on for out-of-scope questions or internal documents the asker may not read; it passes when no chunk passes the relevance threshold.

admin-knowledge-add-case-expected.title: "Expected document"
admin-knowledge-add-case-expected.body: Pick the document the case must retrieve, or "Enter another title…". Hidden when "Must refuse" is on.

admin-knowledge-add-case-submit.title: "Add" / "Save and Add Another"
admin-knowledge-add-case-submit.body: "Add" saves and closes; "Save and Add Another" keeps the box open for the next case.

admin-knowledge-import-example.title: "Insert Example"
admin-knowledge-import-example.body: Fills in a correctly formatted sample to edit.

admin-knowledge-import-json.title: Paste JSON
admin-knowledge-import-json.body: An array of cases { question, roles?, expectedDocumentTitle?, mustRefuse }. It is checked as you type: each error, or how many cases are valid.

admin-knowledge-import-submit.title: "Import"
admin-knowledge-import-submit.body: Only enabled when there are no errors; the cases are added to the set.

admin-guide-manual-header.title: "User guide"
admin-guide-manual-header.body: Admins can read the guides of every role (web, app, kiosk), grouped by role. "Open manual" in the guide list jumps straight to a section.

admin-guide-manual-group.title: One area
admin-guide-manual-group.body: Area name, where it is used ("Admin web", "Mobile app", "At the locker (kiosk)"), a "New" / "Updated" badge if unseen, and a summary.

admin-guide-manual-image.title: Screenshot
admin-guide-manual-image.body: A real screenshot with each part circled in red and numbered.

admin-guide-manual-steps.title: Numbered notes
admin-guide-manual-steps.body: One line per number on the image: the part and how to use it.

admin-guide-manual-run.title: "Show on screen"
admin-guide-manual-run.body: Opens the right page and highlights each part live. Not available for mobile app, kiosk or pre-sign-in sections.

customer-login-language.title: Choose a language
customer-login-language.body: Tap "VI" or "EN" to switch the app language right on the sign-in screen.

customer-login-tabs.title: Log in or sign up
customer-login-tabs.body: Switch between the "Log in" and "Sign up" tabs. The "Don't have an account? Sign up now" line at the bottom also opens sign-up.

customer-login-identifier.title: Email or phone number
customer-login-identifier.body: Enter the email or phone number of your account.

customer-login-password.title: Password
customer-login-password.body: Enter your password; tap the eye icon to show or hide it.

customer-login-links.title: OTP and forgotten password
customer-login-links.body: "Log in with OTP": enter your email above and tap it, then type the 6-digit code sent to your email and tap "Confirm". "Forgot password?" opens the reset page.

customer-login-social.title: Google or phone number
customer-login-social.body: Under "Or continue with": "Google" signs in with your Google account, "Phone" signs in with an SMS code.

customer-login-submit.title: Log in button
customer-login-submit.body: Tap "Log in" to enter the app. The first time you may be asked to accept the terms and complete your details.

customer-register-name.title: Full name
customer-register-name.body: Enter your name; it is shown on orders and to support.

customer-register-email.title: Email
customer-register-email.body: Required. Used to sign in and to receive OTP codes and order updates.

customer-register-phone.title: Phone number
customer-register-phone.body: Required. Used to sign in and to receive locker codes.

customer-register-password.title: Password
customer-register-password.body: Choose a password of at least 6 characters; tap the eye to check it.

customer-register-terms.title: Accept the terms
customer-register-terms.body: Tick the box before creating the account. Tap "Terms of service" or "Privacy policy" to read them.

customer-register-submit.title: Create account
customer-register-submit.body: Tap "Create account". You are usually signed in right away; otherwise the app switches to "Log in" with your email/phone filled in.

customer-login-phone-number.title: Enter your number
customer-login-phone-number.body: Use a local (0xxx) or international (+84xxx) number. If you have no account, one is created when you confirm the code.

customer-login-phone-send.title: Send and confirm the code
customer-login-phone-send.body: Tap "Send OTP code", then type the 6-digit SMS code (it confirms itself once complete). You can "Change phone number" or "Resend code" after the countdown.

customer-forgot-password-email.title: Registered email
customer-forgot-password-email.body: Enter the email of the account whose password you want to reset.

customer-forgot-password-submit.title: Send code and reset
customer-forgot-password-submit.body: Tap "Send OTP code"; then enter the code, a new password (6+ characters), confirm it and tap "Reset password". Tap "Resend OTP code" for a new code.

admin-mobile-notice-intro.title: Use the web console
admin-mobile-notice-intro.body: An admin signing in to the app sees the "Admin account" screen: the admin console is only available in a browser.

admin-mobile-notice-logout.title: Log out
admin-mobile-notice-logout.body: Tap "Log out", then log in with a customer or technician account if you need the app.

customer-profile-info.title: Personal information
customer-profile-info.body: See your email, phone, account status and password. The pencil at the top also opens it.

customer-profile-loyalty.title: Reward points
customer-profile-loyalty.body: See your points, membership tier, how to earn and use points, and the history.

customer-profile-security.title: Security
customer-profile-security.body: Turn on the fingerprint/face app lock and change or set your password.

customer-profile-vouchers.title: Offers & gifts
customer-profile-vouchers.body: Open your voucher collection: usable codes, exchanging points for vouchers, and used ones.

customer-loyalty-refresh.title: Refresh
customer-loyalty-refresh.body: Tap to reload your latest points and history.

customer-loyalty-summary.title: Points and tier
customer-loyalty-summary.body: Current points, membership tier, points needed for the next tier and lifetime points (spending points never lowers your tier).

customer-loyalty-rules.title: Earning and using points
customer-loyalty-rules.body: How points are earned when an order completes and used as a discount at checkout, per the current settings.

customer-loyalty-history.title: Points history
