customer-loyalty-history.body: Every point earned, spent, returned or reversed, per order. Pull down to refresh.

customer-profile-detail-edit.title: Edit profile
customer-profile-detail-edit.body: Tap the pencil to change your name, phone, email and avatar.

customer-profile-detail-disabled.title: Account disabled
customer-profile-detail-disabled.body: If you see this warning your account is disabled; please contact support.

customer-profile-detail-card.title: Photo, name and status
customer-profile-detail-card.body: Your avatar, name and account status (active, not activated or locked).

customer-profile-detail-email.title: Your email
customer-profile-detail-email.body: The email is masked; tap the eye icon to show or hide it.

customer-profile-detail-phone.title: Phone number
customer-profile-detail-phone.body: Tap the eye to show or hide it; "Not set" means no number yet.

customer-profile-detail-password.title: Password
customer-profile-detail-password.body: Tap to open Security and change your password; Google/OTP accounts without one can set it there.

customer-profile-edit-avatar.title: Avatar
customer-profile-edit-avatar.body: Tap the camera icon to "Take photo", "Choose from gallery" or "Remove profile photo".

customer-profile-edit-phone.title: Phone number
customer-profile-edit-phone.body: Enter 9–12 digits (a leading + is allowed). Once set, it cannot be removed.

customer-profile-edit-email.title: Email
customer-profile-edit-email.body: Optional. Changing your phone or email also changes your sign-in details.

customer-profile-edit-save.title: Save
customer-profile-edit-save.body: Tap "Save" to update your profile and go back.

customer-security-biometric.title: Biometric lock
customer-security-biometric.body: Turn on "Biometric app lock" to require fingerprint/face each time the app opens (biometrics must be set up on the device).

customer-security-password.title: Change or set password
customer-security-password.body: Enter your current password, the new one and its confirmation, then tap "Change password"; other devices must sign in again. Google/OTP accounts see "Set password".

customer-profile-manage-notifications.title: Notifications
customer-profile-manage-notifications.body: Open your notifications; the red number is how many are unread.

customer-profile-manage-delegations.title: Delegated orders
customer-profile-manage-delegations.body: See orders others asked you to pick up; the blue number is how many are still active.

customer-profile-manage-refunds.title: Refunds
customer-profile-manage-refunds.body: Request a refund for a problem order and follow the transfer status.

customer-profile-manage-transactions.title: Transactions
customer-profile-manage-transactions.body: See your payment history and spending by day, month and year.

customer-profile-manage-reports.title: My reports
customer-profile-manage-reports.body: Follow the locker incident reports you sent and file a new one.

customer-profile-manage-ble-test.title: Test opening via Bluetooth
customer-profile-manage-ble-test.body: Only shown when an admin has allowed your account to test opening boxes over Bluetooth.

customer-profile-settings-language.title: Language
customer-profile-settings-language.body: Choose "Tiếng Việt" or "English"; the app reloads in the new language.

customer-profile-settings-location.title: Location
customer-profile-settings-location.body: See the location permission status and tap "Grant location permission", "Open app settings" or "Turn on location". It is used to find nearby lockers, give directions and tag incident photos.

customer-profile-support-assistant.title: Lock.R AI assistant
customer-profile-support-assistant.body: Ask the assistant; answers come from official documents with sources.

customer-profile-support-quick-help.title: Quick help
customer-profile-support-quick-help.body: A summary of sending parcels, renting a locker, what to do if a box will not open, and payment.

customer-profile-support-contact.title: Contact
customer-profile-support-contact.body: See the support email, website and support hours; tap the email or website to open it.

customer-profile-support-terms.title: Terms of service
customer-profile-support-terms.body: Read the terms. The "Agreed"/"Not agreed" label shows your consent; if not yet, tick to agree at the bottom of the page.

customer-profile-support-privacy.title: Privacy policy
customer-profile-support-privacy.body: Read what data is collected and how it is protected.

customer-profile-support-logout.title: Log out
customer-profile-support-logout.body: Tap and confirm "Log out" to leave your account on this device.

customer-refunds-actions.title: Refresh and rules
customer-refunds-actions.body: The circular arrow reloads the list; "?" opens the "Refund rules" (eligible cases, processing time).

customer-refunds-tabs.title: Two tabs
customer-refunds-tabs.body: "My requests" lists the requests you sent; "New request" opens the refund form.

customer-refunds-filters.title: Filter by status
customer-refunds-filters.body: Filter "All", "Recent", "Pending", "Transferred", plus "Rejected" and "Cancelled" when present. Tap the active filter again to go back to "All".

customer-refunds-first.title: A request
customer-refunds-first.body: Each card shows the refund amount, order, date sent, status and whether photos/receipts exist. Tap for details.

customer-refunds-empty.title: No requests yet
customer-refunds-empty.body: Tap "Request a refund now" to open the form.

customer-refund-create-order.title: 1. Choose the order
customer-refund-create-order.body: Tap to pick a paid order to refund; tap "Change" to pick another.

customer-refund-create-bank.title: 2. Receiving account
customer-refund-create-bank.body: Choose the bank, enter the account number and holder name (capitals, no accents). Tick "Save as default refund account" to prefill it next time.

customer-refund-create-reason.title: 3. Reason
customer-refund-create-reason.body: Tap a ready-made reason (stuck box, cancelled drone flight, double charge, laundry issue) to add it to the box below, or type your own. Required.

customer-refund-create-evidence.title: 4. Evidence photo
customer-refund-create-evidence.body: Optional: "Take photo" or "From gallery" to attach one photo; you can change or remove it.

customer-refund-create-submit.title: Send the request
customer-refund-create-submit.body: Check the "Expected refund" and tap "Submit refund request". It then appears under "My requests".

customer-refund-account-intro.title: One-time setup
customer-refund-account-intro.body: Refunds for problem orders are sent straight to this account, so you do not retype it each time.

customer-refund-account-bank.title: Beneficiary bank
customer-refund-account-bank.body: Tap to choose the bank; search by name or code.

customer-refund-account-number.title: Account number
customer-refund-account-number.body: Enter the bank account number (at least 6 digits).

customer-refund-account-holder.title: Account holder
customer-refund-account-holder.body: Enter the holder name; letters are capitalised automatically.

customer-refund-account-save.title: Save
customer-refund-account-save.body: Tap "Save refund account" (or "Update account" if one exists) to save.

customer-refund-detail-amount.title: Amount and status
customer-refund-detail-amount.body: The refund amount and its status: awaiting an admin, transferred or rejected.

customer-refund-detail-info.title: Refund details
customer-refund-detail-info.body: Order, receiving account, reason, transfer ID, rejection reason and times. Tap the copy icon to copy the order code or transfer ID.

customer-refund-detail-evidence.title: Documents & photos
customer-refund-detail-evidence.body: The evidence photo you sent and the admin transfer receipt; tap a picture to enlarge it.

customer-refund-detail-close.title: Close
customer-refund-detail-close.body: Tap "Close" to return to the list.

customer-transactions-refresh.title: Refresh
customer-transactions-refresh.body: Tap to reload transactions and statistics.

customer-transactions-period.title: Choose a period
customer-transactions-period.body: Pick "Today", "This month", "This year" or "All" for the figures.

customer-transactions-metrics.title: Spending and income
customer-transactions-metrics.body: "Total spent", "Total in" and the "Net change" line (with the number of transactions) for the period.

customer-transactions-breakdown.title: Spending breakdown
customer-transactions-breakdown.body: Switch "Service" / "Method" to see spending per service or per payment method.

customer-transactions-filter.title: Filter by method
customer-transactions-filter.body: Filter the list: "All methods", "SePay gateway"; older payment methods only appear for old transactions.

customer-transactions-first.title: A transaction
customer-transactions-first.body: Grouped by day; green is money in, orange is money out. Tap to see method, type, direction, time, transaction ID and order code.

customer-notifications-actions.title: Top buttons
customer-notifications-actions.body: Bin: delete all (asks first); "Mark all as read": mark everything read when some are unread; circular arrow: reload.

customer-notifications-first.title: A notification
customer-notifications-first.body: Unread ones have a light blue background. Tap to open the related screen (or the full text); swipe left to delete.

customer-notifications-empty.title: No notifications
customer-notifications-empty.body: New updates about orders, refunds and incidents appear here.

customer-vouchers-tabs.title: Three tabs
customer-vouchers-tabs.body: "Available": usable codes; "Redeem points": swap reward points for vouchers; "History": used or expired codes.

customer-vouchers-first.title: A voucher
customer-vouchers-first.body: The card shows the discount or gift and the expiry. Tap to see the code and how to use it.

customer-vouchers-empty.title: No vouchers yet
customer-vouchers-empty.body: Tap "Explore offers and save codes" to open Offers and save codes to your collection.

customer-voucher-detail-ticket.title: Voucher card
customer-voucher-detail-ticket.body: The discount or gift, campaign and expiry.

customer-voucher-detail-code.title: Voucher code
customer-voucher-detail-code.body: Tap the code to copy it, then paste it when ordering.

customer-voucher-detail-info.title: Details
customer-voucher-detail-info.body: Offer, campaign, scope, status and valid-until date.

customer-voucher-detail-howto.title: How to use
customer-voucher-detail-howto.body: Copy the code, place an order (at the eligible locker if any), enter it in "Discount code" and tap Apply.

customer-promotions-refresh.title: Refresh
customer-promotions-refresh.body: Tap to reload the active offers.

customer-promotions-first.title: An offer
customer-promotions-first.body: The card shows the discount, conditions and expiry; "Expiring soon" is in red. Tap the card for details.

customer-promotions-code.title: Copy the code
customer-promotions-code.body: Tap the code chip to copy the promo code.

customer-promotions-save.title: Save the code
customer-promotions-save.body: Tap "Save" to add the code to "My offers"; it is marked used once applied to an order.

customer-promotion-detail-ticket.title: Offer value
customer-promotion-detail-ticket.body: The discount and validity of the offer.

customer-promotion-detail-code.title: Promo code
customer-promotion-detail-code.body: Tap the code to copy it.

customer-promotion-detail-info.title: Conditions
customer-promotion-detail-info.body: Discount, scope, maximum discount, minimum order, start and end dates and status.

customer-promotion-detail-howto.title: How to use
customer-promotion-detail-howto.body: Follow the 3 steps to apply the code when ordering; expired offers cannot be used.

customer-vouchers-exchange-balance.title: Your points
customer-vouchers-exchange-balance.body: Your current points and the point-to-money rate.

customer-vouchers-exchange-first.title: Exchangeable voucher
customer-vouchers-exchange-first.body: Each card shows the points needed and minimum order. Tap "Redeem" and confirm; the voucher goes to "Available". "… short" means not enough points, "Owned" means you have it.

customer-assistant-history.title: Q&A history
customer-assistant-history.body: Open earlier conversations to review or continue them.

customer-assistant-new.title: New conversation
customer-assistant-new.body: Start fresh without the context of earlier questions.

customer-assistant-examples.title: Sample questions
customer-assistant-examples.body: Tap a question under "You can ask" to send it right away.

customer-assistant-composer.title: Question box
customer-assistant-composer.body: Type a question (accents optional; you can ask about your orders) and tap send. Answers have a "Sources" section: tap it to see the excerpts.

customer-assistant-status.title: Assistant unavailable
customer-assistant-status.body: This notice means the assistant is off or not ready yet; try again later.

customer-assistant-history-first.title: A conversation
customer-assistant-history-first.body: Tap to reopen it; swipe left or long-press to delete (asks first).

customer-assistant-history-empty.title: No conversations
customer-assistant-history-empty.body: Tap "Ask a question" to go back to the assistant.

customer-my-reports-tabs.title: Two tabs
customer-my-reports-tabs.body: "My reports" lists what you sent; "New report" opens the incident form on this page.

customer-my-reports-filters.title: Filter reports
customer-my-reports-filters.body: Filter "All", "Recent", "Awaiting", "Processing", "Done", and "Photo" when some have photos.

customer-my-reports-first.title: An incident report
customer-my-reports-first.body: The card shows the ticket number, status, locker, box, time sent and photo count. Tap for details.

customer-my-reports-empty.title: No reports yet
customer-my-reports-empty.body: Tap "Report an issue now" to open the incident form.

customer-report-detail-head.title: Ticket and status
customer-report-detail-head.body: Ticket number, title and current status; X closes it.

customer-report-detail-locker.title: Locker
customer-report-detail-locker.body: Locker, box and address; tap "Directions to the kiosk" for a map route.

customer-report-detail-content.title: What you reported
customer-report-detail-content.body: Your description and photos; while the ticket is open, tap "Add photo"/"Add more photos" to send more.

customer-report-detail-progress.title: Progress
customer-report-detail-progress.body: Milestones from receipt, technician assignment and handling to completion, with the technical team’s reply.

customer-report-detail-rating.title: Rate the technician
customer-report-detail-rating.body: Once resolved, choose stars, add a comment and tap "Send rating".

customer-report-detail-close.title: Close
customer-report-detail-close.body: Tap "Close" to return to the list.

customer-report-create-title.title: Title
customer-report-create-title.body: Required. A short title for the issue.

customer-report-create-description.title: Description
customer-report-create-description.body: Required. Describe what happened: box will not open, stuck door, screen error…

customer-report-create-locker.title: Faulty locker
customer-report-create-locker.body: Required: tap to choose the locker. When reporting from an order it is filled in for you.

customer-report-create-box.title: Choose the box
customer-report-create-box.body: Optional: pick a box on the "Layout" or "Cards" view, or the screen for a kiosk issue; "Deselect" to start over.

customer-report-create-photos.title: Scene photos
customer-report-create-photos.body: At least 1 photo is needed (optional when reporting from an order): "Take photo" or "Choose several photos"; tap X on a photo to remove it.

customer-report-create-actions.title: Send the report
customer-report-create-actions.body: Tap "Send report" to submit; "Back" (or "Cancel / List" inside My reports) to cancel.

customer-policy-switch.title: Switch document
customer-policy-switch.body: Tap to switch between "Terms of service" and "Privacy policy".

customer-policy-consent-status.title: Consent status
customer-policy-consent-status.body: "You have agreed" with the time, or "You haven't agreed yet".

customer-policy-contents.title: Contents
customer-policy-contents.body: Tap a section to jump to it.

customer-policy-consent-bar.title: Agree to the terms
customer-policy-consent-bar.body: If you have not agreed, tick the box at the bottom and tap "Agree".

customer-first-login-terms.title: Accept the terms
customer-first-login-terms.body: If you have not agreed, a "Terms of service" box appears: read both documents, tick the box and tap "Agree and continue". Otherwise you can only "Log out".

customer-first-login-complete.title: Complete sign-up
customer-first-login-complete.body: The first time you sign in with a phone number, the app asks for your name and an optional email. Tap "Save" or "Later".

customer-first-login-contact.title: Add missing details
customer-first-login-contact.body: If your email or phone is missing, "Complete your account details" appears: "Update now" opens profile editing, "Later" reminds you in a few days.

customer-ble-test-not-allowed.title: Not allowed yet
customer-ble-test-not-allowed.body: If no admin has allowed your account at any locker, the page only shows this notice.

customer-ble-test-hint.title: Get ready
customer-ble-test-hint.body: Turn on Bluetooth and stand within 2 m of the locker; every opening is logged. With several lockers, pick one above.

customer-ble-test-boxes.title: Choose a box
customer-ble-test-boxes.body: Tap a box on the layout; a box holding an order asks for confirmation first.

customer-ble-test-open.title: Open over Bluetooth
customer-ble-test-open.body: Tap "Open compartment … via Bluetooth": the app fetches a code from the server and sends it to the locker. Close the door afterwards.

customer-home-banner.title: Send by drone
customer-home-banner.body: Tap the drone poster to ship from home: pick the receiving locker, a technician collects the parcel and a drone flies it there.

customer-home-avatar.title: Profile
customer-home-avatar.body: Tap your avatar to open Profile: personal details, security, refunds and the guide.

customer-home-assistant.title: AI assistant
customer-home-assistant.body: The round button in the middle opens the “AI assistant” to ask about orders, lockers, fees and how to use Lock.R.

customer-home-sections-active.title: Order in progress
customer-home-sections-active.body: Your latest unfinished order: code, service, box, locker, status, pickup deadline and 4 progress steps. Tap it for details (drone orders open tracking).

customer-home-sections-active-all.title: See all orders
customer-home-sections-active-all.body: Tap “See all” to jump to the “Orders” tab with all your orders.

customer-home-sections-kiosks.title: Kiosk locations
customer-home-sections-kiosks.body: The Lock.R lockers available. Tap “SEE ALL” to open the “Lockers” tab with search and map.

customer-home-sections-kiosk-list.title: Locker cards
customer-home-sections-kiosk-list.body: The strip scrolls by itself; touch it to stop and swipe. Each card shows name, address and status (Active, Maintenance, Disconnected…); tap one to see its box layout.

customer-home-utilities-offers.title: Offers
customer-home-utilities-offers.body: Open the running promotions and discount codes.

customer-home-utilities-report.title: Report an issue
customer-home-utilities-report.body: Report a faulty locker or box (stuck door, broken, dirty…) so a technician fixes it.

customer-home-utilities-reports.title: Reports
customer-home-utilities-reports.body: Review the issues you reported and how they are being handled.

customer-home-utilities-stores.title: Drop-off points
customer-home-utilities-stores.body: Open the list of stores hosting Lock.R lockers.

customer-home-utilities-favorites.title: Favorites
customer-home-utilities-favorites.body: The drop-off points you saved with the heart.

customer-home-utilities-drone.title: Send drone
customer-home-utilities-drone.body: Open the receiving-locker picker to ship by drone, same as the drone poster on Home.

customer-drone-picker-head.title: Send by drone
customer-drone-picker-head.body: Choose the receiving locker, nearest first. The system picks the launch locker and a technician collects the parcel at home.

customer-drone-picker-first.title: Receiving locker
customer-drone-picker-first.body: Each row shows distance, address and free drone boxes. Lockers without a pad, under maintenance or full are greyed out with the reason; tap an available one to open the booking form.

customer-lockers-map.title: Locker map
customer-lockers-map.body: Tap the pin icon to see every locker on a map.

customer-lockers-search.title: Search
customer-lockers-search.body: Type a name or address in “Search locations...”; tap × to clear.

customer-lockers-kiosks.title: Filter by kiosk
customer-lockers-kiosks.body: Pick a kiosk to show only its lockers; tap it again or choose “All” to clear. The number is the locker count.

customer-lockers-first.title: Locker card
customer-lockers-first.body: Lockers are grouped by “Kiosk: …”. A card shows status, distance and the “Most used” tag; tap it to see the box layout and book. Pull down to refresh.

customer-locker-grid-report.title: Report locker issue
customer-locker-grid-report.body: The button at the top opens the issue form for this locker.

customer-locker-grid-address.title: Locker location
customer-locker-grid-address.body: Where the locker stands; tap “Directions” for in-app navigation to it.

customer-locker-grid-kiosk.title: Kiosk point
customer-locker-grid-kiosk.body: The store hosting the kiosk, with its own “Directions” button.

customer-locker-grid-summary.title: Locker count
customer-locker-grid-summary.body: How many lockers are here; tap one to see its free boxes.

customer-locker-grid-card.title: Locker card
customer-locker-grid-card.body: Locker name, free/total boxes, status and a “Report an issue” chip. Tap to expand or collapse the layout; reopening reloads the boxes.

customer-locker-grid-legend.title: Colour legend
customer-locker-grid-legend.body: Box colours: Empty, In use, Reserved, Fault / Broken, Maintenance, Drone (purple), Suitcase (XL); the border tells if the door is open or closed.

customer-locker-grid-cells.title: Box layout
customer-locker-grid-cells.body: Tap an empty box to rent or send; an empty drone box opens a drone booking to this locker; a broken box shows why. Disconnected, maintenance or suspended lockers cannot be booked.

customer-locker-grid-screen.title: Kiosk screen
customer-locker-grid-screen.body: The “Screen” tile tells whether the kiosk is online, how to use PIN/QR there and offers “Report a kiosk screen issue”.

customer-locker-booking-cell.title: Pick an empty box
customer-locker-booking-cell.body: Tap a box marked “Empty” to open the booking sheet.

customer-locker-booking-info.title: Box info
customer-locker-booking-info.body: Size, position (box number) and status of the chosen box.

customer-locker-booking-rent.title: Rent a locker
customer-locker-booking-rent.body: Rent this exact box by the hour or day; the rental form opens with locker and box preset.

customer-locker-booking-send.title: Send parcel
customer-locker-booking-send.body: Send a parcel to someone through this box. Suitcase (XL) boxes are rental-only, so this button is hidden.

customer-locker-booking-report.title: Report this box
customer-locker-booking-report.body: Something wrong? Tap “Problem with this compartment? Report it now” to alert a technician.

customer-locker-map-view.title: Map
customer-locker-map-view.body: Red pins are Lock.R lockers. Drag and pinch to zoom; tap an empty spot to hide the preview card.

customer-locker-map-marker.title: Locker pin
customer-locker-map-marker.body: Tap a pin to show the locker name and address card at the bottom.

customer-locker-map-locate.title: Your location
customer-locker-map-locate.body: Tap “Use your location” to show a blue dot at your position and your address.

customer-locker-map-address.title: Current address
customer-locker-map-address.body: The address estimated from your position.

customer-locker-map-invalid.title: Hidden lockers
customer-locker-map-invalid.body: Tells how many lockers have invalid coordinates and are not shown.

customer-locker-detail-map-preview.title: Preview card
customer-locker-detail-map-preview.body: Name and address of the chosen locker; tap the card to open its detail page.

customer-locker-detail-map-info.title: Locker info
customer-locker-detail-map-info.body: A sheet you can drag up or down: address, connection status, free boxes by type and offers valid only here.

customer-locker-detail-map-actions.title: Book a service
customer-locker-detail-map-actions.body: “Book a service” lets you pick renting or sending with this locker preset; “View compartment layout” opens the boxes. Disabled with a reason when the locker is offline or under maintenance.

customer-locker-detail-map-directions.title: Directions
customer-locker-detail-map-directions.body: Open in-app navigation from your position to the locker.

customer-stores-actions.title: Favorites & refresh
customer-stores-actions.body: The heart opens your “Favorites”; the circular arrow reloads the list.

customer-stores-search.title: Search stores
customer-stores-search.body: Type a name or address to filter instantly; tap × to clear.

customer-stores-nearby.title: Near me
customer-stores-nearby.body: Use your current position to show only stores within the nearby radius, with distances.

customer-stores-first.title: Store card
customer-stores-first.body: Name, address, distance and “Open” status. Tap the heart to save or unsave, tap the card for details.

customer-store-detail-favorite.title: Save as favorite
customer-store-detail-favorite.body: Tap the heart to add or remove the store from “Favorites” (stored on this device).

customer-store-detail-info.title: Store info
customer-store-detail-info.body: Name, status, rating, address, phone, distance and description.

customer-store-detail-directions.title: Directions
customer-store-detail-directions.body: Open in-app navigation to the store; without coordinates it searches the address in your maps app.

customer-store-detail-lockers.title: View lockers
customer-store-detail-lockers.body: Open the store’s lockers; tap each to see its free boxes.

customer-store-detail-reviews.title: Customer reviews
customer-store-detail-reviews.body: Star ratings and comments from customers who used lockers here.

customer-directions-open.title: Open directions
customer-directions-open.body: Tap “Directions” on a store, locker or order page to open navigation.

customer-directions-header.title: Destination
customer-directions-header.body: The back button and the name of where you are heading.

customer-directions-card.title: Route
customer-directions-card.body: Name, address, distance and estimated time; during navigation it shows the remaining distance.

customer-directions-start.title: Navigate
customer-directions-start.body: “Start navigation” follows your position, “Stop navigation” ends it. Without a fix, tap “Get your location”.

customer-directions-external.title: Google Maps
customer-directions-external.body: Open the same destination in Google Maps (or Apple Maps).

customer-directions-recenter.title: Back to you
customer-directions-recenter.body: Recentre the map on your current position.

customer-favorites-intro.title: Favorites
customer-favorites-intro.body: Tap the heart in the store list or on a store page to save it here. The list is stored on this device.

customer-favorites-first.title: Saved store
customer-favorites-first.body: Tap the card for details; tap the heart to remove it. Pull down to refresh.

customer-favorites-explore.title: Explore stores
customer-favorites-explore.body: Nothing saved yet: tap to open the “Drop-off points” list.

customer-send-form-intro.title: Send via locker
customer-send-form-intro.body: You drop the parcel in a box with a PIN; the system then issues a new PIN to the recipient. The step bar at the top shows “Drop off” or “Recipient picks up”.

customer-send-form-locker.title: Choose locker
customer-send-form-locker.body: Pick an active locker for the parcel. When opened from a locker page (layout, “Book a service”) it is preset and locked.

customer-send-form-size.title: Box type
customer-send-form-size.body: Pick a small, medium or large box for the parcel; each shows how many are free. Sending uses standard boxes only; suitcase boxes are for rental.

customer-send-form-recipient.title: Recipient
customer-send-form-recipient.body: Enter the recipient’s phone number (required) and name (optional) just below.

customer-send-form-email.title: Recipient email
customer-send-form-email.body: Required: Lock.R emails the recipient once the order is paid and sends the pickup code when you drop the parcel.

customer-send-form-message.title: Message
customer-send-form-message.body: An optional note for the recipient, e.g. fragile item.

customer-send-form-storage.title: Storage time
customer-send-form-storage.body: Pick or slide how many hours the recipient has to collect; hours beyond those included cost extra.

customer-send-form-promo.title: Discount code
customer-send-form-promo.body: Enter a code valid for this locker; the discount shows in the subtotal at once.

customer-send-form-points.title: Reward points
customer-send-form-points.body: Turn on to spend reward points against the fee.

customer-send-form-bottom.title: Subtotal & create
customer-send-form-bottom.body: The subtotal includes fee, code and points. Tap “Create order & get drop-off PIN” to hold the box, then pay.

customer-payment-vietqr-intro.title: Pay by bank transfer
customer-payment-vietqr-intro.body: After creating an order, or tapping a pay button in order details, the app shows a VietQR code. The box is held meanwhile; unpaid orders cancel automatically.

customer-payment-vietqr-code.title: Scan the VietQR
customer-payment-vietqr-code.body: Scan it with your banking app to prefill account, amount and reference.

customer-payment-vietqr-amount.title: Amount to transfer
customer-payment-vietqr-amount.body: Transfer exactly this amount; if short, the app shows what is still missing.

customer-payment-vietqr-content.title: Transfer reference
customer-payment-vietqr-content.body: Keep this reference so the system matches your order; tap “Copy” for manual transfers.

customer-payment-vietqr-waiting.title: Waiting for payment
customer-payment-vietqr-waiting.body: The app updates as soon as the money arrives and shows “Payment successful!”; nothing else to tap.

customer-payment-vietqr-bank.title: Banking app
customer-payment-vietqr-bank.body: On a phone, tap “Pay with banking app” to pick your app and open a prefilled transfer.

customer-payment-vietqr-leave.title: Leaving before paying
customer-payment-vietqr-leave.body: Going back before paying asks “Cancel this order?”: choose “Stay and pay” or “Cancel order & exit”.

customer-send-drop-card.title: Order and drop-off PIN
customer-send-drop-card.body: Order code, status, payment, “Step 1 — Drop off the parcel” with the PIN/QR for the locker (tap the PIN to copy) and the recipient details to double-check.

customer-send-drop-open.title: Open compartment to drop off
customer-send-drop-open.body: Next to the locker, tap to open the box over Bluetooth; otherwise scan the QR sticker or use the PIN at the kiosk.

customer-send-drop-confirm.title: I’ve dropped off the parcel
customer-send-drop-confirm.body: Put the parcel in, close the door, then confirm. The system switches to the pickup PIN and notifies the recipient; confirming on the kiosk works too.

customer-send-done-card.title: Pickup code
customer-send-done-card.body: “Step 2 — Parcel dropped off” with the PIN/QR the recipient enters at the locker. Recipients with a Lock.R account see it in the app.

customer-send-done-share.title: Share the code
customer-send-done-share.body: “Share code with recipient” opens the share sheet, “Send SMS” prefills a text, “Copy message” lets you paste into any chat.

customer-send-done-deadline.title: Pickup deadline
customer-send-done-deadline.body: The recipient must collect before this time; late pickups may be charged per the policy.

customer-send-done-done.title: Done
customer-send-done-done.body: Close this screen and go to the “Orders” tab to follow the order.

customer-rent-form-intro.title: Rent a storage locker
customer-rent-form-intro.body: Rent a box for your things by the hour or day. The PIN opens it as many times as you need during the rental.

customer-rent-form-locker.title: Choose locker
customer-rent-form-locker.body: Pick an active locker. When opened from a locker page (layout, “Book a service”) it is preset and locked.

customer-rent-form-type.title: Box type
customer-rent-form-type.body: “Standard” or “Suitcase (XL)”, with size, rate and free boxes.

customer-rent-form-mode.title: By hour / By day
customer-rent-form-mode.body: Switch how you choose the rental time.

customer-rent-form-duration.title: Rental time
customer-rent-form-duration.body: By hour: pick or slide. By day: pick or tap −/+; each day is 24 hours from drop-off.

customer-rent-form-note.title: Note
customer-rent-form-note.body: An optional note for the rental.

customer-rent-form-promo.title: Discount code
customer-rent-form-promo.body: Enter a code valid for this locker.

customer-rent-form-points.title: Reward points
customer-rent-form-points.body: Turn on to spend reward points against the rental fee.

customer-rent-form-bottom.title: Subtotal & rent
customer-rent-form-bottom.body: Subtotal after discounts; tap “Rent now” to hold the box, then pay by VietQR.

customer-rent-result-card.title: Rental PIN
customer-rent-result-card.body: Order code, status, payment and the reusable PIN/QR; once running it shows the end time and overtime policy.

customer-rent-result-open.title: Open box to drop off
customer-rent-result-open.body: Your box is held: tap to open it (Bluetooth, QR sticker or kiosk PIN) and put your things in; the rental starts now.

customer-rent-result-pay.title: Pay the extension
customer-rent-result-pay.body: An extension is unpaid: tap “Pay …” before ending the rental.

customer-rent-result-done.title: See the order
customer-rent-result-done.body: Tap “Done — see it in My orders” to manage the rental: open, extend, end.

customer-drone-book-intro.title: How drone delivery works
customer-drone-book-intro.body: Once booked and paid, the nearest technician collects the parcel, loads it on a drone at the launch locker and it flies to the receiving box. The recipient opens it with a code sent by email. A banner warns when drone delivery is paused.

customer-drone-book-pickup.title: Pick up at
customer-drone-book-pickup.body: Tap the pickup field to use your position or drop a pin; add directions for the technician if needed.

customer-drone-book-sender.title: Sender
customer-drone-book-sender.body: Sender’s name, Vietnamese phone number and email (required).

customer-drone-book-receiver.title: Recipient & locker
customer-drone-book-receiver.body: Recipient name, phone and email, then pick the “Receiving locker” and “Receiving drone compartment”; the line below shows free drone boxes.

customer-drone-book-parcel.title: Parcel
customer-drone-book-parcel.body: Pick the weight (sets the fee) and category; add a description, size (must fit the bay), declared value and turn on “Fragile” if needed.

customer-drone-book-fee.title: Route and fee
customer-drone-book-fee.body: With a pickup point and locker set, the app shows the chosen launch locker, distance, fee and route weather; tap refresh to recalculate.

customer-drone-book-offers.title: Offers
customer-drone-book-offers.body: A discount code (valid for the chosen launch locker) and reward points, with the subtotal after discounts.

customer-drone-book-declare.title: No prohibited items
customer-drone-book-declare.body: Tick the pledge that the parcel has no loose batteries, liquids, flammables… before booking.

customer-drone-book-submit.title: Create the order
customer-drone-book-submit.body: Tap “Create order and pay …” to book and pay by VietQR. It is disabled when flights are paused, the weather is bad or the route is out of range; unpaid orders cancel automatically.

customer-drone-pickup-map-search.title: Search address
customer-drone-pickup-map-search.body: Type house number, street, ward…; tap a suggestion to move the pin there.

customer-drone-pickup-map-map.title: Pin on the map
customer-drone-pickup-map-map.body: Tap the map to drop the red pin exactly where to collect.

customer-drone-pickup-map-current.title: Current location
customer-drone-pickup-map-current.body: Tap to pin your phone’s position.

customer-drone-pickup-map-address.title: Pickup address
customer-drone-pickup-map-address.body: Filled from the pin; edit it for clarity (house, building, floor) if needed.

customer-drone-pickup-map-confirm.title: Pick up here
customer-drone-pickup-map-confirm.body: Confirm the pickup point and return to the booking form.

customer-drone-tracking-live.title: Live updates
customer-drone-tracking-live.body: The screen refreshes itself when the status changes and says when it is retrying. Pull down to reload.

customer-drone-tracking-header.title: Current stage
customer-drone-tracking-header.body: Stage name and description, with order code, drone code, time left while flying and when the stage began.

customer-drone-tracking-status.title: Delayed / not delivered
customer-drone-tracking-status.body: A late or failed delivery: reason, time and refund status.

customer-drone-tracking-block.title: Order paused
customer-drone-tracking-block.body: Blocked by an incident, weather or a flight stop; the team is on it and it closes automatically when overdue.

customer-drone-tracking-incident.title: Parcel drop incident
customer-drone-tracking-incident.body: If the drone reports a dropped parcel, this card shows progress and the options the team offers you.

customer-drone-tracking-weather.title: Route weather
customer-drone-tracking-weather.body: Wind and rain forecast on the route that decides whether drones may fly.

customer-drone-tracking-unpaid.title: Not paid yet
customer-drone-tracking-unpaid.body: The team only accepts paid orders: tap “Pay now”. After a weight mismatch choose “Pay the difference” or “Decline · cancel and get a refund”.

customer-drone-tracking-pickup.title: Home pickup
customer-drone-tracking-pickup.body: The pickup code to read to the technician, the pickup point and the technician’s name and phone.

customer-drone-tracking-route-drop.title: Place the parcel
customer-drone-tracking-route-drop.body: When asked, put the parcel in the drone box at the launch locker and tap “I’ve placed the parcel”.

customer-drone-tracking-route-ready.title: Pick up
customer-drone-tracking-route-ready.body: The parcel is in the receiving locker: tap “Pick up” for the PIN; for someone else use “View order details” to share it.

customer-drone-tracking-route-map.title: Track on map
customer-drone-tracking-route-map.body: Open the live map of the drone while it flies.

customer-drone-tracking-route-deadline.title: Pickup deadline
customer-drone-tracking-route-deadline.body: When the recipient must collect, with a warning once overdue.

customer-drone-tracking-route-routemap.title: Route map
customer-drone-tracking-route-routemap.body: The route from launch to receiving locker with the drone’s live or estimated position and distance left.

customer-drone-tracking-route-route.title: Delivery route
customer-drone-tracking-route-route.body: Launch and receiving lockers, the receiving box, code and pickup times, and directions to the locker.

customer-drone-tracking-route-progress.title: Delivery progress
customer-drone-tracking-route-progress.body: Each stage with its time, time between stages and the location of each milestone.

customer-drone-tracking-route-cancel.title: Cancel order
customer-drone-tracking-route-cancel.body: Possible until the flight team accepts; paid orders get a refund request.

customer-drone-tracking-info-order.title: Order
customer-drone-tracking-info-order.body: Order code, declared parcel, drone fee, discounts, amount paid and method.

customer-drone-tracking-info-people.title: People
customer-drone-tracking-info-people.body: Sender, recipient, the technician who accepted and the loader.

customer-drone-tracking-info-mission.title: Flight mission
customer-drone-tracking-info-mission.body: Mission code, status, actual weight, seal and loading checks.

customer-drone-tracking-info-journey.title: Journey log
customer-drone-tracking-info-journey.body: Every event of the order, newest first.

customer-drone-tracking-info-return.title: Parcel return
customer-drone-tracking-info-return.body: Closed order with the parcel still in a box or with the team: where it is and when it was returned.

customer-drone-tracking-info-actions.title: Pay / cancel
customer-drone-tracking-info-actions.body: The bottom bar offers “Pay now” (or “Pay the difference”) and “Cancel order” when allowed.

customer-drone-live-map-open.title: Open the map
customer-drone-live-map-open.body: Tap “Track on map” on the drone tracking screen.

customer-drone-live-map-top.title: Title
customer-drone-live-map-top.body: The back button; the title says “(simulated)” when positions are interpolated for a demo order.

customer-drone-live-map-view.title: Map
customer-drone-live-map-view.body: A is the launch locker, B the receiving one, the blue line is the flown path and the drone icon turns with its heading.

customer-drone-live-map-follow.title: Follow the drone
customer-drone-live-map-follow.body: Turn following on or off; dragging the map away stops following.

customer-drone-live-map-status.title: Flight status
customer-drone-live-map-status.body: Current stage, “Expected arrival”, “Time left”, “Speed” and the drone’s coordinates.

customer-drone-live-map-signal.title: Signal lost
customer-drone-live-map-signal.body: Shown when the drone stops reporting, with the time of its last position.

customer-orders-refresh.title: Refresh
customer-orders-refresh.body: Reload the order list, or pull the list down.

customer-orders-first.title: Order card
customer-orders-first.body: Code, status, service, deadline, locker and box. The right button follows the state: “Drop off in locker”, “Pick up now”, “Pay & pick up”, “Review”… Tap the card for details.

customer-orders-incoming-filters.title: Filter parcels
customer-orders-incoming-filters.body: “All”, “Recent”, “To pick up”, “Completed”, plus “Drone delivery”, “Send parcel”, “Cancelled” when present.

customer-orders-incoming-head.title: Incoming card
customer-orders-incoming-head.body: Order code, status, sender, type (locker or drone), deadline, locker and box. Tap the card for details.

customer-orders-incoming-pin.title: Pickup code
customer-orders-incoming-pin.body: Once the parcel is in, the PIN/QR shows on the card: enter it at the kiosk; tap the PIN to copy.

customer-orders-incoming-action.title: Open to pick up
customer-orders-incoming-action.body: “Open … to pick up” opens the box over Bluetooth next to the locker (or scan the QR sticker / use the kiosk code); before it is ready the button reads “Details”.

customer-receiver-detail-open.title: Open details
customer-receiver-detail-open.body: Tap a parcel card under “Incoming” to see its details.

customer-receiver-detail-header.title: Header
customer-receiver-detail-header.body: Order type, code (tap the icon to copy), your role and an overdue warning. The top-right arrow reloads.

customer-receiver-detail-code.title: Pickup code
customer-receiver-detail-code.body: The PIN/QR for the kiosk, or a note that the parcel is not ready, collected, cancelled or handed to a delegate.

customer-receiver-detail-unlock.title: Open to pick up
customer-receiver-detail-unlock.body: Open the box over Bluetooth next to the locker; otherwise scan the QR sticker or use the kiosk code.

customer-receiver-detail-directions.title: Directions to locker
customer-receiver-detail-directions.body: Open navigation to the locker holding the parcel.

customer-receiver-detail-track.title: Track drone
customer-receiver-detail-track.body: Drone orders: follow the flight, or review it afterwards.

customer-receiver-detail-email.title: Resend by email
customer-receiver-detail-email.body: Email the order details and code to your account (once a minute per order); without an email the app asks you to add one.

customer-receiver-detail-sender.title: Order info
customer-receiver-detail-sender.body: Scroll for the sender (tap to call or email), recipient, locker & box, parcel, times and timeline.

customer-order-detail-refresh.title: Reload
customer-order-detail-refresh.body: Reload the latest order, or pull the page down.

customer-order-detail-status.title: Order status
customer-order-detail-status.body: Service, code and status. Below may come warnings: overdue, fees paused by a box fault, items moved to storage or unpaid.

customer-order-detail-pin.title: PIN / QR
customer-order-detail-pin.body: Enter the PIN or show the QR at the kiosk to open the box; tap the PIN to copy.

customer-order-detail-share.title: Share the code
customer-order-detail-share.body: Send orders after drop-off: pass the code via the share sheet, SMS or a copied message.

customer-order-detail-drone.title: Drone pickup code
customer-order-detail-drone.body: Home-pickup drone orders: read this code to the technician who collects the parcel.

customer-order-detail-info.title: Order info
customer-order-detail-info.body: Locker, address, box, order date, rental/storage time, deadline, overtime fee, recipient, delegation, price, discounts, payment and transaction code.

customer-order-detail-timeline.title: Timeline
customer-order-detail-timeline.body: Milestones such as created, paid, dropped off and picked up, with times.

customer-order-detail-feedback.title: Rate & complain
customer-order-detail-feedback.body: Finished orders: “Rate the order” with stars and a comment, or “File a complaint” if something went wrong.

customer-order-actions-track.title: Track drone
customer-order-actions-track.body: Drone orders: open delivery tracking, or review the journey once done.

customer-order-actions-pay.title: Pay
customer-order-actions-pay.body: Unpaid order or pending extension: tap “Pay …” to open the VietQR.

customer-order-actions-open.title: Open the box
customer-order-actions-open.body: “Open … to drop off / pick up / return”: tries Bluetooth first; otherwise scan the QR sticker, use the OTP at the kiosk or retry.

customer-order-actions-confirm.title: Confirm
customer-order-actions-confirm.body: “I’ve dropped off the items” after drop-off; “I’ve picked up — complete” (asks again before closing); rentals have “End rental & pick up” with a guide.

customer-order-actions-overtime.title: Overtime fee
customer-order-actions-overtime.body: Overdue: “Pay (…) & complete pickup” pays and closes, or “Pay overtime fee (…) & open” to collect afterwards.

customer-order-actions-extend.title: Extend
customer-order-actions-extend.body: “Extend rental” or “Extend storage”: add hours, see the fee and pay the extension.

customer-order-actions-storage.title: Items in storage
customer-order-actions-storage.body: Overdue items moved to storage: “Pay storage fee” in the app then visit the counter, or “Collect at the counter” when paid.

customer-order-actions-reorder.title: Reorder
customer-order-actions-reorder.body: Quickly create a new order like this one (not for drone orders).

customer-order-more-delegate.title: Delegate pickup
customer-order-more-delegate.body: Items in the box: enter the delegate’s phone, name and a message. They see it under “Delegated orders”; the current PIN is renewed.

customer-order-more-pin.title: Change PIN
customer-order-more-pin.body: Asks “Change PIN?”: the current code stops working and a new one is issued; for send orders, pass the new code on.

customer-order-more-email.title: Recipient email
customer-order-more-email.body: Send orders: “Add recipient email”, “Change recipient email” before drop-off, or “Resend details to recipient”.

customer-order-more-report.title: Report faulty compartment
customer-order-more-report.body: Report the order’s box. With items inside, overtime pauses until a technician handles it; orders not yet dropped are cancelled so you can book another box.

customer-order-more-cancel.title: Cancel order
customer-order-more-cancel.body: Cancel before drop-off (drone: before the technician has the parcel). The app asks again; paid orders get a refund request.

customer-order-more-directions.title: Directions to locker
customer-order-more-directions.body: Open navigation to the order’s locker.

customer-order-more-refund.title: Request a refund
customer-order-more-refund.body: Paid orders: send a refund request and follow it in Profile › Refund requests.

customer-delegations-intro.title: Collecting for others
customer-delegations-intro.body: When someone delegates to your phone number, the order appears here with its pickup code. Otherwise you see “No delegated orders yet”.

customer-delegations-refresh.title: Refresh
customer-delegations-refresh.body: Reload the list, or pull it down.

customer-delegations-first.title: Delegated card
customer-delegations-first.body: Who delegated, locker and box, deadline, the PIN/QR for the kiosk and “Open … to pick up”. Tap the card for the delegated order details.

customer-authorized-opening-intro.title: A code sent to you
customer-authorized-opening-intro.body: Use the pickup PIN from “Delegated orders” or from the sender. You must be at the locker.

customer-authorized-opening-locker.title: Choose locker
customer-authorized-opening-locker.body: Tap to choose the locker holding the parcel.

customer-authorized-opening-code.title: Pickup code
customer-authorized-opening-code.body: Enter the numeric code, at least 4 digits.

customer-authorized-opening-open.title: Open compartment to pick up
customer-authorized-opening-open.body: The app asks you to scan the locker’s QR sticker to confirm you are there, then opens the box and shows the result.

customer-qr-scan-intro.title: Scan at the kiosk
customer-qr-scan-intro.body: Point the frame at the QR code on the kiosk screen. The app asks “Log in on the kiosk?” and only signs in once you confirm.

customer-qr-scan-torch.title: Flashlight
customer-qr-scan-torch.body: Turn the light on or off in the dark.

customer-qr-scan-home.title: Home
customer-qr-scan-home.body: Close the scanner and go home.

customer-qr-scan-hint.title: How to scan
customer-qr-scan-hint.body: Keep the QR inside the square; the app reacts as soon as it reads it.

customer-qr-scan-manual.title: Enter code manually
customer-qr-scan-manual.body: Can’t scan: tap to type the session and confirmation codes shown under the QR.

customer-qr-manual-session.title: Session code
customer-qr-manual-session.body: Type the “Session code” shown under the kiosk QR.

customer-qr-manual-code.title: Confirmation code
customer-qr-manual-code.body: Type the “Confirmation code” also shown on the kiosk.

customer-qr-manual-submit.title: Continue
customer-qr-manual-submit.body: Checks the codes, then asks “Log in on the kiosk?”.

customer-qr-manual-confirm.title: Confirm the login
customer-qr-manual-confirm.body: The confirm sheet repeats the kiosk code: tap “Log in on kiosk” only for the kiosk in front of you, or “Cancel”.

drone-tech-home-profile.title: Profile photo
drone-tech-home-profile.body: Tap to see your performance, rating and SLA level at a glance and open your profile.

drone-tech-home-identity.title: Name and status
drone-tech-home-identity.body: Greeting, the DRONE badge and your name; the line below shows your SLA level (if any) and how many tickets you are working on.

drone-tech-home-actions.title: Assistant, profile, log out
drone-tech-home-actions.body: "Q&A assistant" (when enabled), "Profile & edit" and "Log out" — logging out asks first, then ends your shift.

drone-tech-dispatch-filters.title: Filter by stage
drone-tech-dispatch-filters.body: Pick "All statuses", "Unclaimed", "In progress", "In flight", "Delivered" or "Canceled"; the number is the order count. "Awaiting return to sender" always shows regardless of the filter.

drone-tech-dispatch-empty.title: No orders
drone-tech-dispatch-empty.body: "No drone orders waiting" shows when there is nothing to do; new orders appear on their own when notified or every 20 seconds.

drone-tech-pickup-offer.title: Pickup invitation
drone-tech-pickup-offer.body: See the pickup address, distance, declared parcel and time left to reply. "Accept pickup" takes the job; "Decline" asks first and you will not be invited to this order again for a while.

drone-tech-pickup-accepted.title: Going to pick up
drone-tech-pickup-accepted.body: "Directions" opens the map to the sender. On site tap "Picked up": enter the 6-digit code the sender reads out, tick that the parcel matches and take a photo; otherwise tap "Can't pick up" and choose a reason.

drone-tech-pickup-carrying.title: Parcel collected
drone-tech-pickup-carrying.body: Bring the parcel to the sending locker ("Directions to drone"), then tap "Assign drone" to pick an idle drone with enough battery there. If it cannot go, tap "Delivery not completed" with a reason.

drone-tech-orders-return.title: Awaiting return to sender
drone-tech-orders-return.body: The order could not be delivered and the parcel is still in the sending box or with the flight team. Hand it back to the sender, then tap "Confirm parcel returned" (note optional); the old box is released.

drone-tech-orders-card.title: Drone order card
drone-tech-orders-card.body: Route from sending to receiving locker, order code, receiving box, drone, goods and current stage; amber/red tags explain what blocks it (unpaid, heavier than declared, route grounded, blocked by an incident). Tap the card for details.

drone-tech-orders-action.title: Main action
drone-tech-orders-action.body: "Accept": pick a drone for an order the customer dropped at the locker; "Confirm loading": enter the scale reading and tick the 3 checks; "Launch": send the flight; "Track": open mission details.

drone-tech-orders-cancel.title: Cancel before flight
drone-tech-orders-cancel.body: While an order awaits loading or is ready to launch: choose a reason (bad weather, drone fault, landing pad, operational, other) to cancel the mission.

drone-tech-orders-advance.title: Confirm stage
drone-tech-orders-advance.body: If the drone sends no signal you confirm each stage by hand (left station, en route, approaching, arrived, parcel in box). If it is sending signal, stages update automatically.

drone-tech-orders-blocked.title: Change drone, not completed
drone-tech-orders-blocked.body: When an assigned order is blocked by an incident: "Change drone" to another idle drone at the sending locker, or "Delivery not completed" with a reason.

drone-tech-orders-failure.title: Report flight failure
drone-tech-orders-failure.body: The drone launched but could not deliver: choose a reason and add a note; the order moves to incident handling.

drone-tech-order-detail-head.title: Mission details
drone-tech-order-detail-head.body: Scroll for the current stage, incident banners, home pickup, route map, delivery progress, sender/receiver, mission and journey log.

drone-tech-order-detail-camera.title: Live camera monitoring
drone-tech-order-detail-camera.body: While the drone flies: see telemetry (altitude, speed, battery, position). If the parcel drops, tap "Report parcel drop" with your observation and a photo — the delivery stops.

drone-tech-order-detail-weather.title: Route weather
drone-tech-order-detail-weather.body: Wind, gusts and rain at the sending and receiving lockers; tap reload to refresh.

drone-tech-mission-planner-intro.title: Draw the path
drone-tech-mission-planner-intro.body: Tap the map to add a waypoint; tap a point's number to edit altitude or command, move or delete it. The green house marker is HOME (launch point).

drone-tech-mission-planner-name.title: Plan name
drone-tech-mission-planner-name.body: Tap to rename the plan. The arrow on the left goes back.

drone-tech-mission-planner-menu.title: Plan menu
drone-tech-mission-planner-menu.body: Rename, altitude/speed settings, set HOME at map center, save to/open from library, export .waypoints (QGC) or JSON, import a file, new plan, delete all points.

drone-tech-mission-planner-map-tools.title: Locate and fit
drone-tech-mission-planner-map-tools.body: The top button centers the map on you; the bottom one zooms to fit the whole path.

drone-tech-mission-planner-stats.title: Path summary
drone-tech-mission-planner-stats.body: Number of points, distance and estimated flight time.

drone-tech-mission-planner-actions.title: List, export mission
drone-tech-mission-planner-actions.body: "List" opens the points in order to edit them; "Export mission" saves a .waypoints file.

drone-tech-fleet-banner.title: Battery and telemetry
drone-tech-fleet-banner.body: Battery updates by itself when the drone sends telemetry; for unconnected drones the last update is shown (possibly entered by a technician).

drone-tech-fleet-first.title: Drone card
drone-tech-fleet-first.body: Code, status (Ready, Reserved for mission, Charging, In flight, Under maintenance, Fault), locker, battery % and technician; fault reasons show in red. Tap to open actions.

drone-tech-fleet-empty.title: No drones yet
drone-tech-fleet-empty.body: Drones assigned to you show here; you can take charge of an unassigned drone below.

drone-tech-fleet-unassigned.title: Drones without a technician
drone-tech-fleet-unassigned.body: Active drones nobody is in charge of: tap one and choose "Take charge".

drone-tech-drone-actions-head.title: Selected drone
drone-tech-drone-actions-head.body: Code, status and battery %; it says "you're in charge" when the drone is yours.

drone-tech-drone-actions-assign.title: Take charge, release
drone-tech-drone-actions-assign.body: "Take charge" of a drone without a technician; "Release" gives back a drone you hold.

drone-tech-drone-actions-status.title: Change status
drone-tech-drone-actions-status.body: Choose Ready, Charging, Under maintenance or Fault (reason required). A drone with open incident tickets can't go back to Ready/Charging; for a drone in flight you're led to report a flight failure.

drone-tech-drone-actions-battery.title: Update battery %
drone-tech-drone-actions-battery.body: Enter the remaining battery % (0–100) by hand when the drone sends no telemetry.

drone-tech-drone-actions-log.title: Maintenance log
drone-tech-drone-actions-log.body: See the work done on the drone; for drones you're in charge of you can add new notes.

drone-tech-flight-data-intro.title: Flight Data screen
drone-tech-flight-data-intro.body: The map shows the drone (red arrow when ARMED, green when DISARMED) and its yellow trail.

drone-tech-flight-data-status.title: Connection status
drone-tech-flight-data-status.body: Not connected, connecting, receiving telemetry or a connection error. The arrow on the left goes back.

drone-tech-flight-data-connect.title: Connect or disconnect
drone-tech-flight-data-connect.body: Opens "Connect flight controller": choose UDP or TCP, enter the drone address and port, then tap "Connect". Once connected, the red button disconnects.

drone-tech-flight-data-safety.title: Safety note
drone-tech-flight-data-safety.body: Use this screen only with SITL or a dedicated control link; the system doesn't control delivery drones.

drone-tech-flight-data-hud.title: HUD panel
drone-tech-flight-data-hud.body: Artificial horizon, ARMED/DISARMED, flight mode, altitude, ground speed, climb, heading, battery and GPS.

drone-tech-flight-data-commands.title: Flight commands
drone-tech-flight-data-commands.body: ARM/DISARM, RTL, LOITER, GUIDED, AUTO, TAKEOFF — each asks for confirmation; greyed-out buttons explain why. If a drone you're in charge of is on a delivery, manual commands are locked.

drone-tech-incidents-banner.title: Incident queue
drone-tech-incidents-banner.body: Shows how many incidents are waiting to be claimed; new tickets come first so the team can claim them quickly. A load error shows a red banner with "Retry".

drone-tech-incidents-search.title: Search tickets
drone-tech-incidents-search.body: Search by ticket ID, title, drone, reporter or order code; X clears it.

drone-tech-incidents-filters.title: More filters and sort
drone-tech-incidents-filters.body: Filter by assignee ("Assigned to me", "Unassigned"), drone and time (Today, 7 days, 30 days); sort by Newest, Oldest or SLA due. "Reset" clears these filters, the sort and the search.

drone-tech-incidents-drop.title: Parcel drop incidents
drone-tech-incidents-drop.body: Tap a card for the drop location and the drone's return status, and to open a search & recovery task. A warning banner shows when the drone must be flown back by hand.

drone-tech-incidents-routed.title: Sent directly to you
drone-tech-incidents-routed.body: Tickets routed to you by name are listed first; the shared technical queue follows.

drone-tech-incidents-first.title: Incident ticket
drone-tech-incidents-first.body: RPT code, title, status, drone, created date, "SLA overdue"; "Claim" takes an unclaimed ticket. Tap the card to open it: add steps/progress photos, "Sign off & resolve incident", "Extend SLA" or "Release ticket".

drone-tech-incidents-empty.title: No tickets
drone-tech-incidents-empty.body: "No drone incident tickets" shows when nothing matches the filters; long lists have a "Show more" button.

drone-tech-my-work-banner.title: Assigned work
drone-tech-my-work-banner.body: Includes incident tickets and drone maintenance schedules; changes count only once the server confirms them.

drone-tech-my-work-metrics.title: To do, working, done
drone-tech-my-work-metrics.body: Jobs not started (new tickets, due schedules), tickets in progress and finished jobs.

drone-tech-my-work-search.title: Search jobs
drone-tech-my-work-search.body: Search by job title, drone or ticket ID.

drone-tech-my-work-status.title: Status and sort
drone-tech-my-work-status.body: "To do", "Completed" or "All"; the sort button picks "Due soonest" or "Newest".

drone-tech-my-work-list.title: Job list
drone-tech-my-work-list.body: Incident tickets open their record to update progress; maintenance schedules have "Details" and "Inspect". With nothing to show you see "No matching jobs".

drone-tech-routine-banner.title: Maintenance schedules
drone-tech-routine-banner.body: Rate every checklist item; if any fails, the drone switches to fault and the system opens an incident ticket.

drone-tech-routine-search.title: Search schedules
drone-tech-routine-search.body: Search by schedule name, drone code or technician.

drone-tech-routine-filters.title: Priority and sort
drone-tech-routine-filters.body: Filter by priority (Urgent, High, Normal, Low); sort by "Due soonest", "Priority" or "Newly created". "Reset" appears while filtering.

drone-tech-routine-list.title: Schedule card
drone-tech-routine-list.body: Name, "Due" tag, priority, drone, interval, next due, last done and technician; with no schedules an empty notice shows. "Details" shows the schedule and directions; "Inspect" opens the checklist (locked if it belongs to another technician or a ticket is still open).

drone-tech-flight-tools-mission.title: Flight planning
drone-tech-flight-tools-mission.body: Draw waypoints, set altitude/commands and export mission files (Mission Planner).

drone-tech-flight-tools-flight.title: Telemetry & control
drone-tech-flight-tools-flight.body: Connect via MAVLink, view live position/HUD and send flight commands — only with SITL or a dedicated control link (Flight Data).

drone-tech-profile-sheet-stats.title: Your performance
drone-tech-profile-sheet-stats.body: Tickets received, in progress, completed and SLA overdue, as calculated by the server.

drone-tech-profile-sheet-quality.title: Rating and SLA policy
drone-tech-profile-sheet-quality.body: Average rating, SLA policy level (Normal, SLA warning, Restricted from new jobs, Suspended) with the reason, and your technician phone.

drone-tech-profile-sheet-actions.title: Profile and log out
drone-tech-profile-sheet-actions.body: "View & edit profile" opens your profile page; "Log out" asks first, then ends your shift.

drone-tech-profile-avatar.title: Profile photo
drone-tech-profile-avatar.body: Tap to take a new photo, choose from the gallery or remove it. The arrow at the top left goes back.

drone-tech-profile-metrics.title: Shift performance
drone-tech-profile-metrics.body: Tickets assigned, in progress, done and overdue, quality rating and SLA status.

drone-tech-profile-form.title: Personal info
drone-tech-profile-form.body: Edit your full name and contact phone; the account email and role ID are fixed.

drone-tech-profile-save.title: Save changes
drone-tech-profile-save.body: Tap "Save changes" to store your name and phone.

drone-tech-profile-language.title: App language
drone-tech-profile-language.body: Choose the app language: Vietnamese or English.

drone-tech-profile-logout.title: Log out
drone-tech-profile-logout.body: Asks first, then ends your shift and signs you out.

kiosk-home-intro.title: Lock.R locker kiosk
kiosk-home-intro.body: The touch screen on the locker lets you open boxes, rent a box and report problems without the app. Just tap the screen.

kiosk-home-status.title: Status and time
kiosk-home-status.body: The top-right corner shows the kiosk status with the current time and date.

kiosk-home-locker.title: This locker
kiosk-home-locker.body: Location name, address and how many boxes are "Trống" (free) out of the total — check it matches your order.

kiosk-home-open.title: "Mở Tủ / Nhận Đồ" (Open / Pick up)
kiosk-home-open.body: Have a PIN or QR code (pickup, a drop-off created in the app, a box you rent)? Tap here to enter it and open the box.

kiosk-home-send.title: "Gửi Đồ / Thuê Tủ" (Store / Rent)
kiosk-home-send.body: Rent a box on the spot: sign in with your phone or email, pick a box and a duration, then pay by bank transfer. The green tag shows how many boxes are free.

kiosk-home-report.title: "Báo sự cố" (Report a problem)
kiosk-home-report.body: Box won't open, door won't lock, box dirty or screen faulty? Tap here, sign in, then pick the box and the problem to alert a technician.

kiosk-open-code-intro.title: Which code?
kiosk-open-code-intro.body: A drop-off code, a pickup code (shared by the sender), a delegated pickup code or the code of a box you rent. Your codes are under Locker orders in the Lock.R app.

kiosk-open-code-locker.title: Current locker
kiosk-open-code-locker.body: Check the locker name and code match your order: a code only opens boxes at its own locker.

kiosk-open-code-input.title: Code field
kiosk-open-code-input.body: Type the 6-digit PIN — the kiosk sends it as soon as all 6 digits are in. QR codes ("LLQR…") are filled in by the code scanner, if the locker has one.

kiosk-open-code-submit.title: "Mở khóa" (Unlock)
kiosk-open-code-submit.body: Sends the code. If it's valid the box pops open; for a rented box or a drop-off, the kiosk then asks what to do next.

kiosk-open-code-back.title: Back
kiosk-open-code-back.body: The arrow at the top left returns to the home screen.

kiosk-open-invalid-msg.title: Why it was rejected
kiosk-open-invalid-msg.body: The kiosk shows the reason here (wrong or expired code, unpaid order, overdue fee to pay in the app…) and clears the field after 2 seconds so you can retry.

kiosk-open-invalid-lockout.title: Too many wrong tries
kiosk-open-invalid-lockout.body: Several wrong codes in a row lock the box for a few minutes. Forgot the code? Check Locker orders in the Lock.R app.

kiosk-open-retry-msg.title: Code not checked yet
kiosk-open-retry-msg.body: Flaky network or busy system: the code isn't counted as wrong and stays in the field.

kiosk-open-retry-button.title: "Thử lại" (Try again)
kiosk-open-retry-button.body: Wait a few seconds, then tap to resend the same code.

kiosk-rental-access-hint.title: Box is open
kiosk-rental-access-hint.body: Your rented box is open. Just opening it does not end the rental — time keeps running.

kiosk-rental-access-end.title: "Lấy hết đồ & kết thúc thuê" (End rental)
kiosk-rental-access-end.body: Took everything? Tap to return the box and complete the order; the kiosk asks you to confirm first.

kiosk-rental-access-keep.title: "Chỉ lấy/cất đồ — tiếp tục thuê" (Keep renting)
kiosk-rental-access-keep.body: Only taking or adding items: close the door; the code keeps working until the rental ends.

kiosk-end-rental-dialog-box.title: "Kết thúc thuê?" (End rental?)
kiosk-end-rental-dialog-box.body: The kiosk asks whether you've taken everything and closed the door. Once ended, the box code stops working.

kiosk-end-rental-dialog-cancel.title: "Chưa" (Not yet)
kiosk-end-rental-dialog-cancel.body: Closes the dialog; the rental stays active so you can take the rest.

kiosk-end-rental-dialog-confirm.title: "Kết thúc thuê" (End rental)
kiosk-end-rental-dialog-confirm.body: Returns the box and completes the order; the screen shows "Đã kết thúc thuê!".

kiosk-login-tabs.title: Phone or email
kiosk-login-tabs.body: Choose where to get the code. A new phone number or email gets a quick Lock.R account after verification.

kiosk-login-phone.title: "Số điện thoại" (Phone number)
kiosk-login-phone.body: Enter your mobile number (e.g. 0901234567). Use the same number in the Lock.R app to see your order and box code.

kiosk-login-send.title: "Gửi mã OTP" (Send code)
kiosk-login-send.body: Sends a 6-digit code by SMS and moves to the code screen.

kiosk-login-back.title: Back
kiosk-login-back.body: Cancels sign-in and returns to the home screen.

kiosk-login-email-input.title: "Email"
kiosk-login-email-input.body: Enter your email to get the code. When you rent with email, the box code and all rental details are emailed to you.

kiosk-login-email-send.title: "Gửi mã OTP" (Send code)
kiosk-login-email-send.body: Emails a 6-digit code and moves to the code screen. No email? Check your Spam folder.

kiosk-otp-sent.title: Code sent to
kiosk-otp-sent.body: Check the phone number / email shown. Wrong? Tap the back arrow to fix it.

kiosk-otp-input.title: "Nhập mã OTP 6 số" (6-digit code)
kiosk-otp-input.body: Type the 6 digits from the SMS or email.

kiosk-otp-confirm.title: "Xác nhận" (Confirm)
kiosk-otp-confirm.body: Signs you in and continues: to box selection, or to the report screen if you came from "Báo sự cố".

kiosk-otp-resend.title: "Gửi lại mã" (Resend)
kiosk-otp-resend.body: No code? After the 60-second countdown, tap to get a new one — the old code stops working.

kiosk-boxes-user.title: Signed-in account
kiosk-boxes-user.body: The account you just signed in with on the kiosk.

kiosk-boxes-locker.title: Locker info
kiosk-boxes-locker.body: Name, address, locker code, free boxes and total boxes.

kiosk-boxes-legend.title: Colour key
kiosk-boxes-legend.body: Door colours: "Trống" (free), "Đang chọn" (selected), "Đang dùng" (in use), "Drone" (drone deliveries only) and "Lỗi / bảo trì" (fault / maintenance).

kiosk-boxes-map.title: Locker map
kiosk-boxes-map.body: Boxes sit where they are on the real locker. Tap a "Trống" box to select it; "Ô của bạn" is a box you rent — tap it to manage it. Boxes marked "Đang dùng", "Đã đặt" or "Chờ kiểm tra" can't be picked.

kiosk-boxes-picked.title: Selected box
kiosk-boxes-picked.body: The box number and type you picked: standard, or large (XL) for suitcases.

kiosk-boxes-continue.title: "Tiếp tục đặt tủ" (Continue)
kiosk-boxes-continue.body: Enabled once a box is selected — moves on to choosing the rental time.

kiosk-boxes-back.title: Exit
kiosk-boxes-back.body: The top-left arrow signs you out of the kiosk and returns home.

kiosk-boxes-manage-code.title: Box PIN / QR
kiosk-boxes-manage-code.body: This rental's code — use it in "Mở Tủ / Nhận Đồ" to open the box without signing in.

kiosk-boxes-manage-open.title: "Mở tủ" (Open)
kiosk-boxes-manage-open.body: Opens the box now to take or store items; the rental continues. Close the door afterwards.

kiosk-boxes-manage-extend.title: "Gia hạn thuê" (Extend)
kiosk-boxes-manage-extend.body: Extensions are done in the Lock.R app (Locker orders, pick this order); the kiosk just shows how.

kiosk-boxes-manage-end.title: "Kết thúc thuê & trả ô" (End & return)
kiosk-boxes-manage-end.body: Take everything, close the door, then tap; the kiosk confirms before returning the box and completing the order.

kiosk-boxes-manage-delegate.title: "Ủy quyền người khác lấy hộ" (Delegate pickup)
kiosk-boxes-manage-delegate.body: Let someone else collect: set it up in the Lock.R app; they enter the delegation code in "Mở Tủ / Nhận Đồ".

kiosk-boxes-manage-report.title: "Báo ô lỗi" (Report fault)
kiosk-boxes-manage-report.body: Something wrong with the box? Opens the report screen with this box preselected.

kiosk-boxes-manage-close.title: Close
kiosk-boxes-manage-close.body: The X closes the panel and returns to the locker map.

kiosk-order-time-mode.title: By hour / by day
kiosk-order-time-mode.body: Under a day, choose "Theo giờ" (by hour); longer, choose "Theo ngày" (by day, 24 hours each).

kiosk-order-time-quick.title: Quick options
kiosk-order-time-quick.body: Tap a preset; each shows its price under the hours so you can compare.

kiosk-order-time-stepper.title: Fine-tune
kiosk-order-time-stepper.body: The − and + buttons change it hour by hour, within the locker's limits.

kiosk-order-time-rate.title: Rate
kiosk-order-time-rate.body: Hourly price for the selected box type; for long rentals each day never costs more than the cap shown.

kiosk-order-time-back.title: Back
kiosk-order-time-back.body: Returns to the locker map to pick another box.

kiosk-order-day-quick.title: Day presets
kiosk-order-day-quick.body: Pick 1, 2, 3… days (up to the locker's limit), each with its price.

kiosk-order-day-stepper.title: Add / remove days
kiosk-order-day-stepper.body: The − and + buttons change it day by day; the total hours are shown below.

kiosk-order-summary-note.title: "Ghi chú" (Note)
kiosk-order-summary-note.body: Optional: note what you're storing (e.g. clothes, handle with care) for your records.

kiosk-order-summary-promo.title: "Mã giảm giá" (Promo code)
kiosk-order-summary-promo.body: Enter a promo code and tap "Áp dụng" (Apply); it's checked right away for this locker and amount.

kiosk-order-summary-box.title: Selected box
kiosk-order-summary-box.body: The box number and type for this order.

kiosk-order-summary-rows.title: Order summary
kiosk-order-summary-rows.body: Rental time, rental price and any discount.

kiosk-order-summary-total.title: "Tổng cộng" (Total)
kiosk-order-summary-total.body: The amount to transfer. Rental time only starts once you confirm your items are in the box.

kiosk-order-summary-submit.title: "Đặt tủ ngay" (Book now)
kiosk-order-summary-submit.body: Creates the order, holds the box for you and moves to VietQR bank transfer.

kiosk-order-promo-result.title: Code check
kiosk-order-promo-result.body: A valid code shows the promotion and the discount; an invalid code or one below the minimum order shows why.

kiosk-order-promo-remove.title: "Gỡ mã" (Remove)
kiosk-order-promo-remove.body: Removes the current code so you can enter another.

kiosk-order-promo-discount.title: "Khuyến mãi" (Discount)
kiosk-order-promo-discount.body: The discount taken off "Tổng cộng". Change the rental time and it recalculates.

kiosk-payment-qr.title: VietQR code
kiosk-payment-qr.body: Open any banking app, choose scan QR and scan this — amount and reference are filled in.

kiosk-payment-amount.title: "Số tiền" (Amount)
kiosk-payment-amount.body: The order amount — keep it unchanged; a different amount won't be accepted.

kiosk-payment-ref.title: "Nội dung chuyển khoản" (Reference)
kiosk-payment-ref.body: Lets the system match the payment to your order — keep it unchanged.

kiosk-payment-timer.title: Waiting time
kiosk-payment-timer.body: The kiosk waits up to 10 minutes for the money; the countdown shows what's left.

kiosk-payment-status.title: Waiting for confirmation
kiosk-payment-status.body: The kiosk checks every few seconds and opens the box as soon as the money arrives — nothing to tap.

kiosk-payment-cancel.title: "Huỷ & Trả lại ô tủ" (Cancel)
kiosk-payment-cancel.body: Changed your mind? Cancels the order and frees the box (the back arrow does too). Don't tap it after you've paid.

kiosk-payment-expired-msg.title: Timed out
kiosk-payment-expired-msg.body: The kiosk stops waiting after 10 minutes. If it says the transfer is invalid (amount mismatch), contact Lock.R support.

kiosk-payment-expired-recheck.title: "Kiểm tra lại" (Check again)
kiosk-payment-expired-recheck.body: Already paid? Tap to wait another 10 minutes; the box opens when the money arrives.

kiosk-payment-expired-cancel.title: "Huỷ & Trả lại ô tủ" (Cancel)
kiosk-payment-expired-cancel.body: Haven't paid and no longer want the box: cancel the order and free it.

kiosk-payment-retry-summary.title: Order details
kiosk-payment-retry-summary.body: Order code, backup PIN ("PIN dự phòng"), price and the assigned box.

kiosk-payment-retry-vietqr.title: "Chuyển khoản VietQR" (VietQR transfer)
kiosk-payment-retry-vietqr.body: Tap to create the VietQR code again for this order.

kiosk-payment-retry-cancel.title: "Hủy đặt & Trả lại ô tủ" (Cancel booking)
kiosk-payment-retry-cancel.body: Cancels the unpaid order and frees the box.

kiosk-payment-retry-error.title: Error reason
kiosk-payment-retry-error.body: Why the code couldn't be created (network, bank transfer temporarily off…).

kiosk-payment-paid-msg.title: Payment received
kiosk-payment-paid-msg.body: The order is paid — no need to transfer again.

kiosk-payment-paid-pin.title: "Mã mở ô tủ của bạn" (Your box code)
kiosk-payment-paid-pin.body: Write down or photograph this code to reopen the box during the rental. If you used email, it's in your inbox too.

kiosk-payment-paid-open.title: "Mở ô tủ #…" (Open box)
kiosk-payment-paid-open.body: The kiosk opens the box automatically once paid; if it didn't (reason shown below), tap to retry.

kiosk-drop-confirm-hint.title: Box is open
kiosk-drop-confirm-hint.body: Put your items in, close the door, then confirm. You also see this after entering a drop-off code created in the app.

kiosk-drop-confirm-pin.title: Box code
kiosk-drop-confirm-pin.body: The code to reopen the box during the rental. With a phone sign-in, write it down; with email, it's been sent to your inbox.

kiosk-drop-confirm-done.title: "Đã bỏ hàng xong" (Done)
kiosk-drop-confirm-done.body: Tap after closing the door: the rental time starts (a drop-off order then waits for the recipient).

kiosk-drop-confirm-later.title: "Để sau — xác nhận trên ứng dụng" (Later)
kiosk-drop-confirm-later.body: Returns home; confirm the drop-off later in the Lock.R app.

kiosk-success-title.title: Result
kiosk-success-title.body: The title and message tell you what just happened, e.g. "Đã bỏ hàng!" (dropped off), "Đã mở khóa!" (unlocked), "Đã gửi báo cáo!" (report sent).

kiosk-success-card.title: Keep this
kiosk-success-card.body: Order code (or report ticket code), box number and box code if any — take a photo.

kiosk-success-home.title: "Về trang chủ" (Home)
kiosk-success-home.body: Ends the session now and signs you out of the kiosk.
