kiosk-success-countdown.title: Auto close
kiosk-success-countdown.body: If you don't tap anything, the kiosk returns home when the countdown ends.

kiosk-report-login-purpose.title: Why sign in
kiosk-report-login-purpose.body: A technician may need your phone or email to get back to you. You get a one-time code just like when renting.

kiosk-report-login-tabs.title: Phone or email
kiosk-report-login-tabs.body: Choose where to get the code, enter it and tap "Gửi mã OTP"; after verifying you reach the report screen.

kiosk-report-map.title: Tap the faulty box
kiosk-report-map.body: Step 1: pick the problem box on the map. Boxes marked "Đã có báo lỗi" are already waiting for a technician.

kiosk-report-whole.title: "Sự cố cả tủ" (Whole locker)
kiosk-report-whole.body: For problems not tied to one box (the whole locker, the screen…), choose this instead of a box.

kiosk-report-reasons.title: Problem
kiosk-report-reasons.body: Step 2: pick a reason — door won't open, won't close / lock, box damaged, dirty / smelly, screen / keypad faulty, or other.

kiosk-report-detail.title: "Mô tả thêm" (Details)
kiosk-report-detail.body: Optional: add details to help the technician fix it faster.

kiosk-report-picked.title: Review
kiosk-report-picked.body: Summary of the box (or locker) and problem you're about to send.

kiosk-report-send.title: "Gửi báo cáo" (Send report)
kiosk-report-send.body: Enabled once a box and problem are chosen. The box is paused until a technician checks it; follow the ticket under Report issue in the app.

kiosk-report-back.title: Cancel
kiosk-report-back.body: The top-left arrow cancels the report, signs you out and returns home.

kiosk-keyboard-text-keys.title: Virtual keyboard
kiosk-keyboard-text-keys.body: Tap a field and the keyboard appears at the bottom; tap the keys to type.

kiosk-keyboard-text-shift.title: Capital letter
kiosk-keyboard-text-shift.body: The up-arrow key capitalises the next letter.

kiosk-keyboard-text-delete.title: Backspace
kiosk-keyboard-text-delete.body: Deletes the character before the cursor.

kiosk-keyboard-text-mail.title: Email shortcuts
kiosk-keyboard-text-mail.body: Email fields have "@", ".com" and "@gmail.com" keys for quick typing.

kiosk-keyboard-text-enter.title: "OK"
kiosk-keyboard-text-enter.body: Submits the field (like the send button) and hides the keyboard so you see the result.

kiosk-keyboard-text-hide.title: Hide keyboard
kiosk-keyboard-text-hide.body: The down arrow hides the keyboard.

kiosk-keyboard-numeric-pad.title: Digits
kiosk-keyboard-numeric-pad.body: Tap digits to type. Phone fields show a "+" key instead of "Xóa".

kiosk-keyboard-numeric-clear.title: "Xóa" (Clear)
kiosk-keyboard-numeric-clear.body: Clears everything typed so you can start over.

kiosk-keyboard-numeric-hide.title: Hide keyboard
kiosk-keyboard-numeric-hide.body: The down arrow hides the keyboard.

kiosk-tech-setup-intro.title: Waiting to be paired
kiosk-tech-setup-intro.body: A newly installed Pi not yet assigned to a locker shows this instead of the customer screen; the locker takes no orders.

kiosk-tech-setup-qr.title: Pairing QR code
kiosk-tech-setup-qr.body: In the Lock.R app open "Lắp đặt tủ" › pick the profile › "Gán bộ điều khiển" and scan this. The Pi's MAC address is below the code.

kiosk-tech-setup-steps.title: Pairing steps
kiosk-tech-setup-steps.body: The Pi must be online; if scanning fails, pick the matching MAC from the online controllers list. Once paired, the locker loads its box layout, test-opens each box, then switches to the customer screen.

kiosk-tech-setup-foot.title: IP and version
kiosk-tech-setup-foot.body: The Pi's local IP address and software version, for technical support.

locker-tech-home-avatar.title: Profile photo
locker-tech-home-avatar.body: Tap to open your quick profile card: tickets taken, in progress, overdue, your rating and SLA level.

locker-tech-home-sla.title: SLA status line
locker-tech-home-sla.body: Your current SLA level (Normal, Warning, Restricted, Suspended) and the number of overdue tickets. Tap to open the "My work" tab.

locker-tech-header-installations.title: Locker installation
locker-tech-header-installations.body: Opens the installation jobs assigned to you by the admin, where you fill in the commissioning checklist and submit it for review.

locker-tech-header-assistant.title: Q&A assistant
locker-tech-header-assistant.body: Ask quick questions about incident and locker maintenance procedures. Only shown while the assistant is enabled.

locker-tech-header-notifications.title: Notifications
locker-tech-header-notifications.body: New tickets routed to you, work assigned by admins, due inspections and installation jobs all arrive here; the red number counts unread messages.

locker-tech-header-profile.title: Profile & edit
locker-tech-header-profile.body: Opens your technician profile to edit your name, phone number, profile photo and language.

locker-tech-header-logout.title: Log out
locker-tech-header-logout.body: Ends your shift and logs out of the locker technician account after asking you to confirm.

locker-tech-profile-sheet-identity.title: Your details
locker-tech-profile-sheet-identity.body: Your name, the "Locker technician (compartments & hardware)" role and your account email.

locker-tech-profile-sheet-stats.title: Work figures
locker-tech-profile-sheet-stats.body: "Tickets taken", "In progress", "Done" and "Overdue", counted from the tickets assigned to you.

locker-tech-profile-sheet-quality.title: Rating and SLA
locker-tech-profile-sheet-quality.body: Your customer rating, "SLA status" with its reason (if any) and your technician phone number.

locker-tech-profile-sheet-actions.title: Edit profile or log out
locker-tech-profile-sheet-actions.body: "View & edit profile" opens the full profile page; "Log out" ends your shift and signs you out.

locker-tech-shift-status.title: Shift and GPS status
locker-tech-shift-status.body: The "ON SHIFT" / "OFF SHIFT" badge and GPS state: active (accuracy, last update), searching for a signal, or off.

locker-tech-shift-gps.title: Refresh GPS
locker-tech-shift-gps.body: Only shown while on shift: tap to send your current location to dispatch again.

locker-tech-shift-toggle.title: Start / end shift
locker-tech-shift-toggle.body: "Start shift" turns on location so you get nearby jobs; "End shift" asks to confirm, stops new incidents and turns location off completely.

locker-tech-shift-details.title: Location details
locker-tech-shift-details.body: Tap the rest of the card to open the device GPS details.

locker-tech-shift-location-status.title: Shift state
locker-tech-shift-location-status.body: "On shift" (your location is used to dispatch the nearest jobs) or "Off shift" (location is turned off).

locker-tech-shift-location-gps.title: GPS info
locker-tech-shift-location-gps.body: "GPS coordinates", "GPS accuracy" and "Last updated"; with no coordinates yet the panel says so and suggests getting your location.

locker-tech-shift-location-actions.title: Location buttons
locker-tech-shift-location-actions.body: "Open Google Maps" shows your position on the map and "Update GPS" sends it again; with no coordinates the button is "Get current location".

locker-tech-shift-location-privacy.title: Privacy
locker-tech-shift-location-privacy.body: Your location is only read while you are on shift; when the shift ends, location turns off completely.

locker-tech-inspect-tab.title: Inspect tab
locker-tech-inspect-tab.body: The first tab: browse each locker, see its compartment layout and hardware status.

locker-tech-inspect-install-banner.title: Open installation jobs
locker-tech-inspect-install-banner.body: Only shown when installation jobs are assigned to you; tap to open the installation list.

locker-tech-inspect-recovery-banner.title: Parcel recovery tasks
locker-tech-inspect-recovery-banner.body: When a dropped drone parcel needs recovering, this banner appears at the top; tap to open the "Parcel recovery" tab.

locker-tech-inspect-directions.title: Directions
locker-tech-inspect-directions.body: Opens map directions to the selected locker; greyed out when the locker has no location.

locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-summary.title: Cell overview
locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-summary.body: "Total", "Available" and "Faulty" for the selected locker; faulty turns red when above 0.

locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-legend.title: Colour legend
locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-legend.body: The colour of each cell state: Free, Held, Occupied, Broken, Awaiting technician check, Out of service, Cleaning.

locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-cabinet.title: Physical layout
locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-cabinet.body: Laid out like the real locker: the XL suitcase column on the left, standard rows on the right; each cell shows its number, state and type.

locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-first-cell.title: Tap a cell
locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-first-cell.body: Tap a cell to open its actions: report a fault, take it out of service, cleaning, reopen after repair or emergency open.

locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-box-health.title: Cell hardware status
locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-box-health.body: Door state from the sensors (closed, open, no signal) next to the order-based state; an open door on an empty cell is flagged as "need attention".

locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-landing-pad.title: Drone landing pad
locker-tech-inspect-cabinet-landing-pad.body: Only for lockers with a landing pad: choose "Working", "Broken" or "Under maintenance". Broken / maintenance needs a reason and opens a landing-pad ticket assigned to you.

locker-tech-cell-sheet-open.title: Pick a cell
locker-tech-cell-sheet-open.body: The action panel opens when you tap a cell on the locker layout.

locker-tech-cell-sheet-head.title: Cell info
locker-tech-cell-sheet-head.body: Cell number, type, current state and fault reason (if any).

locker-tech-cell-sheet-actions.title: Actions by state
locker-tech-cell-sheet-actions.body: Buttons depend on the cell state: report a fault (reason + photos), out of service, mark cleaning, restore / finish cleaning, confirm a customer-reported fault, or "Fixed" to accept the ticket.

locker-tech-cell-sheet-force-open.title: Emergency open
locker-tech-cell-sheet-force-open.body: Available for every cell: enter a reason (required), a note and photos, then "Confirm open"; the Master command is logged, also in the ticket log if the cell has a ticket assigned to you.

locker-tech-incidents-tab.title: Incidents tab
locker-tech-incidents-tab.body: The number in brackets counts open tickets (unclaimed and in progress) across the system.

locker-tech-incidents-scope.title: Scope
locker-tech-incidents-scope.body: "All" shows every ticket; "My lockers" keeps only tickets routed to you and faulty cells at your lockers.

locker-tech-incidents-status.title: Status filter
locker-tech-incidents-status.body: "All statuses", "Unclaimed", "In progress" or "Done" — only when viewing "All".

locker-tech-incidents-anomalies.title: Open-door alerts
locker-tech-incidents-anomalies.body: Cells whose door is open while empty, across all lockers; tap "Directions" to go and check.

locker-tech-incidents-first-fault.title: Physically faulty cells
locker-tech-incidents-first-fault.body: Broken cells with the reason and address; "Directions" to the locker, "Fixed" starts the ticket acceptance for that cell.

locker-tech-incidents-summary.title: System-wide overview
locker-tech-incidents-summary.body: Total Kiosk tickets and how many are unclaimed, in progress and done.

locker-tech-incidents-first-open.title: Tickets awaiting pickup
locker-tech-incidents-first-open.body: Each card shows the RPT code, a "NEW" badge, SLA countdown, locker / cell, created time and photo count; "Take" claims it, tapping the card opens the details.

locker-tech-mine-tab.title: My work tab
locker-tech-mine-tab.body: The number in brackets counts the tickets you are handling.

locker-tech-mine-overview.title: Shift overview
locker-tech-mine-overview.body: Your "Tickets taken", "In progress", "Tickets done" and "SLA overdue".

locker-tech-mine-rating.title: Rating
locker-tech-mine-rating.body: The average score customers gave the tickets you handled.

locker-tech-mine-sla.title: SLA penalty level
locker-tech-mine-sla.body: The level computed by the server (good standing, warning, restricted, suspended) with its reason and completed, in-progress and overdue counts. Pull down to reload.

locker-tech-mine-procedure.title: Standard procedure
locker-tech-mine-procedure.body: A reminder of the steps: check the locker location, take the ticket, go to the right cell, take acceptance photos, then complete.

locker-tech-mine-first-report.title: Tickets in progress
locker-tech-mine-first-report.body: Your tickets, most recently taken first, with completed history below. Tap a card to open the ticket.

locker-tech-report-detail-open.title: Open a ticket
locker-tech-report-detail-open.body: Tap a ticket card (in "My work" or "Incidents") to open its details.

locker-tech-report-detail-head.title: Ticket header
locker-tech-report-detail-head.body: RPT code, title and status; ✕ closes it.

locker-tech-report-detail-badges.title: SLA and ticket badges
locker-tech-report-detail-badges.body: SLA countdown, extended / overdue, how long it has been open, assignee, created time, SLA due, extension reason and ticket type (landing pad, locker-level, whole locker blocked, from a routine inspection).

locker-tech-report-detail-location.title: Locker / cell location
locker-tech-report-detail-location.body: Locker name, cell number, address and the "Directions to locker" button.

locker-tech-report-detail-reporter.title: Reporter
locker-tech-report-detail-reporter.body: The reporter name and phone number; tap the copy icon to copy the number.

locker-tech-report-detail-complaint.title: Customer's report
locker-tech-report-detail-complaint.body: The reporter's description with the on-site photos they sent; tap a photo to enlarge it.

locker-tech-report-detail-my-photos.title: Your attached photos
locker-tech-report-detail-my-photos.body: Photos you uploaded to the ticket (on site, repairing, acceptance); tap ✕ to delete a wrong upload.

locker-tech-report-detail-logs.title: Work log
locker-tech-report-detail-logs.body: The history of technician steps. While handling the ticket, tap "Add a work step / quick note..." to write a note, pick a quick template and attach photos.

locker-tech-report-actions-open.title: Open a ticket
locker-tech-report-actions-open.body: The action buttons are at the bottom of the ticket details.

locker-tech-report-actions-claim.title: Take it now
locker-tech-report-actions-claim.body: Only on unclaimed tickets: takes the ticket and switches to the "My work" tab.

locker-tech-report-actions-box-incident.title: Check cell & lock incident
locker-tech-report-actions-box-incident.body: At the Kiosk: pick the cell, see whether it holds customer items, choose how to handle them and whether to lock the cell.

locker-tech-report-actions-resolve.title: Accept & complete
locker-tech-report-actions-resolve.body: Opens the acceptance panel with before / during / after photos and notes; only the assignee can complete it.

locker-tech-report-actions-reject.title: Not as described
locker-tech-report-actions-reject.body: Checked and the cell works normally: write feedback for the reporter (required), the ticket closes and the cell returns to service.

locker-tech-report-actions-release.title: Return to the queue
locker-tech-report-actions-release.body: If you cannot continue, enter a reason (required) to send the ticket back for another technician; the reason goes into the ticket log.

locker-tech-report-actions-handled-by.title: Another technician's ticket
locker-tech-report-actions-handled-by.body: A ticket handled by someone else is read-only for you; only the assignee can complete it.

locker-tech-report-actions-directions.title: Directions to locker
locker-tech-report-actions-directions.body: Opens map directions to the ticket's locker.

locker-tech-report-actions-extend.title: Extend SLA
locker-tech-report-actions-extend.body: Only for the assignee: ask for more time; when no extensions are left the button shows how many were used.

locker-tech-resolve-open.title: Done button
locker-tech-resolve-open.body: On a ticket in progress tap "Done" (or "Accept & complete" in the details) to open this panel.

locker-tech-resolve-head.title: Ticket being accepted
locker-tech-resolve-head.body: Locker name, cell number, RPT code and ticket title.

locker-tech-resolve-before.title: Before repair
locker-tech-resolve-before.body: Photos of the condition before repair (optional); existing on-site photos are shown for comparison.

locker-tech-resolve-during.title: During repair
locker-tech-resolve-during.body: Photos of the technical work and part replacement (optional).

locker-tech-resolve-after.title: After repair
locker-tech-resolve-after.body: Acceptance photos after the repair — at least 1 is required when admins demand it.

locker-tech-resolve-notes.title: Technical notes
locker-tech-resolve-notes.body: Describe the replaced parts and steps taken; tap a quick-note chip below to insert it.

locker-tech-resolve-test-open.title: Test-open after repair
locker-tech-resolve-test-open.body: Turn on to send an open command and check the latch after completing; only shown when the cell holds no order, off by default.

locker-tech-resolve-submit.title: Confirm & complete
locker-tech-resolve-submit.body: Uploads the photos, saves the acceptance and closes the ticket; the cell / landing pad / locker returns to service.

locker-tech-scene-photos-open.title: Acceptance button
locker-tech-scene-photos-open.body: On a ticket in progress tap "Acceptance" ("Photos (+)" once photos exist) to open the on-site photo panel.

locker-tech-scene-photos-photos.title: On-site photos
locker-tech-scene-photos-photos.body: Photograph the door, lock, board... as soon as you arrive; at least 1 photo is needed, up to the limit.

locker-tech-scene-photos-note.title: Condition note
locker-tech-scene-photos-note.body: Optional note; with a note the ticket log gets an entry with the photos.

locker-tech-scene-photos-submit.title: Save on-site photos
locker-tech-scene-photos-submit.body: Uploads the photos to the ticket as pre-repair evidence.

locker-tech-extend-sla-open.title: Extend button
locker-tech-extend-sla-open.body: On a ticket in progress (or in its details) tap "Extend"; each ticket allows a limited number of extensions.

locker-tech-extend-sla-due.title: Current and new due
locker-tech-extend-sla-due.body: Compare "Current due" with "New due (estimated)" for the hours you pick.

locker-tech-extend-sla-hours.title: Pick the hours
locker-tech-extend-sla-hours.body: Choose a "+N h" option, within the per-extension maximum set by admins.

locker-tech-extend-sla-reason.title: Extension reason
locker-tech-extend-sla-reason.body: A reason is required; tap a preset such as "Waiting for replacement parts" to fill it in.

locker-tech-extend-sla-submit.title: Confirm extension
locker-tech-extend-sla-submit.body: Sends the request; on success you see the new due time and extensions used.

locker-tech-box-incident-open.title: Open the ticket
locker-tech-box-incident-open.body: Tap a ticket in progress to open its details.

locker-tech-box-incident-button.title: Check cell button
locker-tech-box-incident-button.body: Tap "Check compartment & lock incident at Kiosk" at the bottom of the details to open this panel.

locker-tech-box-incident-pick.title: 1. Pick the cell
locker-tech-box-incident-pick.body: Pick the faulty cell; the app looks up the order and shows whether it holds customer items, has no order or is empty, with an "Emergency open" button to check in person.

locker-tech-box-incident-options.title: 2. Resolution
locker-tech-box-incident-options.body: With items: move to a new empty cell (new PIN), hand over directly (customer PIN / QR), seal and take to the Hub (seal code) or fix on site. Without items: fix on site or lock for maintenance.

locker-tech-box-incident-lock.title: Lock or not
locker-tech-box-incident-lock.body: Switch between locking the cell for maintenance (Broken) or keeping it active; the maintenance-lock option always locks it.

locker-tech-box-incident-notes.title: 3. Reason & notes
locker-tech-box-incident-notes.body: Read the reporter reason or failed routine inspection details, then write your own assessment.

locker-tech-box-incident-photos.title: 4–5. On-site & repair photos
locker-tech-box-incident-photos.body: See the existing comparison photos, add on-site photos and repair progress photos (optional).

locker-tech-box-incident-submit.title: Confirm & update
locker-tech-box-incident-submit.body: Saves the resolution, updates the cell status and writes it to the ticket log.

locker-tech-routine-tab.title: Routine tab
locker-tech-routine-tab.body: The number in brackets counts Kiosk routine inspection schedules.

locker-tech-routine-intro.title: How routine checks work
locker-tech-routine-intro.body: When due, tap "Inspect" and rate each item: all pass moves it to the next cycle; any fail opens a ticket assigned to you.

locker-tech-routine-scope.title: Mine / All
locker-tech-routine-scope.body: "Mine" shows only schedules assigned to you; "All" includes other technicians' schedules.

locker-tech-routine-first-card.title: Schedule card
locker-tech-routine-first-card.body: Schedule ID, title, a "Due" badge or days left, station, due date, cycle and the "Assigned" badge; an orange border means the last check failed.

locker-tech-routine-first-details.title: Details
locker-tech-routine-first-details.body: Opens the full inspection plan (tapping the card works too).

locker-tech-routine-first-inspect.title: Inspect
locker-tech-routine-first-inspect.body: Opens the checklist; greyed out when the schedule belongs to another technician.

locker-tech-routine-first-ticket.title: Handle ticket
locker-tech-routine-first-ticket.body: The last check failed: complete this RPT ticket first, then you can inspect again.

locker-tech-schedule-detail-open.title: Open the schedule
locker-tech-schedule-detail-open.body: Tap "Details" (or the schedule card) to open it.

locker-tech-schedule-detail-head.title: Header
locker-tech-schedule-detail-head.body: Schedule title, the "Kiosk routine" type and the close button.

locker-tech-schedule-detail-badges.title: Overview badges
locker-tech-schedule-detail-badges.body: Due, priority, cycle, time slot and assigned technician.

locker-tech-schedule-detail-location.title: Device & location
locker-tech-schedule-detail-location.body: Kiosk station, address, location inside the building and the "Directions to locker" button.

locker-tech-schedule-detail-plan.title: Plan & deadline
locker-tech-schedule-detail-plan.body: Due date, start time, time slot, repeat cycle, priority, assigned technician and last inspection.

locker-tech-schedule-detail-checklist.title: Checklist
locker-tech-schedule-detail-checklist.body: The items to check, from the admin SOP.

locker-tech-schedule-detail-sop.title: Procedure
locker-tech-schedule-detail-sop.body: SOP notes from the admin, shown only when present.

locker-tech-schedule-detail-history.title: Previous result
locker-tech-schedule-detail-history.body: Passed / failed, time, technician, per-item results, notes, photos and the related incident ticket (if any).

locker-tech-schedule-detail-actions.title: Bottom buttons
locker-tech-schedule-detail-actions.body: "Inspect now" opens the checklist; after a failed check it is "Resolve ticket RPT-…".

locker-tech-routine-inspection-open.title: Inspect button
locker-tech-routine-inspection-open.body: Tap "Inspect" on the schedule card (or "Inspect now" in the schedule details).

locker-tech-routine-inspection-info.title: Locker and cycle
locker-tech-routine-inspection-info.body: Station name, locker code, cycle and address.

locker-tech-routine-inspection-items.title: Checklist items
locker-tech-routine-inspection-items.body: Choose Passed / Failed / N/A for each item and add a note; schedules without a checklist take an overall result.

locker-tech-routine-inspection-verdict.title: Provisional result
locker-tech-routine-inspection-verdict.body: Shows how many items are left, or PASSED (next due moves a cycle) / FAILED (a ticket is opened for you).

locker-tech-routine-inspection-fault.title: Faulty cell
locker-tech-routine-inspection-fault.body: When failed: pick the faulty cell so it is marked Broken and linked to the ticket, or leave it for a locker-level incident; you can describe the incident.

locker-tech-routine-inspection-photos.title: Evidence photos
locker-tech-routine-inspection-photos.body: Photograph the whole locker, locks or parts you checked (optional).

locker-tech-routine-inspection-actions.title: Close / Confirm
locker-tech-routine-inspection-actions.body: "Confirm completion" is enabled once everything is rated; "Close" leaves without saving.

locker-tech-iot-tab.title: IoT devices tab
locker-tech-iot-tab.body: The number in brackets counts the locker controllers.

locker-tech-iot-first-device.title: Device
locker-tech-iot-first-device.body: Device ID, its locker, "Last signal" and a status badge (online / offline / error). Tap for details.

locker-tech-iot-hint.title: Server-computed status
locker-tech-iot-hint.body: Status comes from the device's latest signal; if the list fails to load, tap "Try again" at the top.

locker-tech-iot-device-open.title: Open a device
locker-tech-iot-device-open.body: Tap a device in the list.

locker-tech-iot-device-info.title: Device info
locker-tech-iot-device-info.body: The "Device ID", "Locker", "Last signal" and "Connection" rows; only mark it manually when you are sure it is offline or broken.

locker-tech-iot-device-restart.title: Restart controller
locker-tech-iot-device-restart.body: Asks to confirm, then restarts the locker control process (not the machine); cells cannot open meanwhile. The result shows above the button.

locker-tech-iot-device-mark.title: Mark manually
locker-tech-iot-device-mark.body: "Mark disconnected" or "Mark faulty" until the controller sends a signal again (asks to confirm).

locker-tech-iot-device-logs.title: Activity log
locker-tech-iot-device-logs.body: The locker's 30 most recent events with times.

locker-tech-recovery-tab.title: Parcel recovery tab
locker-tech-recovery-tab.body: The number in brackets counts tasks that still need action.

locker-tech-recovery-banner.title: Recovery rules
locker-tech-recovery-banner.body: Recover at the verified drop location; take real photos and record GPS and parcel condition before sending to the admin.

locker-tech-recovery-first-card.title: Task
locker-tech-recovery-first-card.body: Incident code, status, order and drone, situation and drop coordinates; tap to open details.

locker-tech-recovery-detail-open.title: Open a task
locker-tech-recovery-detail-open.body: Tap a task card to open its details.

locker-tech-recovery-detail-accuracy.title: Data accuracy
locker-tech-recovery-detail-accuracy.body: Location source, accuracy and whether telemetry is live or stale.

locker-tech-recovery-detail-directions.title: Directions to drop location
locker-tech-recovery-detail-directions.body: Opens Google Maps to the drop coordinates.

locker-tech-recovery-detail-evidence.title: Existing evidence
locker-tech-recovery-detail-evidence.body: Photos already attached to the incident; swipe to browse.

locker-tech-recovery-detail-station.title: Receiving station
locker-tech-recovery-detail-station.body: The station the admin chose for the parcel: distance, whether a drone is available and the "Directions to station" button.

locker-tech-recovery-detail-action.title: Next step
locker-tech-recovery-detail-action.body: "Accept task", "Start searching", "Record search result", then after admin verification confirm the hand-over to the Hub or station.

locker-tech-recovery-result-open.title: Open the task
locker-tech-recovery-result-open.body: Tap a task that is being searched.

locker-tech-recovery-result-button.title: Record result button
locker-tech-recovery-result-button.body: Tap "Record search result" (only while the task is being searched).

locker-tech-recovery-result-gps.title: Confirm coordinates
locker-tech-recovery-result-gps.body: Tap to read the GPS coordinates where you stand; the app shows the distance to the drop point and lets you refresh.

locker-tech-recovery-result-outcome.title: Search result
locker-tech-recovery-result-outcome.body: "Parcel found", "Parcel not found" or "Area unsafe to search".

locker-tech-recovery-result-condition.title: Parcel condition
locker-tech-recovery-result-condition.body: When found: intact, minor damage, major damage, unusable or undetermined.

locker-tech-recovery-result-note.title: Field note
locker-tech-recovery-result-note.body: Required: where it was found, drone and parcel state; tap a "+ …" chip to insert it.

locker-tech-recovery-result-photos.title: On-site photos
locker-tech-recovery-result-photos.body: Taken with the camera; at least 1 photo is required.

locker-tech-recovery-result-submit.title: Send for verification
locker-tech-recovery-result-submit.body: Sends the result; if GPS is unavailable the app asks before sending.

locker-tech-installations-hint.title: Assigned jobs
locker-tech-installations-hint.body: A locker goes live only after the admin approves commissioning. Pull down to reload.

locker-tech-installations-empty.title: No jobs yet
locker-tech-installations-empty.body: When the admin assigns an installation job you get a notification and it appears here.

locker-tech-installations-first-item.title: Job card
locker-tech-installations-first-item.body: Locker name, status (Scheduled, In progress, Awaiting review, Approved, Cancelled), schedule, progress bar and admin return reason; tap to open.

locker-tech-install-detail-header.title: Installation info
locker-tech-install-detail-header.body: Locker name and code, status, schedule, power, network, cabinet model, notes and site contact (tap "Call"); the banner below tells you the next step.

locker-tech-install-detail-reload.title: Reload
locker-tech-install-detail-reload.body: Reads the locker data again to refresh the automatic steps.

locker-tech-install-detail-checklist.title: Commissioning checklist
locker-tech-install-detail-checklist.body: Steps done out of the total; chip-icon steps are verified automatically, person-icon steps are confirmed by you.

locker-tech-install-detail-site-photos.title: Site photos
locker-tech-install-detail-site-photos.body: At least 2 overview photos of the site are required; tap "Take photo", long-press a photo to delete it.

locker-tech-install-detail-missing.title: Still missing
locker-tech-install-detail-missing.body: Lists what must be done before you can submit.

locker-tech-install-detail-bottom.title: Start / Submit
locker-tech-install-detail-bottom.body: "Start installation" once on site; when everything is done, "Submit for review" (it shows how many items are left otherwise).

locker-tech-install-checklist-manual.title: Technician-confirmed step
locker-tech-install-checklist-manual.body: Like mounting: "Take photo" (required), "Mark passed", "Report failure" with a reason, "Not applicable" when allowed, or "Undo".

locker-tech-install-checklist-controller.title: Bind controller
locker-tech-install-checklist-controller.body: Tap "Bind controller", then "Scan QR" on the kiosk screen or "Pick from list" among online Pis; the locker installs its layout and test-opens boxes.

locker-tech-install-checklist-box-test.title: Test each box
locker-tech-install-checklist-box-test.body: Tap each box to test-open it, check the door pops and close it; "Test-open remaining boxes one by one" runs them all.

locker-tech-install-checklist-lid.title: Lid
locker-tech-install-checklist-lid.body: "Open lid" and "Close lid" so the system records it; for lockers without a lid use "Not applicable" with a reason.

locker-tech-profile-avatar.title: Profile photo
locker-tech-profile-avatar.body: Tap to take a new photo, choose one from the gallery or remove it.

locker-tech-profile-metrics.title: Shift performance
locker-tech-profile-metrics.body: Tickets assigned, in progress, done, overdue, quality rating and SLA level.

locker-tech-profile-form.title: Personal info
locker-tech-profile-form.body: Edit your full name (required, at least 2 characters) and contact phone; the account email and role are fixed.

locker-tech-profile-save.title: Save changes
locker-tech-profile-save.body: Saves the name and phone number you edited.

locker-tech-profile-language.title: Language
locker-tech-profile-language.body: Choose Tiếng Việt or English for the app.

locker-tech-profile-logout.title: Log out of account
locker-tech-profile-logout.body: Ends your shift and logs out after asking you to confirm.

admin-locker-more-menu-maintenance.title: Maintenance
admin-locker-more-menu-maintenance.body: Only shown while the locker is active: opens the dialog that puts the whole locker into maintenance (no new orders), optionally with a fault ticket for a technician.

admin-locker-more-menu-activate.title: Activate
admin-locker-more-menu-activate.body: Only shown while the locker is in maintenance or inactive: puts the locker back into service.

admin-locker-maintenance-mode-detail.title: Open the locker
admin-locker-maintenance-mode-detail.body: Choose "View details" in the ⋯ menu of the locker that needs maintenance.

admin-locker-maintenance-mode-more.title: More actions
admin-locker-maintenance-mode-more.body: The ⋯ button at the top holds the command that puts the locker into maintenance.

admin-locker-maintenance-mode-menu.title: Maintenance
admin-locker-maintenance-mode-menu.body: Opens the dialog. Only shown while the locker is active.

admin-locker-maintenance-mode-dialog.title: Locker maintenance dialog
admin-locker-maintenance-mode-dialog.body: A locker in maintenance takes no new orders; parcels already inside can still be collected.

admin-locker-maintenance-mode-report.title: Add a fault ticket
admin-locker-maintenance-mode-report.body: Tick to create a ticket for the locker's assigned technician (or all technicians if none is assigned); enter a title and a description of the fault.

admin-locker-maintenance-mode-confirm.title: Confirm
admin-locker-maintenance-mode-confirm.body: Puts the locker into maintenance (and creates the ticket if ticked). Reactivate it with "Activate" in the ⋯ menu.

admin-locker-maintenance-history-detail.title: Open the locker
admin-locker-maintenance-history-detail.body: Choose "View details" in the ⋯ menu of the locker whose history you want.

admin-locker-maintenance-history-tab.title: Repair & maintenance tab
admin-locker-maintenance-history-tab.body: Brings together this locker's fault tickets and scheduled inspections.

admin-locker-maintenance-history-kpis.title: Quick figures
admin-locker-maintenance-history-kpis.body: Total fault tickets, open tickets, resolved tickets and number of scheduled inspections.

admin-locker-maintenance-history-filters.title: Filter
admin-locker-maintenance-history-filters.body: Show everything, faults only or scheduled inspections only.

admin-locker-maintenance-history-list.title: Timeline
admin-locker-maintenance-history-list.body: Each card is a ticket or an inspection with its status, technician and photos; click it for details.

admin-settings-simulation-card.title: Simulation & demo cluster
admin-settings-simulation-card.body: All simulation modes and demo data of every service in one place, at the top of Business settings.

admin-settings-simulation-status.title: Status
admin-settings-simulation-status.body: "All off — live operation" is the right state when the system serves real customers.

admin-settings-simulation-actions.title: Turn off / on in bulk
admin-settings-simulation-actions.body: "Turn everything off" switches every item off at once. "Turn on demo mode" turns the demo items back on; the two locker test tools must be turned on separately.

admin-settings-simulation-list.title: Each item
admin-settings-simulation-list.body: Each item has its own switch and its underlying setting key; changes here take effect immediately on the live system.

admin-settings-simulation-confirm.title: Confirm
admin-settings-simulation-confirm.body: The confirmation lists exactly which items will change before saving.
